text: If the battery voltage is below 23V, Kitchen Subsystem shall activate Kitchen Warning buzzer and blink Kitchen Schalter on driver and hostess side yellow LED with 250 milliseconds interval for 10 seconds. Remark: To operate this behaviour engine shall not be running and additional battery shall not be installed on the vehicle and the parameter named G_78_PARA_Kueche_Grossverbr_Aktiv shall be defined.
en: If the battery voltage is below 23V, Kitchen Subsystem shall activate Kitchen Warning buzzer and blink Kitchen Schalter on driver and hostess side yellow LED with 250 milliseconds interval for 10 seconds.
remark: Remark: To operate this behaviour engine shall not be running and additional battery shall not be installed on the vehicle and the parameter named G_78_PARA_Kueche_Grossverbr_Aktiv shall be defined.

text: If the driver presses the upper part of Kitchen Schalter on the driver side or hostess side, Kitchen Subsystem shall set kitchen status as "Kitchen is in use". Remark: If the driver presses the lower part of Kitchen Schalter on the driver side or hostess side, Kitchen Subsystem shall deactivate kitchen operations.
en: If the driver presses the upper part of Kitchen Schalter on the driver side or hostess side, Kitchen Subsystem shall set kitchen status as "Kitchen is in use".
remark: Remark: If the driver presses the lower part of Kitchen Schalter on the driver side or hostess side, Kitchen Subsystem shall deactivate kitchen operations.

text: If kitchen is in use and ignition KL15 is active and the engine is running or additional battery is installed on the vehicle, Kitchen Subsystem shall activate High Consuming Mode. Remark: If the parameter named G_78_PARA_Kueche_Grossverbr_Aktiv is defined and battery voltage is not below 22.7V and ignition KL50 is not inactive more than 3 seconds and the vehicle is not locked from outside, Kitchen Subsystem shall also activate High Consuming Mode.
en: If kitchen is in use and ignition KL15 is active and the engine is running or additional battery is installed on the vehicle, Kitchen Subsystem shall activate High Consuming Mode.
remark: Remark: If the parameter named G_78_PARA_Kueche_Grossverbr_Aktiv is defined and battery voltage is not below 22.7V and ignition KL50 is not inactive more than 3 seconds and the vehicle is not locked from outside, Kitchen Subsystem shall also activate High Consuming Mode.

text: If High Consuming Mode is active, Kitchen Subsystem shall turn on Kitchen Schalter on hostess side green LED. Remark: To perform this behaviour hostess call shall not be active and door 1 shall not be open or the vehicle shall not be stationary(vehicle speed is greater than 3kmh) and battery voltage shall not be below 23V.
en: If High Consuming Mode is active, Kitchen Subsystem shall turn on Kitchen Schalter on hostess side green LED.
remark: Remark: To perform this behaviour hostess call shall not be active and door 1 shall not be open or the vehicle shall not be stationary(vehicle speed is greater than 3kmh) and battery voltage shall not be below 23V.

text: If kitchen is in use and High Consuming Mode is inactive, Kitchen Subsystem shall blink Kitchen Schalter on hostess side green LED (800 milliseconds on / 200 milliseconds off ). Remark: To perform this behaviour hostess call shall not be active and, door 1 shall not be open or the vehicle shall not be stationary and battery voltage shall not be below 23V.
en: If kitchen is in use and High Consuming Mode is inactive, Kitchen Subsystem shall blink Kitchen Schalter on hostess side green LED (800 milliseconds on / 200 milliseconds off ).
remark: Remark: To perform this behaviour hostess call shall not be active and, door 1 shall not be open or the vehicle shall not be stationary and battery voltage shall not be below 23V.

text: If hostess call is active and door 1 is not open or vehicle is not stationary, Kitchen Subsystem shall blink Kitchen Schalter on hostess side red LED with 500 milliseconds interval. Remark: To perform this behaviour, battery voltage shall not be below 23V.
en: If hostess call is active and door 1 is not open or vehicle is not stationary, Kitchen Subsystem shall blink Kitchen Schalter on hostess side red LED with 500 milliseconds interval.
remark: Remark: To perform this behaviour, battery voltage shall not be below 23V.

text: If door 1 is open and vehicle is stationary, Kitchen Schalter on hostess side red LED shall blink with 250 milliseconds interval. Remark: To perform this behaviour, battery voltage shall not be below 23V.
en: If door 1 is open and vehicle is stationary, Kitchen Schalter on hostess side red LED shall blink with 250 milliseconds interval.
remark: Remark: To perform this behaviour, battery voltage shall not be below 23V.

text: If High Consuming Mode is active and battery level is not below 23V, Kitchen Subsystem shall turn on Kitchen Schalter on driver side green LED. Remark: If Low Consuming Mode is active and battery level is not below 23V, Kitchen Subsystem shall blink Kitchen Schalter on driver side green LED (800 milliseconds on / 200 milliseconds off).
en: If High Consuming Mode is active and battery level is not below 23V, Kitchen Subsystem shall turn on Kitchen Schalter on driver side green LED.
remark: Remark: If Low Consuming Mode is active and battery level is not below 23V, Kitchen Subsystem shall blink Kitchen Schalter on driver side green LED (800 milliseconds on / 200 milliseconds off).

text: If kitchen is in use, Kitchen Subsystem shall turn on Kitchen Schalter on driver side green LED.
en: If kitchen is in use, Kitchen Subsystem shall turn on Kitchen Schalter on driver side green LED.

text: If hostess call is active, Kitchen Subsystem shall activate buzzer for 500 milliseconds.
en: If hostess call is active, Kitchen Subsystem shall activate buzzer for 500 milliseconds.

text: If kitchen is in use or High Consuming Mode is active, Kitchen Subsystem shall allow the usage of small consumers. Remark: If Low Consuming Mode is active, Kitchen Subsystem shall activate water pump, hostess call on.
en: If kitchen is in use or High Consuming Mode is active, Kitchen Subsystem shall allow the usage of small consumers.
remark: Remark: If Low Consuming Mode is active, Kitchen Subsystem shall activate water pump, hostess call on.

text: If kitchen is in use and hostess call is inactive and taster block is inactive, Kitchen Subsystem shall also turn on Kitchen Schalter on hostess side green LED.
en: If kitchen is in use and hostess call is inactive and taster block is inactive, Kitchen Subsystem shall also turn on Kitchen Schalter on hostess side green LED.

text: As long as Hostess Call is active, Kitchen Subsystem shall blink control indicator flashes. Remark: This behaviour is valid only for High-Floor buses.
en: As long as Hostess Call is active, Kitchen Subsystem shall blink control indicator flashes.
remark: Remark: This behaviour is valid only for High-Floor buses.

text: If the water tank in the kitchen is empty, Kitchen Subsystem shall transmit Water Tank Empty Information. Remark: This behaviour is valid only for High-Floor buses.
en: If the water tank in the kitchen is empty, Kitchen Subsystem shall transmit Water Tank Empty Information.
remark: Remark: This behaviour is valid only for High-Floor buses.

text: As soon as ignition KL50 is active, Electric Plug Socket Subsystem shall deactivate electric plug socket on the edge. Remark: If the parameter named G_68_PARA_Steckd_Aus_Kl50 is defined as soon as ignition KL50 is active, Electric Plug Socket Subsystem shall activate electric plug socket on the edge. To perform this behaviour the parameter named G_68_PARA_Steckd_vers_aus_bei_Kl50 shall be defined. This behaviour is valid only for Low Floor buses.
en: As soon as ignition KL50 is active, Electric Plug Socket Subsystem shall deactivate electric plug socket on the edge.
remark: Remark: If the parameter named G_68_PARA_Steckd_Aus_Kl50 is defined as soon as ignition KL50 is active, Electric Plug Socket Subsystem shall activate electric plug socket on the edge. To perform this behaviour the parameter named G_68_PARA_Steckd_vers_aus_bei_Kl50 shall be defined. This behaviour is valid only for Low Floor buses.

text: As soon as ignition radio is active, Refrigerator Subsystem shall activate refrigerator. Remark: Refrigerator Subsystem shall keep the refrigerator active for the time defined with the parameter named G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_Nachlauf. If the parameter named G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_nur_bei_KL15 is defined, Refrigerator Subsystem shall also activate refrigerator as soon as ignition KL15 is active. If the parameter named G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_nur_bei_Motorlauf is defined than Refrigerator Subsystem shall also activate refrigerator as soon as the engine is ready for running. This behaviour is valid only for Low Floor buses.
en: As soon as ignition radio is active, Refrigerator Subsystem shall activate refrigerator.
remark: Remark: Refrigerator Subsystem shall keep the refrigerator active for the time defined with the parameter named G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_Nachlauf. If the parameter named G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_nur_bei_KL15 is defined, Refrigerator Subsystem shall also activate refrigerator as soon as ignition KL15 is active. If the parameter named G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_nur_bei_Motorlauf is defined than Refrigerator Subsystem shall also activate refrigerator as soon as the engine is ready for running. This behaviour is valid only for Low Floor buses.

text: As long as ignition KL15 is active, Refrigerator Subsystem shall power up the refrigerator which is installed on the front part of the vehicle. Remark: This behaviour is valid only for High Floor buses.
en: As long as ignition KL15 is active, Refrigerator Subsystem shall power up the refrigerator which is installed on the front part of the vehicle.
remark: Remark: This behaviour is valid only for High Floor buses.

text: Transformer Subsystem shall activate kitchen transformer if the transformer schalter is installed on the vehicle and the driver presses the upper part of transformer schalter. Remark: If the transformer schalter is not installed, Transformer Subsystem shall activate the kitchen transformers if the engine is running or additional batteries are installed. To perform this behaviour ignition KL15 shall be active and ignition KL50 shall not be inactive for more than 3 seconds. Kitchen Transformers shall be controlled over high side and low side.
en: Transformer Subsystem shall activate kitchen transformer if the transformer schalter is installed on the vehicle and the driver presses the upper part of transformer schalter.
remark: Remark: If the transformer schalter is not installed, Transformer Subsystem shall activate the kitchen transformers if the engine is running or additional batteries are installed. To perform this behaviour ignition KL15 shall be active and ignition KL50 shall not be inactive for more than 3 seconds. Kitchen Transformers shall be controlled over high side and low side.

text: If the driver presses upper part of transformer schalter, Transformer Subsystem shall turn on transformer schalter yellow LED. Remark: To perform this behaviour, ignition KL15 shall be active and the engine shall be running or additional batteries shall be installed.
en: If the driver presses upper part of transformer schalter, Transformer Subsystem shall turn on transformer schalter yellow LED.
remark: Remark: To perform this behaviour, ignition KL15 shall be active and the engine shall be running or additional batteries shall be installed.

text: If the kitchen transformers are active and the driver presses lower part of transformer schalter, Transformer Subsystem shall deactivate kitchen transformers. Remark: If driver deactivates ignition KL15 or the engine stops running and additional batteries are not installed, Transformer Subsystem shall also deactivate kitchen transformers.
en: If the kitchen transformers are active and the driver presses lower part of transformer schalter, Transformer Subsystem shall deactivate kitchen transformers.
remark: Remark: If driver deactivates ignition KL15 or the engine stops running and additional batteries are not installed, Transformer Subsystem shall also deactivate kitchen transformers.

text: Refrigerator Subsystem shall not operate in undervoltage conditions.
en: Refrigerator Subsystem shall not operate in undervoltage conditions.

text: Kitchen Transformers shall not operate in case of undervoltage conditions.
en: Kitchen Transformers shall not operate in case of undervoltage conditions.

text: Kitchen Schalter on driver side and hostess side red LED shall blink with 250 milliseconds interval if driver presses the schalters in case of undervoltage conditions.
en: Kitchen Schalter on driver side and hostess side red LED shall blink with 250 milliseconds interval if driver presses the schalters in case of undervoltage conditions.

text: Kitchen Schalters are locked in case of undervoltage conditions.
en: Kitchen Schalters are locked in case of undervoltage conditions.

text: High or Low Consuming Modes shall not be activated in case of undervoltage conditions.
en: High or Low Consuming Modes shall not be activated in case of undervoltage conditions.

text: Kitchen Lights shall be active in Exhibition Mode.
en: Kitchen Lights shall be active in Exhibition Mode.

text: As soon as the water tank in the Kitchen is empty, Diagnostics Subsystem shall perform the diagnostics operation with the following parameters: Priority: 5 SPN: 6602 FMI: 0 Diagnostic Subsystem shall perform diagnostic operation with 30 seconds delay and shall keep performing the diagnostics operation for 1 minute. Diagnostics subsystem shall display the error on the dashboard. There is no need to save the error code for this operation. This behaviour is valid only for Skyliner buses.
en: As soon as the water tank in the Kitchen is empty, Diagnostics Subsystem shall perform the diagnostics operation with the following parameters: Priority: 5 SPN: 6602 FMI: 0 Diagnostic Subsystem shall perform diagnostic operation with 30 seconds delay and shall keep performing the diagnostics operation for 1 minute. Diagnostics subsystem shall display the error on the dashboard. There is no need to save the error code for this operation. This behaviour is valid only for Skyliner buses.

text: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_68_PARA_Steckd_Aus_Kl50 BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate electric plug with ignition KL50.
en: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_68_PARA_Steckd_Aus_Kl50 BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate electric plug with ignition KL50.

text: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_68_PARA_Steckd_Vers_aus_bei_Kl50 BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate electric plug consumption with ignition KL50.
en: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_68_PARA_Steckd_Vers_aus_bei_Kl50 BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate electric plug consumption with ignition KL50.

text: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_nur_bei_KL15 BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate Refrigerator with ignition KL15.
en: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_nur_bei_KL15 BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate Refrigerator with ignition KL15.

text: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_nur_bei_Motorlauf BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate Refrigerator when the engine is ready for running.
en: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_nur_bei_Motorlauf BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate Refrigerator when the engine is ready for running.

text: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_Nachlauf TIME 0 65535 This parameter shall be defined to set the refrigerator delay time.
en: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_68_PARA_Kuehlbox_Nachlauf TIME 0 65535 This parameter shall be defined to set the refrigerator delay time.

text: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_78_PARA_Kueche_Grossverbr_Aktiv BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate High Consuming Mode.
en: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_78_PARA_Kueche_Grossverbr_Aktiv BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate High Consuming Mode.

text: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_78_PARA_Enable_KuecheBeif_S BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate Kitchen Schalter on the hostess side.
en: Name Type Min Max Description KSW Requirement ID G_78_PARA_Enable_KuecheBeif_S BOOL 0 1 This parameter shall be defined to activate Kitchen Schalter on the hostess side.

text: Stop request button (IBSR_StStopReqBtnAcv_O) shall be active, if control of stop request signal is active.
en: Stop request button (IBSR_StStopReqBtnAcv_O) shall be active, if control of stop request signal is active.

text: Video system in standard shall be activate by Ignition Radio. In default it is upholded for 5 minutes after turning off Ignition Radio. There is a possibility of changing or turning off uphold time via parameter.
en: Video system in standard shall be activate by Ignition Radio. In default it is upholded for 5 minutes after turning off Ignition Radio. There is a possibility of changing or turning off uphold time via parameter.

text: Defining one parameter make Video system is active for defined time after activating Ignition Radio or after turning off Ignition Clamp15 (condition is active Ignition Radio). Then constant activating is via Ignition Clamp15.
en: Defining one parameter make Video system is active for defined time after activating Ignition Radio or after turning off Ignition Clamp15 (condition is active Ignition Radio). Then constant activating is via Ignition Clamp15.

text: There must be a possibility to adjust the power supply conditions to client requirement. As an option video system shall be supplied also at waiting room mode.
en: There must be a possibility to adjust the power supply conditions to client requirement. As an option video system shall be supplied also at waiting room mode.

text: A kit of standard signals shall be delivered to the video system: 1) alarm signal; 2) opened door signal (general and separated for each door); 3) permission for door opening (for automatic type doors); 3) reverse signal (automatically or manually by a button); 4) signal for changing the view on monitor (additional button required); 5) speed signal; 6) blinkers signal. The bus system shall have the ability to receive error signal from the video system.
en: A kit of standard signals shall be delivered to the video system: 1) alarm signal; 2) opened door signal (general and separated for each door); 3) permission for door opening (for automatic type doors); 3) reverse signal (automatically or manually by a button); 4) signal for changing the view on monitor (additional button required); 5) speed signal; 6) blinkers signal. The bus system shall have the ability to receive error signal from the video system.

text: There should be a possibility to provide additional signals for the system (depending on client needs).
en: There should be a possibility to provide additional signals for the system (depending on client needs).

text: Exhibition mode blocks a possibility of changing camera view by button.
en: Exhibition mode blocks a possibility of changing camera view by button.

text: Driver door buttons are used for manual door control. This requirement document describes 1st door control possibilites. The principle is similar to other door control (2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th) described in document 156889 but there are some differences, because if 1st door consist of 2 wings there is a possibility to controll each wing independently. The system shall always provide the possibility to control the doors by the button: for manual, half-automatic and automatic doors. Every door button is a taster-type and is equipped with backlight. If 1st door consists of 2 wings, the system shall be prepared to control them by one common button or 2 separate buttons for each wing.
en: Driver door buttons are used for manual door control. This requirement document describes 1st door control possibilites. The principle is similar to other door control (2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th) described in document 156889 but there are some differences, because if 1st door consist of 2 wings there is a possibility to controll each wing independently. The system shall always provide the possibility to control the doors by the button: for manual, half-automatic and automatic doors. Every door button is a taster-type and is equipped with backlight. If 1st door consists of 2 wings, the system shall be prepared to control them by one common button or 2 separate buttons for each wing.

text: If the system is equipped with one button for both wings control, door wings shall be controlled together. If the system is equipped with two buttons for separete wings control, each button shall control its assigned wing.
en: If the system is equipped with one button for both wings control, door wings shall be controlled together. If the system is equipped with two buttons for separete wings control, each button shall control its assigned wing.

text: The system shall provide additional possibility: if the bus is equipped with separete wings control buttons for each wing of door 1, there is a possibility to provide an additional FAP button to enable a temporary possibility to steer both wings by one wing door button. One wing door button (for front or rear wing) has the possibility to control front and rear wing at the same time.
en: The system shall provide additional possibility: if the bus is equipped with separete wings control buttons for each wing of door 1, there is a possibility to provide an additional FAP button to enable a temporary possibility to steer both wings by one wing door button. One wing door button (for front or rear wing) has the possibility to control front and rear wing at the same time.

text: The system shall provide the possibility to open corresponding door wing by driver button if all below conditions are met: - bus stop brake is active / parking break is active / bus stop brake is emergency-released / departure block is active ; - bus speed < 1km/h; - doors are not deactivated and are in normal mode; - doors and driver buttons are supplied; - doors are closed / closing;
en: The system shall provide the possibility to open corresponding door wing by driver button if all below conditions are met: - bus stop brake is active / parking break is active / bus stop brake is emergency-released / departure block is active ; - bus speed < 1km/h; - doors are not deactivated and are in normal mode; - doors and driver buttons are supplied; - doors are closed / closing;

text: The system shall be able to close the doors basing on the button signal if all below requirements are fulfilled: - doors and driver buttons are supplied; - doors are opened / opening; - light barrier is not active; - door closing blockade is not active; - driver door button blockade is not active; - doors are not deactivated and are in normal mode;
en: The system shall be able to close the doors basing on the button signal if all below requirements are fulfilled: - doors and driver buttons are supplied; - doors are opened / opening; - light barrier is not active; - door closing blockade is not active; - driver door button blockade is not active; - doors are not deactivated and are in normal mode;

text: For door 3 and door 4 the system shall provide optionall possibility to disable the opening or closing function of the driver door button.
en: For door 3 and door 4 the system shall provide optionall possibility to disable the opening or closing function of the driver door button.

text: For example: if proper parameter is enabled, it is possible to open the corresponding door by driver button but there is no possibility to use it for doors closing. In second case: when another parameter is enabled, it is possible to close the correspodning door by driver button but there is no possibility to use if for door opening. If both parameters for corresponding doors are activated it is not possible to operate the doors from driver button.
en: For example: if proper parameter is enabled, it is possible to open the corresponding door by driver button but there is no possibility to use it for doors closing. In second case: when another parameter is enabled, it is possible to close the correspodning door by driver button but there is no possibility to use if for door opening. If both parameters for corresponding doors are activated it is not possible to operate the doors from driver button.

text: The system shall be prepared to implement an optional solution with door opening standby function. If the bus speed is higher than 1 km/h and the driver door button is pressed, then the function shall be activated. The system shall open the door automatically if the bus stops in 10 seconds from pressing the button (the time and speed limit shall be parametrized).
en: The system shall be prepared to implement an optional solution with door opening standby function. If the bus speed is higher than 1 km/h and the driver door button is pressed, then the function shall be activated. The system shall open the door automatically if the bus stops in 10 seconds from pressing the button (the time and speed limit shall be parametrized).

text: The system shall also provide the user with the possibility to use driver door button for forced closing (the time of holding the button pressed shall be also parametrized). Optionally it is possible to connect this function with door release - forced closing can be activated only at deactivated door opening release.
en: The system shall also provide the user with the possibility to use driver door button for forced closing (the time of holding the button pressed shall be also parametrized). Optionally it is possible to connect this function with door release - forced closing can be activated only at deactivated door opening release.

text: Forced closing is a situation when door equipped with light barrier cannot be closed automatically (in automatic mode) because there is an obstacle in the range of the barrier filed of view (the doors are reversing). Normally is means a situation, when someone is standing near the exit but not centrally in the line of doors so they can be securely closed. In forced closing mode the light barrier state is not taken into consideration.
en: Forced closing is a situation when door equipped with light barrier cannot be closed automatically (in automatic mode) because there is an obstacle in the range of the barrier filed of view (the doors are reversing). Normally is means a situation, when someone is standing near the exit but not centrally in the line of doors so they can be securely closed. In forced closing mode the light barrier state is not taken into consideration.

text: Driver button shall be highlighted by the system in several modes: - blinking (250ms on/250ms off) by activated nothahn with no door 1 local mode (highest priority); - blinking (200/800) by door error with no door 1 local mode (2nd priority); - blinking (250/3000) by door local mode or nothahn cap breakup (3rd priority); - constant backlight at opened doors or at door reverse (4th priority); - constant backlight or blinking (parameter - 200/800) at active door opening standby function (5th priority); - backlight by active stop demand (optional ¿ lowest priority).
en: Driver button shall be highlighted by the system in several modes: - blinking (250ms on/250ms off) by activated nothahn with no door 1 local mode (highest priority); - blinking (200/800) by door error with no door 1 local mode (2nd priority); - blinking (250/3000) by door local mode or nothahn cap breakup (3rd priority); - constant backlight at opened doors or at door reverse (4th priority); - constant backlight or blinking (parameter - 200/800) at active door opening standby function (5th priority); - backlight by active stop demand (optional ¿ lowest priority).

text: Note: if the bus is equipped with common button for 2 wings of door 1 control, if any of above conditions appear only for one of the wings, the backlight shall be activated at the button as well.
en: Note: if the bus is equipped with common button for 2 wings of door 1 control, if any of above conditions appear only for one of the wings, the backlight shall be activated at the button as well.

text: The system shall provide the possibility to adapt an optionall functionality with one wing of door 1 blocking. If the bus is equipped with one, common button for both wings of door 1 control, the system shall be prepared to apply an aditional FAP button for wings blocking. If the wing blocking button is used, the main door 1 button shall only control the wing which is not blocked.
en: The system shall provide the possibility to adapt an optionall functionality with one wing of door 1 blocking. If the bus is equipped with one, common button for both wings of door 1 control, the system shall be prepared to apply an aditional FAP button for wings blocking. If the wing blocking button is used, the main door 1 button shall only control the wing which is not blocked.

text: If the doors are left in different wings state (one wing of door 1 is closed and the 2nd is opened), the wing-blocking button is no longer used and main driver door button is used, the system shall lead both wings for close state (shall close the wing which was opened). Optionally the system shall provide an opening priority signal for all doors. In this mode, the system shall lead both wings for open state (shall open the wing which was closed).
en: If the doors are left in different wings state (one wing of door 1 is closed and the 2nd is opened), the wing-blocking button is no longer used and main driver door button is used, the system shall lead both wings for close state (shall close the wing which was opened). Optionally the system shall provide an opening priority signal for all doors. In this mode, the system shall lead both wings for open state (shall open the wing which was closed).

text: The system shall distinguish if the bus is equipped with additional dashboard button for wing/wings blocking and basing on this information two different signals shall be prepared for wing blocking. Optionally the difference can by also made by an additional parameter.
en: The system shall distinguish if the bus is equipped with additional dashboard button for wing/wings blocking and basing on this information two different signals shall be prepared for wing blocking. Optionally the difference can by also made by an additional parameter.

text: Below requirements describe half-automatic door mode. This kind of door control is included in 'doors manual' part of software because it uses the same signals to control the doors. The main difference between manual and half-automatic is the presence of additional button on drivers dashboard - door release button.
en: Below requirements describe half-automatic door mode. This kind of door control is included in 'doors manual' part of software because it uses the same signals to control the doors. The main difference between manual and half-automatic is the presence of additional button on drivers dashboard - door release button.

text: At half automatic mode the system shall open the doors basing on the request from passenger door opening buttons (optionally stop request buttons) - if one of this buttons was used, the doors shall be opened after enabling door opening release by the driver.
en: At half automatic mode the system shall open the doors basing on the request from passenger door opening buttons (optionally stop request buttons) - if one of this buttons was used, the doors shall be opened after enabling door opening release by the driver.

text: By default the system shall provide the possibility to close the doors in half automatic mode by driver door button. Optionally the system shall provide the possibility to close the doors in half-automatic mode by deactivating door release.
en: By default the system shall provide the possibility to close the doors in half automatic mode by driver door button. Optionally the system shall provide the possibility to close the doors in half-automatic mode by deactivating door release.

text: The system shall provide optional possibility to close the doors at half automatic mode (if the doors were firstly open in half-automatic mode) by driver button only if door opening release is not active.
en: The system shall provide optional possibility to close the doors at half automatic mode (if the doors were firstly open in half-automatic mode) by driver button only if door opening release is not active.

text: Optionally the system shall provide the possibility to activate half-automatic mode only for rear wing of door 1. For example - if there is a request for door opening from door 1 passenger area, after activating door release only rear wing of door 1 is opened.
en: Optionally the system shall provide the possibility to activate half-automatic mode only for rear wing of door 1. For example - if there is a request for door opening from door 1 passenger area, after activating door release only rear wing of door 1 is opened.

text: The difference between automatic and half-automatic mode is that at auto mode when the doors are opened, the closing starts automatically after defined time (default 3 seconds) while at half-automatic mode the doors stay opened till they are closed manually by the driver (by deactivating door release or by door button).
en: The difference between automatic and half-automatic mode is that at auto mode when the doors are opened, the closing starts automatically after defined time (default 3 seconds) while at half-automatic mode the doors stay opened till they are closed manually by the driver (by deactivating door release or by door button).

text: Below requirements refer to door 1 driver external button - it is included in this document because this button is also used for manual door 1 control by the driver. External driver button is detaily described in other document (PTC ID 268950).
en: Below requirements refer to door 1 driver external button - it is included in this document because this button is also used for manual door 1 control by the driver. External driver button is detaily described in other document (PTC ID 268950).

text: The system shall provide the possibility to deactivate external door 1 driver button by dedicated dashboard button - if the button on the dasboard is pressed, external button is blocked.
en: The system shall provide the possibility to deactivate external door 1 driver button by dedicated dashboard button - if the button on the dasboard is pressed, external button is blocked.

text: External driver button functionality shall be additionally parametrized by below parameters: 1) blockade by ignition radio and neutral gear (external door 1 driver button is not enabled at activated ignition radio and neutral gear); 2) blockade by ignition clamp 15 and bus stop brake (external door 1 driver button is not enabled at activated ignition clamp 15 and bus stop brake); 3) blockade by ignition clamp 15 and hand brake (external door 1 driver button is not enabled at activated ignition clamp 15 and hand brake) ; 4) blockade by running engine (external door 1 driver button is enabled only when the engine is not running); 5) blockade by inactive hand brake (external door 1 driver button is enabled only at active hand brake); 6) blockade by ignition radio;
en: External driver button functionality shall be additionally parametrized by below parameters: 1) blockade by ignition radio and neutral gear (external door 1 driver button is not enabled at activated ignition radio and neutral gear); 2) blockade by ignition clamp 15 and bus stop brake (external door 1 driver button is not enabled at activated ignition clamp 15 and bus stop brake); 3) blockade by ignition clamp 15 and hand brake (external door 1 driver button is not enabled at activated ignition clamp 15 and hand brake) ; 4) blockade by running engine (external door 1 driver button is enabled only when the engine is not running); 5) blockade by inactive hand brake (external door 1 driver button is enabled only at active hand brake); 6) blockade by ignition radio;

text: Optionally the system shall provide a solution to control only front wing of door 1 by external door 1 driver button. The button has no impact on rear wing (this solution can be only implemented if door 1 has 2 wings).
en: Optionally the system shall provide a solution to control only front wing of door 1 by external door 1 driver button. The button has no impact on rear wing (this solution can be only implemented if door 1 has 2 wings).

text: Driver door buttons shall remain its functions as long as the door controlled is supplied.
en: Driver door buttons shall remain its functions as long as the door controlled is supplied.

text: At exhibition mode driver door 1 button/buttons shall only have the possibility to open the door. The system shall not provide the possibility to close 1st door at exhibition mode.
en: At exhibition mode driver door 1 button/buttons shall only have the possibility to open the door. The system shall not provide the possibility to close 1st door at exhibition mode.

text: Standard panic mode shall be activated by special button (IBPB_StIbisEmcyCallBtn) or by foot-button (IBPB_StIbisEmcyCallFootBtn) and shall be active as long as buttons are pushed.
en: Standard panic mode shall be activated by special button (IBPB_StIbisEmcyCallBtn) or by foot-button (IBPB_StIbisEmcyCallFootBtn) and shall be active as long as buttons are pushed.

text: There is option of independent button for activating quiet panic mode. In this case there is no signals for warning lights, horn, video system and destination displays. Turning off button shall deactivate mode.
en: There is option of independent button for activating quiet panic mode. In this case there is no signals for warning lights, horn, video system and destination displays. Turning off button shall deactivate mode.

text: There may be a reset button which shall activate another output to reset panic mode.
en: There may be a reset button which shall activate another output to reset panic mode.

text: Turning on Panic Button causes sending Opening Door Request. Signal is deactivated by opening all doors.
en: Turning on Panic Button causes sending Opening Door Request. Signal is deactivated by opening all doors.

text: When exhibition mode is active, emergency mode activation signals shall not be activated when driver presses panic button, FAP panic button or foot-button.
en: When exhibition mode is active, emergency mode activation signals shall not be activated when driver presses panic button, FAP panic button or foot-button.

Stop supplying the monitors could occur with a delay set in parameter (option) There is a possibility of uphold when "radio" is active (option) 1. en: If the monitors are supplied in any of above way, the LED installed on the "Monitor PWR" taster lights-up.

text: The monitors supply could occur if the waiting room mode is active. (option) (KSW)
en: The monitors supply could occur if the waiting room mode is active. (option) (KSW)

text: The image of rear view camera could be displayed on the monitor 1 (IBMO_StRvdcmrOn) when one of the following conditions are satisfied: 1. Rear view camera TEMP_StRvdcmrAcv is active (deavtivated by IBP_StsIbisWoutRvdcmr_P parameter) or the system detect the revers driving (GW_StRvsGearEngd is active)(deavtivated by IBP_StsIbisWoutRvdcmr_P parameter) or any door is opened (the signal is DBF_StsDoorxClsd is inactive) AND Exibition mode is off AND if priority is in reverse for monitor (IBP_CfgDoorAbvDrvgRvsPrio_P parameter set to 0) . 2.Additional button IBMO_StMoniAddlSwtPosn1 is active.
en: The image of rear view camera could be displayed on the monitor 1 (IBMO_StRvdcmrOn) when one of the following conditions are satisfied: 1. Rear view camera TEMP_StRvdcmrAcv is active (deavtivated by IBP_StsIbisWoutRvdcmr_P parameter) or the system detect the revers driving (GW_StRvsGearEngd is active)(deavtivated by IBP_StsIbisWoutRvdcmr_P parameter) or any door is opened (the signal is DBF_StsDoorxClsd is inactive) AND Exibition mode is off AND if priority is in reverse for monitor (IBP_CfgDoorAbvDrvgRvsPrio_P parameter set to 0) . 2.Additional button IBMO_StMoniAddlSwtPosn1 is active.

text: The system shall be able to display the view on the monitor 1 from the camera directed on a door instead of the image from rear view camera. (option)
en: The system shall be able to display the view on the monitor 1 from the camera directed on a door instead of the image from rear view camera. (option)

text: The image from rear view camera is displayed on monitor 2 when: *. The door X is opened (option) *. The exhibition mode was not met.
en: The image from rear view camera is displayed on monitor 2 when: *. The door X is opened (option) *. The exhibition mode was not met.

text: The image from camera 1 will be displayed on monitor 2 when the driver pushes the "Camera" button.
en: The image from camera 1 will be displayed on monitor 2 when the driver pushes the "Camera" button.

text: The monitor 2 shall be able to display image from camera 1 when the "Stop request" button is pushed. (option)
en: The monitor 2 shall be able to display image from camera 1 when the "Stop request" button is pushed. (option)

text: The monitor 2 shall be able to display image from camera 1 when: *. The exhibition mode was not active *. The image from rear view camera is not displaying on monitor 2 *. Displaying image from camera 1 on monitor 2 could be turn on when the door X is opened was met (option) and ignition was radio(with parameter).
en: The monitor 2 shall be able to display image from camera 1 when: *. The exhibition mode was not active *. The image from rear view camera is not displaying on monitor 2 *. Displaying image from camera 1 on monitor 2 could be turn on when the door X is opened was met (option) and ignition was radio(with parameter).

text: The monitor 2 shall be able to display image from camera 1 when: *. The door X is opened (option) *. The request about turning off the monitor when set value of speed was reached is defined (option) *. The parameter about door and speed is active (option) The signal shall be deactivated by turning off Ignition or by reaching defined value of speed.

The request about turning off the monitor when set value of speed was reached is defined (option) *. The parameter about door and speed is active (option) The signal shall be deactivated by turning off Ignition or by reaching defined value of speed.

text: The system shall be able to delay turning off displaying the image from camera 1 on monitor 2. (option)
en: The system shall be able to delay turning off displaying the image from camera 1 on monitor 2. (option)

text: Conditions of displaying image from camera 1 on monitor 3 are relevant to conditions for monitor 2.
en: Conditions of displaying image from camera 1 on monitor 3 are relevant to conditions for monitor 2.

text: The monitor 3 shall be able to display image from camera 1 when: *. The exhibition mode was not active *. Parameter about door and speed was inactive (option) *. Displaying image from camera 1 on monitor 3 could be turn on when Ignition Radio is active (option) and the door X is opened was met (option)
en: The monitor 3 shall be able to display image from camera 1 when: *. The exhibition mode was not active *. Parameter about door and speed was inactive (option) *. Displaying image from camera 1 on monitor 3 could be turn on when Ignition Radio is active (option) and the door X is opened was met (option)

Manual activation by pushing switch installed on drivers working space and the function enabling displaying image from camera 1 on monitor 1 by "stop request" taster is enabled or the image from camera 1 on monitor 1 is displaying if any of the doors is opened and the function disabling image from camera on monitor when the set speed is exceeded is active. en: When the exhibition mode is enable: *. the supply of the monitors shall not occur *. the image of the rear view camera shall not be displayed on monitor 1 *. the image of the rear view camera shall not be displayed on monitor 2 *. the image of the camera 1 on monitor 2 shall not be displayed *. the image of the camera 1 on monitor 3 shall not be displayed

text: Euro Box lighting shall be active in three below cases: - Cash Desk lighting is active - Driver Place lighting is active - External signal is active on digital input.
en: Euro Box lighting shall be active in three below cases: - Cash Desk lighting is active - Driver Place lighting is active - External signal is active on digital input.

text: There is a possibility an Euro Box lighting is active when Parking Lights are active.
en: There is a possibility an Euro Box lighting is active when Parking Lights are active.

text:
Roof hatches activation with buttons;
-Ignition clamp radio should activate.
-Under voltage should not activated.
When the first roof hatch button is pressed, the following conditions occur in the in system:
-First press, Roof Hatches is front open and left side button LED is activated.
-Second press, Roof Hatches is rear open, front is already is opened and, two LED is activated.
-Third press,roof hatches is front closed and left side button LED is deactivated.The rear is already open and right button LED is activated
-Fourth press, Roof Hatches is rear closed and button LEDs deactivated.
en:
Roof hatches activation with buttons;
-Ignition clamp radio should activate.
-Under voltage should not activated.
When the first roof hatch button is pressed, the following conditions occur in the in system:
-First press, Roof Hatches is front open and left side button LED is activated.
-Second press, Roof Hatches is rear open, front is already is opened and, two LED is activated.
-Third press,roof hatches is front closed and left side button LED is deactivated.The rear is already open and right button LED is activated
-Fourth press, Roof Hatches is rear closed and button LEDs deactivated.

text:
When an error occurs in the roof hatches driver (voltage fluctuations, system overload, etc.), the program shall wait 20 seconds and then close the relevant roof hatches.
After the system is closed status, if the error is still active, the system cannot be opened.
If the system was previously open, the roof hatches shall return to their previous positions once the fault condition is resolved.
en:
When an error occurs in the roof hatches driver (voltage fluctuations, system overload, etc.), the program shall wait 20 seconds and then close the relevant roof hatches.
After the system is closed status, if the error is still active, the system cannot be opened.
If the system was previously open, the roof hatches shall return to their previous positions once the fault condition is resolved.

text: Roof hatch shall be open as long as open-signal is active. Due to work of actuator, It takes approximately 15 seconds for the roof hatch to change position when the opening signal changes.
en: Roof hatch shall be open as long as open-signal is active. Due to work of actuator, It takes approximately 15 seconds for the roof hatch to change position when the opening signal changes.

text: After the ignition is switched on, roof hatches shall automatically go to position in witch they were last time when ignition was turned on.
en: After the ignition is switched on, roof hatches shall automatically go to position in witch they were last time when ignition was turned on.

text: CANCELED
en: CANCELED

text:
Windscreen wiper:
-Ignition clamp radio should activate.
-Under voltage should not activated.
If the roof hatches have been opened previously, the system shall closes all the roof hatches after 30 seconds from moment when wiper was turned on.
After that, the driver shall not open roof hatches with buttons. If the driver attempts to open the roof hatches using the buttons while windscreen wipers are activated, the system will not open,buton the request is stores in memory.
If the wiper status turn off, roof hatches shall be open with buttons after 1 minutes.
en:
Windscreen wiper:
-Ignition clamp radio should activate.
-Under voltage should not activated.
If the roof hatches have been opened previously, the system shall closes all the roof hatches after 30 seconds from moment when wiper was turned on.
After that, the driver shall not open roof hatches with buttons. If the driver attempts to open the roof hatches using the buttons while windscreen wipers are activated, the system will not open,buton the request is stores in memory.
If the wiper status turn off, roof hatches shall be open with buttons after 1 minutes.

text:
When Rain&Twilight sensor;
-Ignition clamp radio should activate.
-Under voltage should not activated.
If the roof hatches have been opened previously, the system shall closes all the roof hatches after 10 seconds from moment when rain was detected .
Roof hatches can not controlled with buttons.If the driver attempts to open the roof hatches using the buttons while rain&twilight are activated, the system will not open,buton the request is stores in memory.
If the rain&twilight sensors turn off, roof hatches shall be open with buttons after 1 minutes.
en:
When Rain&Twilight sensor;
-Ignition clamp radio should activate.
-Under voltage should not activated.
If the roof hatches have been opened previously, the system shall closes all the roof hatches after 10 seconds from moment when rain was detected .
Roof hatches can not controlled with buttons.If the driver attempts to open the roof hatches using the buttons while rain&twilight are activated, the system will not open,buton the request is stores in memory.
If the rain&twilight sensors turn off, roof hatches shall be open with buttons after 1 minutes.

text:
HVAC systems;
When the HVAC system is activated, the following conditions shall be met:
1. When air conditioning (heating and cooling) is active, roof hatches shall close. Roof hatches can not controlled with buttons. If the driver attempts to open the roof hatches using the buttons while HVAC is activated, the system will not open,buton the request is stores in memory.
2. When the frontbox is activated, Roof hatches shall not closed.
3. When smog (air pollution, smoke) is detected, roof hatches shall be closed.Roof hatches can not controlled with buttons.
4.If the HVAC and smoke is turn off, roof hatches can be controlled with buttons.
en:
HVAC systems;
When the HVAC system is activated, the following conditions shall be met:
1. When air conditioning (heating and cooling) is active, roof hatches shall close. Roof hatches can not controlled with buttons. If the driver attempts to open the roof hatches using the buttons while HVAC is activated, the system will not open,buton the request is stores in memory.
2. When the frontbox is activated, Roof hatches shall not closed.
3. When smog (air pollution, smoke) is detected, roof hatches shall be closed.Roof hatches can not controlled with buttons.
4.If the HVAC and smoke is turn off, roof hatches can be controlled with buttons.

text: System shall send to display information which roof hatches are opened.
en: System shall send to display information which roof hatches are opened.

text: CANCELED
en: CANCELED

text:
Undervoltage ;
-Ignition clamp radio should activate.
When an undervoltage is detected, the system shall automatically close all roof hatches. Until the undervoltage consition is resolved, the driver is prevented from reopening the roof hatches using the buttons.
When the undervoltage condition is removed, if the roof hatch was previously left open, the roof hatch shall return to its previous position.
en:
Undervoltage ;
-Ignition clamp radio should activate.
When an undervoltage is detected, the system shall automatically close all roof hatches. Until the undervoltage consition is resolved, the driver is prevented from reopening the roof hatches using the buttons.
When the undervoltage condition is removed, if the roof hatch was previously left open, the roof hatch shall return to its previous position.

text:
In Exhibition mode:
If all off the conditions below are fulfilled , roof hatches open automatically after 3 seconds;
-Ignition clamp radio is active.
-Any door is open .
During this mode ,error messages shall not appear on display.
en:
In Exhibition mode:
If all off the conditions below are fulfilled , roof hatches open automatically after 3 seconds;
-Ignition clamp radio is active.
-Any door is open .
During this mode ,error messages shall not appear on display.

text: If door entrance illumination control indicator exists in the bus it shall be on if manual dedicated manual input was received (and not reset) and key is in 2nd position.
en: If door entrance illumination control indicator exists in the bus it shall be on if manual dedicated manual input was received (and not reset) and key is in 2nd position.

text: Door Entrance Illumination Intensity shall be defined by a parameter DoorIEntrancellluminationIntensity_P [kibes ref: G_77_PARA_Tuer_1_Einstiegsbele_Dimm] (150 PWM by default).
en: Door Entrance Illumination Intensity shall be defined by a parameter DoorIEntrancellluminationIntensity_P [kibes ref: G_77_PARA_Tuer_1_Einstiegsbele_Dimm] (150 PWM by default).

text:
The system shall be three possible states;
-The system shall be Disabled,
-The systemshall be Enabledfor all doors and
-The system shall be operated by Door System Controller for each door separately.
en:
The system shall be three possible states;
-The system shall be Disabled,
-The systemshall be Enabledfor all doors and
-The system shall be operated by Door System Controller for each door separately.

text:
CANCELLED.
DoorIEntrancellluminationControl ENABLED state shall have the highest priority – when requirements for DoorIEntrancellluminationControl to be ENABLED are met, DoorIEntrancellluminationControl shall be enabled regardless of other requirements.
en:

DoorIEntrancellluminationControl ENABLED state shall have the highest priority – when requirements for DoorIEntrancellluminationControl to be ENABLED are met, DoorIEntrancellluminationControl shall be enabled regardless of other requirements.

text: The system shall be activated when at least one of the doors emergency mode is on.
en: The system shall be activated when at least one of the doors emergency mode is on.

text: There shall exist a possibility to add the following functionality with a parameter LIP_CfgDoorIntLiPrmnt_P [kibes ref: G_77_PARA_KSW_Dauer_Einsteigsbel] : DoorIEntrancellluminationControl shall be ENABLED when door is released to automatic operation.
en: There shall exist a possibility to add the following functionality with a parameter LIP_CfgDoorIntLiPrmnt_P [kibes ref: G_77_PARA_KSW_Dauer_Einsteigsbel] : DoorIEntrancellluminationControl shall be ENABLED when door is released to automatic operation.

text:
LIP_ModeDoorIntLi_P [kibes ref: G_77_2_PARA_Einstiegbeleuchtung] is KSW parameter.
There shall exist a parameter DoorIEntrancellluminationMode_P [kibes ref: G_77_2_PARA_Einstiegbeleuchtung] which allows to choose in which one of the following cases DoorIEntrancellluminationControl shall be ALLOWED: "0. Parking lights are ON AND (it has been less than 10min since engine was turned OFF AND it was not turned ON NOR was the key introduced to first position since) 10. Key is in 2nd positon OR Parking lights are ON "

text: Ambient lighting shall be activated or deactivated by turn on/off ambient light switch on FAP.
en: Ambient lighting shall be activated or deactivated by turn on/off ambient light switch on FAP.

text:
If ambient lighting is turned on, it should work 1 hour after the ignition (radio) or waiting mode is switched off .After this time ambient light should be automatically switched off.
The ambient light shall be switched off automatically before 1 hour, if any of following conditions is true:
-the vehicle has been closed by an external driver button,
-the ignition has been switched on again-normal interior lighting has been turned on.
en:
If ambient lighting is turned on, it should work 1 hour after the ignition (radio) or waiting mode is switched off .After this time ambient light should be automatically switched off.
The ambient light shall be switched off automatically before 1 hour, if any of following conditions is true:
-the vehicle has been closed by an external driver button,
-the ignition has been switched on again-normal interior lighting has been turned on.

text: If there is no ambient light button build in, the ambient lighting is activated by a normal interior lighting button.
en: If there is no ambient light button build in, the ambient lighting is activated by a normal interior lighting button.

text:
This requirement is KSW
There must be option to invert PWM signal that controls ambient light, because various types of ambient light modules are installed. Invertion shall be active when invertion parameter is active - 174694(AmbientLightInvertionPWM).
en:
This requirement is KSW
There must be option to invert PWM signal that controls ambient light, because various types of ambient light modules are installed. Invertion shall be active when invertion parameter is active - 174694(AmbientLightInvertionPWM).

text: If ambient lighting is turned on, button led should be on. When function isn't active button led should be off.
en: If ambient lighting is turned on, button led should be on. When function isn't active button led should be off.

text:
This requirement is KSW.
There is automatic color change mode activated when exhibition mode 154168 is active. Automatic color change mode can be enabled without exhibition mode, by pressing ambient lighting button for 5 seconds. In the automatic color change mode, the ambient light colors shall automatically change once a minute.
en:
This requirement is KSW.
There is automatic color change mode activated when exhibition mode 154168 is active. Automatic color change mode can be enabled without exhibition mode, by pressing ambient lighting button for 5 seconds. In the automatic color change mode, the ambient light colors shall automatically change once a minute.

text:
This requirement is KSW.
Information about the ambient lighting status must be stored in the eeprom memory. This is required to restore the ambient lighting settings when the system is turned off. (lighting colour and switch on/off.) If automatic color change mode was enabled, in eeprom shall be saved last color before auto mode. (In automatic mode, the colors change automatically, so the last color selected by the user should be stored in the memory.)
en:
This requirement is KSW.
Information about the ambient lighting status must be stored in the eeprom memory. This is required to restore the ambient lighting settings when the system is turned off. (lighting colour and switch on/off.) If automatic color change mode was enabled, in eeprom shall be saved last color before auto mode. (In automatic mode, the colors change automatically, so the last color selected by the user should be stored in the memory.)

text: There shall be option to change color of lighting by special two-way pushbutton in fire extinguisher box. Pressing this button in one way changes lighting in range of 5 basic colors, pressing in another way changes lighting in range of 35 colors. After turning off, last active color shall be saved in eeprom.
en: There shall be option to change color of lighting by special two-way pushbutton in fire extinguisher box. Pressing this button in one way changes lighting in range of 5 basic colors, pressing in another way changes lighting in range of 35 colors. After turning off, last active color shall be saved in eeprom.

text: The ambient lighting is turned off when the voltage drops below 22.7 V. If user tries to enable ambient light with undervoltage, button led should blink for 3 seconds.
en: The ambient lighting is turned off when the voltage drops below 22.7 V. If user tries to enable ambient light with undervoltage, button led should blink for 3 seconds.

text: Passenger should be able to switch on/off light, if there is permission to do that.
en: Passenger should be able to switch on/off light, if there is permission to do that.

text: Permission to control lights by passengers is enabled if: (at least one of following is true) -key position is radio, and driver enables permission by permission button, -key position is KL15, and driver enables permission by permission button, -motor is running and driver enables permission by special switch. -motor is running and driver enables his own reading light. -exhibition mode is active.
en: Permission to control lights by passengers is enabled if: (at least one of following is true) -key position is radio, and driver enables permission by permission button, -key position is KL15, and driver enables permission by permission button, -motor is running and driver enables permission by special switch. -motor is running and driver enables his own reading light. -exhibition mode is active.

text: If reading-lights permission button on FAP can be highlighted, it shall be highlighted by green color when reading lights permission is active.
en: If reading-lights permission button on FAP can be highlighted, it shall be highlighted by green color when reading lights permission is active.

text: If ignition (KL50) changes state from off to on (raising edge), permission for reading lights shall be turned off. Driver can enable permission again by permission button. After reactivation, lightening points that was active before, shall be active again.
en: If ignition (KL50) changes state from off to on (raising edge), permission for reading lights shall be turned off. Driver can enable permission again by permission button. After reactivation, lightening points that was active before, shall be active again.

text: If KL15 isn't active and passenger door is open, all of lighting points shall be activated automatically.
en: If KL15 isn't active and passenger door is open, all of lighting points shall be activated automatically.

text: Driver shall be able to turn on all of the lighting points, by pressing special button/switch.
en: Driver shall be able to turn on all of the lighting points, by pressing special button/switch.

text: Permission for hostess request shall be active when driver activates it by permission button on FAP, or staff member activates it by permission button.
en: Permission for hostess request shall be active when driver activates it by permission button on FAP, or staff member activates it by permission button.

text: The reading lighting shall be switched on when the cleaning lighting is active, or when the interior lighting is dimmed to its maximum brightness.
en: The reading lighting shall be switched on when the cleaning lighting is active, or when the interior lighting is dimmed to its maximum brightness.

text: If undervoltage is detected, reading lights must be turned off. If reading-lights permission button on FAP can be highlighted, it shall be highlighted by red color. If the voltage returns to normal level, the lights can switch on after 1 second delay.
en: If undervoltage is detected, reading lights must be turned off. If reading-lights permission button on FAP can be highlighted, it shall be highlighted by red color. If the voltage returns to normal level, the lights can switch on after 1 second delay.

text: In exhibition mode, the permission to control the lights by corresponding switches shall be active.
en: In exhibition mode, the permission to control the lights by corresponding switches shall be active.

text: The system shall be disabled when ignition radio is active.
en: The system shall be disabled when ignition radio is active.

text: When the ignition clamp radio is turn off and press the button, the system shall be active for 30 min. After that, light shall automatically turn off.
en: When the ignition clamp radio is turn off and press the button, the system shall be active for 30 min. After that, light shall automatically turn off.

text:
Auto mode (30 min):
After the cleaning lighting is activate by pressing the button,it shall automatically begin to turn off at the 28th minute. It shall be dimmed to 50% of power for 2 minutes and then turn off completely.
en:
Auto mode (30 min):
After the cleaning lighting is activate by pressing the button,it shall automatically begin to turn off at the 28th minute. It shall be dimmed to 50% of power for 2 minutes and then turn off completely.

text:
Cleaning lighting includes that:
-Interior lighting
-Driver workplace lighting
-Cash register lighting
-Ticket validators powering-up.
en:
Cleaning lighting includes that:
-Interior lighting
-Driver workplace lighting
-Cash register lighting
-Ticket validators powering-up.

text: When the vehicle shall be undervoltage status, Cleaning lighting button should be blink for 90s. The blink status shall be 6 (200/200) and button led color shall be yellow.
en: When the vehicle shall be undervoltage status, Cleaning lighting button should be blink for 90s. The blink status shall be 6 (200/200) and button led color shall be yellow.

text:
The system shall provide possibility open the lightings if all below conditions are fulfillled;
-Ignition clamp 15 shall be active.
-Parking light shall be open.
-Doors shall be open or released.
If the parking light is deactivated, the system shall be turned off.

The system shall provide possibility open the lightings if all below conditions are fulfillled;
-Ignition clamp 15 shall be active.
-Parking light shall be open.
-Doors shall be open or released.
If the parking light is deactivated, the system shall be turned off.

-Parameters LIP_StDoorExtLiPrkgLiDoorOpen_P=0 and LIP_StDoorExtLiByDoorOpen_P=0 are not defined and LIP_StDoorExtLibySwtNoPosLi_P is set and related door is not closed.

-Parameters LIP_StDoorExtLiPrkgLiDoorOpen_P=0 and LIP_StDoorExtLiByDoorOpen_P=0 are not defined and LIP_StDoorExtLibySwtNoPosLi_P is set and related door is not closed.

en:
CANCELLED

text:
When standing lights are active, and reverse gear is set, and at least one door is open or released, all of the external entrance lights shall be turn on. Lights shall be turned off when bus speed reach 3kmh (in forward direction). If parameter 161196 is active, 3kmh should be switched to 5kmh. If standing lights are switched off during the work of the entrance exterior lighting, this lighting shall also be switched off.

en: When standing lights are active, and reverse gear is set, and at least one door is open or released, all of the external entrance lights shall be turn on. Lights shall be turned off when bus speed reach 3kmh (in forward direction). If parameter 161196 is active, 3kmh should be switched to 5kmh. If standing lights are switched off during the work of the entrance exterior lighting, this lighting shall also be switched off.

EDL shall activate driver switch LED blink in yellow color, None of the five doors' external lights are active and "LIP_StDoorExtLiOffByV_P" is defined as 1 and bus reach speed is greater than 5 kmh (or if "LIP_StDoorExtLiOffByV_P" is defined as 0 and bus reach speed is less than 3 kmh) and driver switch and parking light is active.

EDL shall activate driver switch LED blink in yellow color, None of the five doors' external lights are active and "LIP_StDoorExtLiOffByV_P" is defined as 1 and bus reach speed is greater than 5 kmh (or if "LIP_StDoorExtLiOffByV_P" is defined as 0 and bus reach speed is less than 3 kmh) and driver switch and parking light is active.

text: In exhibition mode all the system is active. Button shall don't blink. Button LED shall be lighting constantly in yellow.
en: In exhibition mode all the system is active. Button shall don't blink. Button LED shall be lighting constantly in yellow.

3 minute (Hold Up)

Lighting shall provide the possibility to closed during 3 mins(timer hold up) the lighting corresponding one of the conditions are fulfilled:

3 minute (Hold Up)
If the ignition clamp radio is turn off , driver area and payment light shall worked during 3 mins.
Lighting shall provide the possibility to closed during 3 mins(timer hold up) the lighting corresponding one of the conditions are fulfilled:

-Ignition clamp radio is on.

en: CANCELLED

Turn off Driver area light with speed condition:
When the vehicle speed is above 5km/h ,the system shall be deactivated automatically.

Turn off Driver area light with speed condition:
When the vehicle speed is above 5km/h ,the system shall be deactivated automatically.

en: CANCELLED

text: When the cleaning lighting is switched on, the driver's lighting and payment place lighting shall be turned on.
en: When the cleaning lighting is switched on, the driver's lighting and payment place lighting shall be turned on.
