3 minute (Hold Up)
If 3 min. hold up is activated, button led shall be blink (Led value is 5).
en:
3 minute (Hold Up)
If 3 min. hold up is activated, button led shall be blink (Led value is 5).

text: When the ignition clamp radio is turned off while system is active ,the last status of the system shall be kept in memory(EEPROM).
en: When the ignition clamp radio is turned off while system is active ,the last status of the system shall be kept in memory(EEPROM).

text: If the press the driver area button or hostess button and under voltage status active , driver area and hostess button led shall be blink (LED value is shalll be 3).
en: If the press the driver area button or hostess button and under voltage status active , driver area and hostess button led shall be blink (LED value is shalll be 3).

text:
When the exhibition mode is activated, the system shall automatically activated,
When exhibition mode is deactivated, the system shall automatically deactivated,
en:
When the exhibition mode is activated, the system shall automatically activated,
When exhibition mode is deactivated, the system shall automatically deactivated,

text: Automatic mode is the system which opens the door automatically after passenger door opening buttons pressed (Even the corresponding door is moving) when the door release is active. Automatic mode doors hold open time may be changed by parameter (default 3 sec.).
en: Automatic mode is the system which opens the door automatically after passenger door opening buttons pressed (Even the corresponding door is moving) when the door release is active. Automatic mode doors hold open time may be changed by parameter (default 3 sec.).

text: Automatic mode of a door shall be selected by a switch in the workshop area over the door.
en: Automatic mode of a door shall be selected by a switch in the workshop area over the door.

text:
The system shall send the opening request for the automatic door, if all the below conditions are fulfilled:
- Ignition clamp 15 or waiting room mode (Wartesaal) mode is active (GW_StClmp15On =1 or DWR_StWaroAcv=1)
- Doors power supply is active (DPS_StDoorsPwrSpply=1)
- Door release or waiting room mode is enabled (DR_StDoorRelsActvForDoor1=1,DR_StDoorRelsActvForDoor2=1,DR_StDoorRelsActvForDoor3=1,DR_StDoorRelsActvForDoor4=1 for corresponding door or DWR_StWaroAcv=1)
- Exhibition mode is not active (GW_ModeExbnOn=0)
- Night mode button is not active (DBF_StOutdBtnDeac=0)
- The vehicle speed is less than 1 km/h (GW_SpdLess1On=1)
- The corresponding automatic mode door is in closed or closing status (BBC_StDoor1Wngfr =1/3 ,BBC_StDoor1Wngre =1/3, BBC_StDoor2 =1/3, BBC_StDoor3 =1/3, BBC_StDoor4 =1/3 for corresponding door)
- No opening blockade is active for the corresponding door (D1B_StDoorOpngBlkgReq=0, D2B_StDoorOpngBlkgReq=0, D3B_StDoorOpngBlkgReq =0, D4B_StDoorOpngBlkgReq =0 for corresponding door)
- One of the opening buttons or special buttons in the area of corresponding automatic mode door is pressed (DXPB_StDoorXExtPrmBtn, DXPB_StDoorXIntPrmBtn, DXW_StDoorXIntWhlchrBtn, DXW_StDoorXExtWhlchrBtn, DXSR_StBtnIntDoorX, DXSR_StBtnExtDoorX, DOM_StDoorXOldMBtn for corresponding door)
en:
The system shall send the opening request for the automatic door, if all the below conditions are fulfilled:
- Ignition clamp 15 or waiting room mode (Wartesaal) mode is active (GW_StClmp15On =1 or DWR_StWaroAcv=1)
- Doors power supply is active (DPS_StDoorsPwrSpply=1)
- Door release or waiting room mode is enabled (DR_StDoorRelsActvForDoor1=1,DR_StDoorRelsActvForDoor2=1,DR_StDoorRelsActvForDoor3=1,DR_StDoorRelsActvForDoor4=1 for corresponding door or DWR_StWaroAcv=1)
- Exhibition mode is not active (GW_ModeExbnOn=0)
- Night mode button is not active (DBF_StOutdBtnDeac=0)
- The vehicle speed is less than 1 km/h (GW_SpdLess1On=1)
- The corresponding automatic mode door is in closed or closing status (BBC_StDoor1Wngfr =1/3 ,BBC_StDoor1Wngre =1/3, BBC_StDoor2 =1/3, BBC_StDoor3 =1/3, BBC_StDoor4 =1/3 for corresponding door)
- No opening blockade is active for the corresponding door (D1B_StDoorOpngBlkgReq=0, D2B_StDoorOpngBlkgReq=0, D3B_StDoorOpngBlkgReq =0, D4B_StDoorOpngBlkgReq =0 for corresponding door)
- One of the opening buttons or special buttons in the area of corresponding automatic mode door is pressed (DXPB_StDoorXExtPrmBtn, DXPB_StDoorXIntPrmBtn, DXW_StDoorXIntWhlchrBtn, DXW_StDoorXExtWhlchrBtn, DXSR_StBtnIntDoorX, DXSR_StBtnExtDoorX, DOM_StDoorXOldMBtn for corresponding door)

text:
The system shall work with the manual driver buttons as below :
- Only first door shall be able to open by the driver manual buttons
- The rest of the doors shall not be able to be controlled by driver manual buttons by default
en:
The system shall work with the manual driver buttons as below :
- Only first door shall be able to open by the driver manual buttons
- The rest of the doors shall not be able to be controlled by driver manual buttons by default

text: While the automatic mode door is closing, if the light barrier has detection then the door shall be opened automatically.
en: While the automatic mode door is closing, if the light barrier has detection then the door shall be opened automatically.

text:
The system shall send the closing request automatically after defined time ends, if all the below conditions are fulfilled;
- Door is opened in automatic mode
- Light barrier/Safety edge detection is not active
- Manual ramp is in closed status (if exists)
- The door is not in emergency or powerless mode
en:
The system shall send the closing request automatically after defined time ends, if all the below conditions are fulfilled;
- Door is opened in automatic mode
- Light barrier/Safety edge detection is not active
- Manual ramp is in closed status (if exists)
- The door is not in emergency or powerless mode

text: The standard hold open time is 3 seconds. If one of the detection of light barrier or safety edge is active, the time shall be restarted.
en: The standard hold open time is 3 seconds. If one of the detection of light barrier or safety edge is active, the time shall be restarted.

text: The buzzer shall be able to have continuous ( only for KSW cases) and intermittent ( both series and KSW cases) sound functionallity.
en: The buzzer shall be able to have continuous ( only for KSW cases) and intermittent ( both series and KSW cases) sound functionallity.

text: Door Release function shall provide automatic control for the doors in auto mode, by the button on driver dashboard.
en: Door Release function shall provide automatic control for the doors in auto mode, by the button on driver dashboard.

text: When the waiting room function is activated then the door release function shall automatically be active independent from the door release button. In this case the parking brake shall be engaged.
en: When the waiting room function is activated then the door release function shall automatically be active independent from the door release button. In this case the parking brake shall be engaged.

text: The system shall not be enabled with emergency release of bus stop brake, if the parking brake is not active.
en: The system shall not be enabled with emergency release of bus stop brake, if the parking brake is not active.

text:
The system shall evaluate the individual door statuses. The possible states :
- Door X Unknown
- Door X Closed
- Door X Open
- Door X Closing
- Door X Opening
- Door X Powerless
- Door X Not Installed
- Door X Emergency
- Door X Error
- Door X Local Mode
- Door X Reversing
en:
The system shall evaluate the individual door statuses. The possible states :
- Door X Unknown
- Door X Closed
- Door X Open
- Door X Closing
- Door X Opening
- Door X Powerless
- Door X Not Installed
- Door X Emergency
- Door X Error
- Door X Local Mode
- Door X Reversing

text:
It shall be possible to evaluate the door statuses below for the systems which need:
- At least one door is open
- All doors are open
- All doors are closed
- Last door is closing
en:
It shall be possible to evaluate the door statuses below for the systems which need:
- At least one door is open
- All doors are open
- All doors are closed
- Last door is closing

text: This system is designed to collect all of the external signals and internal signals and distribute them to bus door center ECU.
en: This system is designed to collect all of the external signals and internal signals and distribute them to bus door center ECU.

text: The system shall have possibility to send the blocking request for all the doors in the vehicle separately for opening/closing blocking.
en: The system shall have possibility to send the blocking request for all the doors in the vehicle separately for opening/closing blocking.

text: If the door opening of door is a blocked by an open flap, this must be indicated to the driver.
en: If the door opening of door is a blocked by an open flap, this must be indicated to the driver.

text: There shall be a possibility to request blockade with/without information for the driver. Information shall be indicated as visual graphic in the bus stop display menu.
en: There shall be a possibility to request blockade with/without information for the driver. Information shall be indicated as visual graphic in the bus stop display menu.

text: Representation the blocking states to the driver shall be shown for each door seperately. Only for the first door, each wings' states shall be shown seperately.
en: Representation the blocking states to the driver shall be shown for each door seperately. Only for the first door, each wings' states shall be shown seperately.

text: Bus stop brake (HSB) is one of the brake type which allows the system to open the door.
en: Bus stop brake (HSB) is one of the brake type which allows the system to open the door.

text:
Bus stop brake (HSB) request shall be active if any of the below conditions are satisfied
-Door 1 front wing is installed and not closed and door 1 bus stop break disable parameter is not activated in the vehicle.
-Door 1 rear wing is installed and not closed and door 1 bus stop break disable parameter is not activated in the vehicle.
-Door 2 is installed and not closed
-Door 3 is installed and not closed
-Door 4 is installed and not closed
-When the vehicle is stationary, any door is in emergency mode but not in local mode
-Any driver manual door button is pressed within the last 1 second when the vehicle is stationary
-Manual Ramp stop break signal is active
-Lift stop break signal is active
-Electric Ramp stop break signal is active
-When door release function is activated.
-Driver door is open. (KSW)
en:
Bus stop brake (HSB) request shall be active if any of the below conditions are satisfied
-Door 1 front wing is installed and not closed and door 1 bus stop break disable parameter is not activated in the vehicle.
-Door 1 rear wing is installed and not closed and door 1 bus stop break disable parameter is not activated in the vehicle.
-Door 2 is installed and not closed
-Door 3 is installed and not closed
-Door 4 is installed and not closed
-When the vehicle is stationary, any door is in emergency mode but not in local mode
-Any driver manual door button is pressed within the last 1 second when the vehicle is stationary
-Manual Ramp stop break signal is active
-Lift stop break signal is active
-Electric Ramp stop break signal is active
-When door release function is activated.
-Driver door is open. (KSW)

text: Heating system shall have only one area of arrangements in solo bus and two separate areas in articulation bus. The system could work on the two different level, which effect on heating power and blower power.
en: Heating system shall have only one area of arrangements in solo bus and two separate areas in articulation bus. The system could work on the two different level, which effect on heating power and blower power.

text:
Demand 1st heating step should be possible, when few additional conditions shall be fulfilled:
- Request from Bader shall be active. 1st heating step shall be upheld 1 second after disappearance of request.
- Fire alert is inactive
en:
Demand 1st heating step should be possible, when few additional conditions shall be fulfilled:
- Request from Bader shall be active. 1st heating step shall be upheld 1 second after disappearance of request.
- Fire alert is inactive

text: As an option 1st heating step should be inhibited when system could be work on the Eco mode without ventilation and engine is running (P).
en: As an option 1st heating step should be inhibited when system could be work on the Eco mode without ventilation and engine is running (P).

text:
If all of the following preconditions linked below are fulfilled, the system shall provide the user with the ability to activate 2nd heating step:
- Request from Bader shall be active. 2nd heating step shall be upheld 1 second after disappearance of request.
- Fire alert is inactive
- reduction of the internal heaters power not active;
en:
If all of the following preconditions linked below are fulfilled, the system shall provide the user with the ability to activate 2nd heating step:
- Request from Bader shall be active. 2nd heating step shall be upheld 1 second after disappearance of request.
- Fire alert is inactive
- reduction of the internal heaters power not active;

text: As an option 2nd step should be also available by the KL15 ignition position, when engine is not working. For that functionality based on special Customer requirements should be prepared additional condition (KSW requirement).
en: As an option 2nd step should be also available by the KL15 ignition position, when engine is not working. For that functionality based on special Customer requirements should be prepared additional condition (KSW requirement).

text: In the articulated buses shall provide separate steering of the heating inside the articulation. Based on information comes from ATC controller steering outputs should be activated.
en: In the articulated buses shall provide separate steering of the heating inside the articulation. Based on information comes from ATC controller steering outputs should be activated.

text: If an additional heating system is installed, the system shall provide the driver with the ability to control it independently of the other heating systems.
en: If an additional heating system is installed, the system shall provide the driver with the ability to control it independently of the other heating systems.

text: The heating system, which are steering by the automatic temperature controller provide whom with the ability to control the each interior heaters. Based on those signals, internal software should introduce additional protection for each heating area. The system shall able to reduce the power of the heaters or turn off the heaters. In each case at least radio ignition position or waiting room mode shall be active.
en: The heating system, which are steering by the automatic temperature controller provide whom with the ability to control the each interior heaters. Based on those signals, internal software should introduce additional protection for each heating area. The system shall able to reduce the power of the heaters or turn off the heaters. In each case at least radio ignition position or waiting room mode shall be active.

text: Reduction of front heaters power should be possible when KSW about reduction mode by the KL15 ignition position dedicated for front area will be active, ATC controller will send request about reduction and KSW requirement about roof heating reduction with Waiting room mode will be disable and any blocking signal will be not active.
en: Reduction of front heaters power should be possible when KSW about reduction mode by the KL15 ignition position dedicated for front area will be active, ATC controller will send request about reduction and KSW requirement about roof heating reduction with Waiting room mode will be disable and any blocking signal will be not active.

text: Inhibit of front heaters should be possible when KSW requirement about reduction mode by the KL15 ignition position dedicated for front area will be active, ATC controller will send to off request and any blocking signal will be not active;
en: Inhibit of front heaters should be possible when KSW requirement about reduction mode by the KL15 ignition position dedicated for front area will be active, ATC controller will send to off request and any blocking signal will be not active;

text: Reduction of roof heating power in passengers area ¿ should be possible when KSW requirement about reduction mode by the KL15 ignition position dedicated for roof heating will be active, any blocking signal will be not active, ATC controller will send request about reduction or KSW requirement about reduction in Waiting room mode should be enabled,
en: Reduction of roof heating power in passengers area ¿ should be possible when KSW requirement about reduction mode by the KL15 ignition position dedicated for roof heating will be active, any blocking signal will be not active, ATC controller will send request about reduction or KSW requirement about reduction in Waiting room mode should be enabled,

text: Inhibit of roof heating power in passengers area ¿ should be possible when KSW requirement about reduction mode by the KL15 ignition position dedicated for roof heating will be active, any blocking signal will be not active, ATC controller will send to off request or KSW requirement about reduction in Waiting room mode should be enabled;
en: Inhibit of roof heating power in passengers area ¿ should be possible when KSW requirement about reduction mode by the KL15 ignition position dedicated for roof heating will be active, any blocking signal will be not active, ATC controller will send to off request or KSW requirement about reduction in Waiting room mode should be enabled;

text: Interior heaters should provide the user with the ability to activation when ignition is off (P)(KSW requirement).
en: Interior heaters should provide the user with the ability to activation when ignition is off (P)(KSW requirement).

text: The system could be also controlled by the external signal, i.e: from an additional Customer socket (CEJN or Mennekes), which include trigger for heater flame (P)(KSW requirement).
en: The system could be also controlled by the external signal, i.e: from an additional Customer socket (CEJN or Mennekes), which include trigger for heater flame (P)(KSW requirement).

text: The system shall provide all signals for external temperature controller based on CAN Matrix documentation, i.e.: Coolant liquid temperature, exterior temperature, ignition signal and engine is working, smog mode activation. Sending of CAN bus signals to the controller shall be protected by the proper message state of CAN frame received from ATC.
en: The system shall provide all signals for external temperature controller based on CAN Matrix documentation, i.e.: Coolant liquid temperature, exterior temperature, ignition signal and engine is working, smog mode activation. Sending of CAN bus signals to the controller shall be protected by the proper message state of CAN frame received from ATC.

text: As an option the system should be activated 2 minutes after start engine when 1st step of the heating will be activation by temperature condition outside temperature is above 22 dg C (KSW requirement).(p)
en: As an option the system should be activated 2 minutes after start engine when 1st step of the heating will be activation by temperature condition outside temperature is above 22 dg C (KSW requirement).(p)

text: As an option the system shall provide whom with the ability to enable outlet mode of the roof fans two minutes before compressor works (KSW requirement). When clutch compressor will be running, outlet and inlet of the roof fans should be inhibited.
en: As an option the system shall provide whom with the ability to enable outlet mode of the roof fans two minutes before compressor works (KSW requirement). When clutch compressor will be running, outlet and inlet of the roof fans should be inhibited.

text: The system will provide also possibility roof fans enable in the outlet mode, when clutch compressor will be start. Fans should be working with clutch compressor in this case (KSW requirement).
en: The system will provide also possibility roof fans enable in the outlet mode, when clutch compressor will be start. Fans should be working with clutch compressor in this case (KSW requirement).

en: The automatic heating system shall provide possibility to the driver inform about failure. Failure message should be displayed on the dashboard like a text message and warning lamp.

text: The system should give information about failure in the two situations: - during proper works of clutch compressor when the pressure of the compressors loop is wrong, driver air condition will be inhibited or air conditioning controller will be inhibited.
en: The system should give information about failure in the two situations: - during proper works of clutch compressor when the pressure of the compressors loop is wrong, driver air condition will be inhibited or air conditioning controller will be inhibited.

text: Compressor coupling shall be closed (connected) when main air conditioning request is given by automatic temperature control function. That functions also determine when to disable connection.
en: Compressor coupling shall be closed (connected) when main air conditioning request is given by automatic temperature control function. That functions also determine when to disable connection.

text: When ignition is kl15 longer than 3 seconds, and parking brake is on, and engine is running, the compressor speed should be maintained at a higher speed than normal to allow the compressor to operate.
en: When ignition is kl15 longer than 3 seconds, and parking brake is on, and engine is running, the compressor speed should be maintained at a higher speed than normal to allow the compressor to operate.

text: The essential preconditions to enable ¿Circulation pump¿ are: *. Circulation pump is installed *. installed Webasto and Thermograph are not installed.
en: The essential preconditions to enable ¿Circulation pump¿ are: *. Circulation pump is installed *. installed Webasto and Thermograph are not installed.

text: ¿Auxiliary heating - Circulation pump¿ shall be enabled when at least one of the conditions below is met: *. roof heating is active *. space heating is active *. front heating is active *. automatic temperature control is set in ¿pump¿ *. the ¿KL50¿ state is active. In additional, there shall be met one of the conditions below: *. The waiting room is active *. If there is not undervoltage or the bus engine is not active and it is not simulation, the ¿Auxiliary heating ¿ Circulation pump¿ shall be enabled for 10 minutes.
en: ¿Auxiliary heating - Circulation pump¿ shall be enabled when at least one of the conditions below is met: *. roof heating is active *. space heating is active *. front heating is active *. automatic temperature control is set in ¿pump¿ *. the ¿KL50¿ state is active. In additional, there shall be met one of the conditions below: *. The waiting room is active *. If there is not undervoltage or the bus engine is not active and it is not simulation, the ¿Auxiliary heating ¿ Circulation pump¿ shall be enabled for 10 minutes.

text: The system shall provide a possibility to enable ¿Auxiliary heating ¿ Circulation pump¿ with supporting protocol version 1.09 by system. (P)
en: The system shall provide a possibility to enable ¿Auxiliary heating ¿ Circulation pump¿ with supporting protocol version 1.09 by system. (P)

text: The system shall provide a possibility to enable ¿Auxiliary heating ¿ Circulation pump hold out¿ which is halting the circulation pump. One of the conditions below shall be met: *. There is not undervoltage *. Motor is not active and it is not simulation The function will be enabled after 10 minutes. The system shall support the protocol version 1.09. (P)
en: The system shall provide a possibility to enable ¿Auxiliary heating ¿ Circulation pump hold out¿ which is halting the circulation pump. One of the conditions below shall be met: *. There is not undervoltage *. Motor is not active and it is not simulation The function will be enabled after 10 minutes. The system shall support the protocol version 1.09. (P)

text: If circulation pump is active and the bus enigne is active and undervoltage occurs and as soon as one of the conditions is met: *. roof heating is active *. space heating is active *. front heating is active *. automatic temperature control is set in ¿pump¿ *. the bus is started by ignition in ¿KL50¿ state. And in the system, there is undervoltage and the bus engine is active or it is simulation, the ¿Auxiliary heating ¿ Circulation pump¿ will be disable after 10 minutes.
en: If circulation pump is active and the bus enigne is active and undervoltage occurs and as soon as one of the conditions is met: *. roof heating is active *. space heating is active *. front heating is active *. automatic temperature control is set in ¿pump¿ *. the bus is started by ignition in ¿KL50¿ state. And in the system, there is undervoltage and the bus engine is active or it is simulation, the ¿Auxiliary heating ¿ Circulation pump¿ will be disable after 10 minutes.

text: When there is no switch or button installed in the bus (Parameter 164509 is off ) air condition power is controlled automatically. Device shall be turned on when engine is turned on.
en: When there is no switch or button installed in the bus (Parameter 164509 is off ) air condition power is controlled automatically. Device shall be turned on when engine is turned on.

text: When there is switch installed in the bus, (Parameter 164509 is on) air condition power shall be turned on one second after: If Parameter 164511 is off -- switch was turned on If Parameter 164511 is on -- switch was turned on and engine is running If Parameter 164513 is active, air conditioning starts working automatically with motor, and manual switches can be used to turn it off.
en: When there is switch installed in the bus, (Parameter 164509 is on) air condition power shall be turned on one second after: If Parameter 164511 is off -- switch was turned on If Parameter 164511 is on -- switch was turned on and engine is running If Parameter 164513 is active, air conditioning starts working automatically with motor, and manual switches can be used to turn it off.

text: If switch can be highlighted, it shall be highlighted when air conditioning works. When parameter 164517 is active switch shall be highlighted when air conditioning is turned off, not when works. If there is RGB highlight possibility, switch should be highlighted with blinking in red color when an error occurs.
en: If switch can be highlighted, it shall be highlighted when air conditioning works. When parameter 164517 is active switch shall be highlighted when air conditioning is turned off, not when works. If there is RGB highlight possibility, switch should be highlighted with blinking in red color when an error occurs.

text: In both modes: auto and manual with switch, air conditioning can be turned on only when ignition is at least in radio position.
en: In both modes: auto and manual with switch, air conditioning can be turned on only when ignition is at least in radio position.

text:
Driver Place Air Conditioning shall be enabled if all the following conditions are met:
- Engine is active.
- Fire alarm is inactive.
- Pressure valve does not detect any error/failures.
and if any of the following conditions are met:
- Driver Place Air Conditioning is requested by automatic temperature control function.
- Main compressor is requested by automatic temperature control function.
en:
Driver Place Air Conditioning shall be enabled if all the following conditions are met:
- Engine is active.
- Fire alarm is inactive.
- Pressure valve does not detect any error/failures.
and if any of the following conditions are met:
- Driver Place Air Conditioning is requested by automatic temperature control function.
- Main compressor is requested by automatic temperature control function.

text: If the proximity sensor detected the connection of power supply for hot water circuit, it sends a signal informing about that to the system and enables turning on the electric heater.
en: If the proximity sensor detected the connection of power supply for hot water circuit, it sends a signal informing about that to the system and enables turning on the electric heater.

text: Detected connection of power supply for hot water circuit by proximity sensor blocks a bus startup.
en: Detected connection of power supply for hot water circuit by proximity sensor blocks a bus startup.

text: The system shall provide a possibility to enable heating by external hot water circuit only if the temperature inside is below 16 ¿. (P)
en: The system shall provide a possibility to enable heating by external hot water circuit only if the temperature inside is below 16 ¿. (P)

text: The inside temperature sensor works properly if the system got information about external system connection and the ignition was not in ¿radio¿ state.
en: The inside temperature sensor works properly if the system got information about external system connection and the ignition was not in ¿radio¿ state.

text: If the system detected the connection of ELDI external system, it sends enables to turn on the electric heater if the ignition was not in ¿radio¿ state and the battery charger was not installed.
en: If the system detected the connection of ELDI external system, it sends enables to turn on the electric heater if the ignition was not in ¿radio¿ state and the battery charger was not installed.

text: Detected connection of ELDI external system blocks a bus startup.
en: Detected connection of ELDI external system blocks a bus startup.

text: The system shall provide user a possibility to enable to turn on electric heater if the battery charger was installed. (P)
en: The system shall provide user a possibility to enable to turn on electric heater if the battery charger was installed. (P)

text: The external remote of heating by Automatic Temperature Controller is enabled if the system enables to turn on electric heater.
en: The external remote of heating by Automatic Temperature Controller is enabled if the system enables to turn on electric heater.

text: The system shall enable the signal of power supply of the door system.
en: The system shall enable the signal of power supply of the door system.

text: The door power supply signal DPS_StDoorsPwrSpply shall remain active as long as the ECU (EIOB24) has the power signal* on the physical wake up pin (3.Socket/27.Pin).
en: The door power supply signal DPS_StDoorsPwrSpply shall remain active as long as the ECU (EIOB24) has the power signal* on the physical wake up pin (3.Socket/27.Pin).

text:
The system should have possibility to reset the door power supply for resetting the door controller by the buttons on the dashboard if all of the conditions below are fulfilled:
- Parking brake shall be applied.
- The button of driver window heater and first door manual control button shall be kept pressed by 10 second.
en:
The system should have possibility to reset the door power supply for resetting the door controller by the buttons on the dashboard if all of the conditions below are fulfilled:
- Parking brake shall be applied.
- The button of driver window heater and first door manual control button shall be kept pressed by 10 second.

text: The system shall be active independent of ignition state.
en: The system shall be active independent of ignition state.

text: The system should contain the preparation for the delay of creating the external driver door button impulse for KSW cases. Additionally, the system should contain the preperation for deactivating the external driver door button for KSW cases.
en: The system should contain the preparation for the delay of creating the external driver door button impulse for KSW cases. Additionally, the system should contain the preperation for deactivating the external driver door button for KSW cases.

text: The system shall create the request of opening/closing if the external door button is pressed for 10 seconds in exhibition mode.
en: The system shall create the request of opening/closing if the external door button is pressed for 10 seconds in exhibition mode.

text: Door emergency valve reactivation is a function that resets emergency valve (air valve) after emergency opening the doors by emergency knob (emergency button) or less air in the pneumatic system. This is needed to restore door operation after an emergency opening (refill the emergency valve).
en: Door emergency valve reactivation is a function that resets emergency valve (air valve) after emergency opening the doors by emergency knob (emergency button) or less air in the pneumatic system. This is needed to restore door operation after an emergency opening (refill the emergency valve).

text:
Driver door buttons are used for manual door control. The system shall always provide the possibility to control the doors by the button for:
- Manual Mode
- Half-automatic Mode
- Automatic Mode (If forced closing is available)
en:
Driver door buttons are used for manual door control. The system shall always provide the possibility to control the doors by the button for:
- Manual Mode
- Half-automatic Mode
- Automatic Mode (If forced closing is available)

text:
The system shall provide the possibility to open the corresponding doors by driver button if all below conditions are fulfilled:
- Ignition level shall be minimum clamp radio or preconditioning function is active or cleaning service is active.
- Bus speed shall be below 1 km/h.
- Corresponding door is not in local mode.
- Corresponding door is not in powerless mode.
- Corresponding door is in closed or closing position.
en:
The system shall provide the possibility to open the corresponding doors by driver button if all below conditions are fulfilled:
- Ignition level shall be minimum clamp radio or preconditioning function is active or cleaning service is active.
- Bus speed shall be below 1 km/h.
- Corresponding door is not in local mode.
- Corresponding door is not in powerless mode.
- Corresponding door is in closed or closing position.

text: The system shall also provide the user the possibility to use driver door button for forced closing.
en: The system shall also provide the user the possibility to use driver door button for forced closing.

text: Forced closing is the closing type by suppressing the light barrier detection on the corresponding door. In order to perform forced closing, the user shall press the corresponding driver door button for more than 2 second.
en: Forced closing is the closing type by suppressing the light barrier detection on the corresponding door. In order to perform forced closing, the user shall press the corresponding driver door button for more than 2 second.

text: Half-automatic door mode is included in 'doors manual' part of software as it uses the same signals to control the doors.
en: Half-automatic door mode is included in 'doors manual' part of software as it uses the same signals to control the doors.

text:
The difference between automatic and half-automatic mode is ;
If a door is opened automatically by the passenger stop buttons, at automatic mode the closing starts automatically after defined time (default 3 seconds) while at half-automatic mode the doors stay opened till they are closed manually by the driver.
en:
The difference between automatic and half-automatic mode is ;
If a door is opened automatically by the passenger stop buttons, at automatic mode the closing starts automatically after defined time (default 3 seconds) while at half-automatic mode the doors stay opened till they are closed manually by the driver.

text: Corresponding driver button shall be blocked for closing if opening blocking signal by manual ramp is activated.
en: Corresponding driver button shall be blocked for closing if opening blocking signal by manual ramp is activated.

text:
Driver door buttons are used for manual door control. This requirement describes 1st door control possibilites. The principle is similar to other door control of 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th but there are some differences as the first door has seperate wing control possibility.
The system shall always provide the possibility to control the doors by the buttons for;
- Manual mode
- Half-automatic mode
- Automatic mode
en:
Driver door buttons are used for manual door control. This requirement describes 1st door control possibilites. The principle is similar to other door control of 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th but there are some differences as the first door has seperate wing control possibility.
The system shall always provide the possibility to control the doors by the buttons for;
- Manual mode
- Half-automatic mode
- Automatic mode

text: If the system is equipped with one button for both wings control, door wings shall be controlled together. If the system is equipped with two buttons for separete wings control, each button shall control its assigned wing.
en: If the system is equipped with one button for both wings control, door wings shall be controlled together. If the system is equipped with two buttons for separete wings control, each button shall control its assigned wing.

text: The system shall provide a functionality of opening blocking for each wing of door 1 ,optionally*. If the bus is equipped with one, common button for both wings of door 1 control, the system shall be prepared to apply an aditional FAP button for wings blocking.
en: The system shall provide a functionality of opening blocking for each wing of door 1 ,optionally*. If the bus is equipped with one, common button for both wings of door 1 control, the system shall be prepared to apply an aditional FAP button for wings blocking.

text: When the door wings are in different state (one wing of door 1 is closed and the other one is opened/opening), if the wing-blocking button is deactivated , the system shall open the wing which is blocked.
en: When the door wings are in different state (one wing of door 1 is closed and the other one is opened/opening), if the wing-blocking button is deactivated , the system shall open the wing which is blocked.

text: Activation of air flap can be done by driver button, or automatically, for example by smog detection function. Precise description is done in other requirement documents. When recirculation air flap is activated (air closed), roof hatches shall be closed.
en: Activation of air flap can be done by driver button, or automatically, for example by smog detection function. Precise description is done in other requirement documents. When recirculation air flap is activated (air closed), roof hatches shall be closed.

text: Request for closing the recirculating flap is given by the HVAC Aurora function. If request is active this function shall close the flap by 10 second closing signal. When request ends its action, this function shall open the flap by 10 second opening signal. There shall be possibility to change direction during opening/closing action - when user decides to close during opening process or open during closing process.
en: Request for closing the recirculating flap is given by the HVAC Aurora function. If request is active this function shall close the flap by 10 second closing signal. When request ends its action, this function shall open the flap by 10 second opening signal. There shall be possibility to change direction during opening/closing action - when user decides to close during opening process or open during closing process.

text: When KL15 is switched off, system should give 10 second opening signal to flap.
en: When KL15 is switched off, system should give 10 second opening signal to flap.

text: Wheelchair button is a taster-type button located inside/outside the bus. It is used to inform the driver that a disabled person with limited mobility is willing to exit/enter the bus.
en: Wheelchair button is a taster-type button located inside/outside the bus. It is used to inform the driver that a disabled person with limited mobility is willing to exit/enter the bus.

text:
The buttons shall have additional "Simulation mode" functionality if all the conditions below are fulfilled :
- Ignition is in clamp 15 position
- Engine simulation mode is active
en:
The buttons shall have additional "Simulation mode" functionality if all the conditions below are fulfilled :
- Ignition is in clamp 15 position
- Engine simulation mode is active

text:
Pressing internal wheelchair button shall generate an acoustic and optical notification (If door release is not active) if all the below conditions are fulfilled :
- Ignition clamp 15 or waiting room (wartesaal) is active
- The assigned door has no active error
- "Exhibition mode" is not active
- "Simulation mode" is not active
Pressing external wheelchair button shall generate an acoustic and optical notification (If door release is not active) if all the below conditions are fulfilled :
- Ignition clamp 15 or waiting room (wartesaal) is active
- The assigned door has no active error
- "Exhibition mode" is not active
- "Simulation mode" is not active
- If the vehicle speed is less than 1 km/h
en:
Pressing internal wheelchair button shall generate an acoustic and optical notification (If door release is not active) if all the below conditions are fulfilled :
- Ignition clamp 15 or waiting room (wartesaal) is active
- The assigned door has no active error
- "Exhibition mode" is not active
- "Simulation mode" is not active
Pressing external wheelchair button shall generate an acoustic and optical notification (If door release is not active) if all the below conditions are fulfilled :
- Ignition clamp 15 or waiting room (wartesaal) is active
- The assigned door has no active error
- "Exhibition mode" is not active
- "Simulation mode" is not active
- If the vehicle speed is less than 1 km/h

text:
Optical notification to the passengers for internal buttons:
- There shall be no active LED when ignition level in radio or 15 or engine active case.
- If there is active stop request in vehicle when the corresponding door is not in auto-mode, then the green LED of the Wheelchair/Pram button shall be active as long as stop request is active.
- If the corresponding door is in auto-mode then green LED will be active for 300 ms when the button itself or any auto door opening button at the corresponding door, is pressed.
For external buttons:
- The button in the initial state (speed below 1 km/h) is illuminated in green.
- While the vehicle is moving, the button is not illuminated.
en:
Optical notification to the passengers for internal buttons:
- There shall be no active LED when ignition level in radio or 15 or engine active case.
- If there is active stop request in vehicle when the corresponding door is not in auto-mode, then the green LED of the Wheelchair/Pram button shall be active as long as stop request is active.
- If the corresponding door is in auto-mode then green LED will be active for 300 ms when the button itself or any auto door opening button at the corresponding door, is pressed.
For external buttons:
- The button in the initial state (speed below 1 km/h) is illuminated in green.
- While the vehicle is moving, the button is not illuminated.

text: If a push button for passengers has two symbols (wheelchair and pram), the driver should be notified with two symbols.
en: If a push button for passengers has two symbols (wheelchair and pram), the driver should be notified with two symbols.

text: In case when the door has been opened in automatic mode and the automatic closing process is interrupted, closing the door by the driver shall be possible by pressing pram driver button (reset function) on the dashboard.
en: In case when the door has been opened in automatic mode and the automatic closing process is interrupted, closing the door by the driver shall be possible by pressing pram driver button (reset function) on the dashboard.

text: If the door has been opened in manual mode by the driver, the button shall not affect the behaviour of the door.
en: If the door has been opened in manual mode by the driver, the button shall not affect the behaviour of the door.

text:
After pressing the wheelchair passenger button, the driver shall receive an optical notification in the form of wheelchair symbol with stop request symbol. If the general conditions for a stop request signal are fulfilled (See the requirements of Wheelchair Button Function).
The wheelchair symbol on the display remains until the function is reset. (See the requirements of Wheelchair Button Function)
en:
After pressing the wheelchair passenger button, the driver shall receive an optical notification in the form of wheelchair symbol with stop request symbol. If the general conditions for a stop request signal are fulfilled (See the requirements of Wheelchair Button Function).
The wheelchair symbol on the display remains until the function is reset. (See the requirements of Wheelchair Button Function)

text: After pressing the button, the driver receives an acoustic notification (buzzer or bell) - single notification for 500ms or different number of buzzer notification with frequency 500ms/500ms. The number of notifications depends on the parameters.
en: After pressing the button, the driver receives an acoustic notification (buzzer or bell) - single notification for 500ms or different number of buzzer notification with frequency 500ms/500ms. The number of notifications depends on the parameters.

text:
Door configured as manual or semi-automatic - active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition (radio).
- When the corresponding door "closed" status appears.
- Occurring error on the corresponding door.
- When "all doors closed" status appears, if the door is out of service, e.g. overnight locking system (lock with the microswitch in the door leaves) or local mode is active, simultaneously.
en:
Door configured as manual or semi-automatic - active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition (radio).
- When the corresponding door "closed" status appears.
- Occurring error on the corresponding door.
- When "all doors closed" status appears, if the door is out of service, e.g. overnight locking system (lock with the microswitch in the door leaves) or local mode is active, simultaneously.

text:
The buttons shall have additional "Exhibition mode" functionality.
- The backlight on the button shall be constant green.
- Pressing the button activates the acoustic notification (buzzer or bell for the driver) for 500ms and optical notification for 3s (stop request and wheelchair symbol on the dashboard, stop request board/monitor for passengers).
en:
The buttons shall have additional "Exhibition mode" functionality.
- The backlight on the button shall be constant green.
- Pressing the button activates the acoustic notification (buzzer or bell for the driver) for 500ms and optical notification for 3s (stop request and wheelchair symbol on the dashboard, stop request board/monitor for passengers).

text: Stop demand is a signal which becomes active when one of the passenger buttons is pressed.
en: Stop demand is a signal which becomes active when one of the passenger buttons is pressed.

text:
The system shall activate the outside special buttons supply when all of the following general conditions are met:
- Night mode is inactive, and
- There is no external button deactivate request,
AND at least one of the following specific conditions is fulfilled: 1-)All of the following are true:
- Door errors are inactive,
- Door is not in local mode,
- Door release is active.
2-)Waiting room is active;
3-)Exhibition mode is active.
en:
The system shall activate the outside special buttons supply when all of the following general conditions are met:
- Night mode is inactive, and
- There is no external button deactivate request,
AND at least one of the following specific conditions is fulfilled: 1-)All of the following are true:
- Door errors are inactive,
- Door is not in local mode,
- Door release is active.
2-)Waiting room is active;
3-)Exhibition mode is active.

text: The system shall provide the possibility to choose whether functionality is divided into door zones or not.
en: The system shall provide the possibility to choose whether functionality is divided into door zones or not.

text: If door zones are activated, a stop request shall be enabled only when the doors in the corresponding zone are in the closed state, and the stop signal shall be cleared only by the doors in the same zone.
en: If door zones are activated, a stop request shall be enabled only when the doors in the corresponding zone are in the closed state, and the stop signal shall be cleared only by the doors in the same zone.

text:
The system shall be prepared to read signals from stop buttons in the following modes:
1- Only for notification, without triggering door opening
2- Notification with single door opening by enabling door opening permission, provided the request occurs while the door release is inactive.
en:
The system shall be prepared to read signals from stop buttons in the following modes:
1- Only for notification, without triggering door opening
2- Notification with single door opening by enabling door opening permission, provided the request occurs while the door release is inactive.

text: If the doors are closed and door release is disabled, door opening buttons shall send a stop request signal that is stored by the system to open the doors upon activation of door release; if door release is enabled, the opening buttons shall directly open the doors without generating a request.
en: If the doors are closed and door release is disabled, door opening buttons shall send a stop request signal that is stored by the system to open the doors upon activation of door release; if door release is enabled, the opening buttons shall directly open the doors without generating a request.

text: If the wing blockade function is activated, the system shall delete the stop demand with opening of the one of the wings.
en: If the wing blockade function is activated, the system shall delete the stop demand with opening of the one of the wings.

text: At engine simulation mode the system shall supply the buttons for checking the functionality of those buttons by driver.
en: At engine simulation mode the system shall supply the buttons for checking the functionality of those buttons by driver.

text: The system shall be automatically reset the stop demand after 3 seconds at exhibiton mode.
en: The system shall be automatically reset the stop demand after 3 seconds at exhibiton mode.

text:
Internal buttons shall have power supply if all the following conditions are fulfilled:
- Ignition switch shall be in 15 position or waiting room.
- Night mode button is not active.
en:
Internal buttons shall have power supply if all the following conditions are fulfilled:
- Ignition switch shall be in 15 position or waiting room.
- Night mode button is not active.

text:
Optical notification to the passengers :
Internal buttons:
- The button's green backlight shall be active as long as active stop request exists when door release is not active.
- While pressing the button, the red backlight shall be active for about 500ms.
External buttons:
- If button has power supply then the green LED shall always be active.
- Red LED shall be activated for 500 ms. only when it is pressed.
en:
Optical notification to the passengers :
Internal buttons:
- The button's green backlight shall be active as long as active stop request exists when door release is not active.
- While pressing the button, the red backlight shall be active for about 500ms.
External buttons:
- If button has power supply then the green LED shall always be active.
- Red LED shall be activated for 500 ms. only when it is pressed.

text: After pressing the button, the driver shall receive an optical notification in the form of pram symbol and stop request "H" symbol on the cluster.
en: After pressing the button, the driver shall receive an optical notification in the form of pram symbol and stop request "H" symbol on the cluster.

text:
The buttons shall have additional "Simulation mode" functionality if all the conditions below are fulfilled :
- Ignition switch in "clamp 5" position.
- Engine simulation mode is active.
en:
The buttons shall have additional "Simulation mode" functionality if all the conditions below are fulfilled :
- Ignition switch in "clamp 5" position.
- Engine simulation mode is active.

text:
For the doors configured as manual or semi-automatic, the active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition radio.
- Detection of error for a corresponding door.
- When the corresponding door "closed" status appears.
- When the corresponding door is out of service, by locking the closed door.
en:
For the doors configured as manual or semi-automatic, the active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition radio.
- Detection of error for a corresponding door.
- When the corresponding door "closed" status appears.
- When the corresponding door is out of service, by locking the closed door.

text: Old man with cane button is used to inform the driver that a person with limited mobility wants to get out of the vehicle.
en: Old man with cane button is used to inform the driver that a person with limited mobility wants to get out of the vehicle.

text:
The button can be in different locations:
1. Passenger compartment - The button is located at specially designated seating areas between doors 1 and 2. In articulated vehicles the button may be additionally located at door 3 area.
2. In the front part of the vehicle, the button is assigned to door 1 and 2 by default.
en:
The button can be in different locations:
1. Passenger compartment - The button is located at specially designated seating areas between doors 1 and 2. In articulated vehicles the button may be additionally located at door 3 area.
2. In the front part of the vehicle, the button is assigned to door 1 and 2 by default.

text: Buttons are assigned to specific doors. This means that they only affect the corresponding door (for example, door 2) and other doors will not be affected by the functionality of the buttons.
en: Buttons are assigned to specific doors. This means that they only affect the corresponding door (for example, door 2) and other doors will not be affected by the functionality of the buttons.

text:
Internal buttons shall have standard functionality under the following conditions:
- Ignition switch is in "clamp15" position.
- The assigned door has no active error.
- "Waiting room" mode is not active.
- "Exhibition mode" is not active.
en:
Internal buttons shall have standard functionality under the following conditions:
- Ignition switch is in "clamp15" position.
- The assigned door has no active error.
- "Waiting room" mode is not active.
- "Exhibition mode" is not active.

text: After pressing the button, the driver shall receive an optical notification in the form of old man with stick symbol regardless the door position.
en: After pressing the button, the driver shall receive an optical notification in the form of old man with stick symbol regardless the door position.

text:
For the doors configured as manual or semi-automatic, the active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition (radio).
- Occurring an error on corresponding door.
- When the corresponding door status is "closed"
- When the status "all doors closed" is set, if the door is out of service, e.g. overnight locking system (lock with the microswitch in the door leaves) or local mode is active.
en:
For the doors configured as manual or semi-automatic, the active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition (radio).
- Occurring an error on corresponding door.
- When the corresponding door status is "closed"
- When the status "all doors closed" is set, if the door is out of service, e.g. overnight locking system (lock with the microswitch in the door leaves) or local mode is active.

text:
If the corresponding door is operating in automatic or semi-automatic mode then these buttons have additional functionality:
- The button shall send a signal to open the door 1 and 2 by default as soon as the door release is activated (the signal shall also be sent when the door is during closing by automatic mode).
- The button shall deactivate the automatic door closing process and the door shall stay in the open position (even if the door is opened with another button by the passenger).
en:
If the corresponding door is operating in automatic or semi-automatic mode then these buttons have additional functionality:
- The button shall send a signal to open the door 1 and 2 by default as soon as the door release is activated (the signal shall also be sent when the door is during closing by automatic mode).
- The button shall deactivate the automatic door closing process and the door shall stay in the open position (even if the door is opened with another button by the passenger).

text:
After pressing the button, the driver shall receive an acoustic notification (driver buzzer or bell) as;
- Single notification for 500ms or triple notification with frequency 500ms ON /500ms OFF. (The number of notifications depends on the option selected by the customer.)
en:
After pressing the button, the driver shall receive an acoustic notification (driver buzzer or bell) as;
- Single notification for 500ms or triple notification with frequency 500ms ON /500ms OFF. (The number of notifications depends on the option selected by the customer.)

text:
Optical notification to the passengers. Internal buttons:
- The button initially shall be illuminated as green constantly.
- While pressing the button, the red backlight shall be active about 500ms long.
en:

Stop request shall be activated for 500ms if all below conditions are satisfied:

- Stop request saved for all doors signal is activated.

en: This function is responsible for setting or reseting the pram/wheelchair/old man button functions for the corresponding doors.

text:

en: The "Blocking doors open" function can be enabled only when permission from doors control software module is active. (Permission for doors to operate.)

en: If the pram driver button is pressed when a special stop request notification (old man or pram or wheelchair) exists on the display, then all of active notifications shall be reset.

text: There may be installed 2-position switches (1-2), or 3-positions buttons (1-0-2). Position "1" shall disable 'blocking doors open' function, and position 2 shall enable that function. If parameter is active the 'blocking door open' function can be deactivated by standard doors buttons on FAP.

text:
Emergency Mode :
The requested valve state shall be set to "unknown" if the door is in pressureless state (emergency opening mode).
en:
Emergency Mode :
The requested valve state shall be set to "unknown" if the door is in pressureless state (emergency opening mode).

text: Blocking of the emergency opening mechanism via continuously activating the closed magnetic coil of the door valve block shall be requested above a calibratable vehicle speed (default value 3 km/h) with calibratable hysteresis OR blocking of the emergency is requested via BB-CAN.
en: Blocking of the emergency opening mechanism via continuously activating the closed magnetic coil of the door valve block shall be requested above a calibratable vehicle speed (default value 3 km/h) with calibratable hysteresis OR blocking of the emergency is requested via BB-CAN.

text: The mirror lights shall be activated depending on the set of conditions.
en: The mirror lights shall be activated depending on the set of conditions.

text: If the parking lights are turned on and the door 1 is open, the sytem shall be activated.
en: If the parking lights are turned on and the door 1 is open, the sytem shall be activated.

en: If the remote control system is active, the mirror lights shall be active. after the 20s , the system turn off.

text: The system shall be active when the exhibition mode is active.
en: The system shall be active when the exhibition mode is active.

text: The system shall be activated by driver button.
en: The system shall be activated by driver button.

text:
If one of the conditions below are fulfilled and emergency button is not pressed, the system shall be deactivated :
-WC is active, driver button pressed and toilet is not occupied.
-There is under voltage condition and toilet is not occupied for 15 sec.
-There is under voltage condition and toilet driver button is pressed to activate system.
-WC is active, additional battery is not installed or bus type is not e-coach, ignition clamp is turned off, no under voltage condition and the toilet is not occupied for 3 min.
-WC is active, additional battery is installed or bus type is e-coach, no under voltage condition, 1 hour has elapsed since ignition clamp is turned off, and the toilet has been unoccupied for the last 5 minutes.
-WC is active, the doors of the vehicle are locked from outside, ignition clamp is turned off, the toilet is not occupied for 1 min and the cleaning service lights button is not pressed.
en:
If one of the conditions below are fulfilled and emergency button is not pressed, the system shall be deactivated :
-WC is active, driver button pressed and toilet is not occupied.
-There is under voltage condition and toilet is not occupied for 15 sec.
-There is under voltage condition and toilet driver button is pressed to activate system.
-WC is active, additional battery is not installed or bus type is not e-coach, ignition clamp is turned off, no under voltage condition and the toilet is not occupied for 3 min.
-WC is active, additional battery is installed or bus type is e-coach, no under voltage condition, 1 hour has elapsed since ignition clamp is turned off, and the toilet has been unoccupied for the last 5 minutes.
-WC is active, the doors of the vehicle are locked from outside, ignition clamp is turned off, the toilet is not occupied for 1 min and the cleaning service lights button is not pressed.

text: If the toilet is occupied, the toilet shall not be unavailable. If the ignition (KL15) is turned off or the doors are locked from outside when the toilet is occupied, the toilet shall be unavailable after the toilet gets free. Remark: The toilet shall remain available for an additional 1 minute before the toilet becomes unavailable.
en: If the toilet is occupied, the toilet shall not be unavailable. If the ignition (KL15) is turned off or the doors are locked from outside when the toilet is occupied, the toilet shall be unavailable after the toilet gets free.
remark: Remark: The toilet shall remain available for an additional 1 minute before the toilet becomes unavailable.

text:
If all of the conditions below are fulfilled, 'Toilet occupied ' shall be displayed on the internal indicator :
-The system is active.
-Toilet is occupied.
en:
If all of the conditions below are fulfilled, 'Toilet occupied ' shall be displayed on the internal indicator :
-The system is active.
-Toilet is occupied.

text:
If all of the conditions below is fulfilled, the toilet door pneumatic lock shall be active:
-Fire alarm is not active.
-Smoke alarm is not active.
-Emergency button is not pressed.
-Emergency shut down request is not active.
-Exhibition mode is off
-WC is deactivated.
-There is no under voltage condition.
- Cleaning service lights button is not pressed.
Remark: After the under voltage condition is occurred, toilet door lock shall remain active for 1 more min than pneumatic lock will be deactivated.
en:
If all of the conditions below is fulfilled, the toilet door pneumatic lock shall be active:
-Fire alarm is not active.
-Smoke alarm is not active.
-Emergency button is not pressed.
-Emergency shut down request is not active.
-Exhibition mode is off
-WC is deactivated.
-There is no under voltage condition.
- Cleaning service lights button is not pressed.
remark: Remark: After the under voltage condition is occurred, toilet door lock shall remain active for 1 more min than pneumatic lock will be deactivated.

text: If the system is active, the toilet button led shall be turned to yellow continuously.
en: If the system is active, the toilet button led shall be turned to yellow continuously.

text:
If one of the conditions below is fulfilled, the toilet button led shall be blinking in yellow unless the root case is eliminated. Blinking type: 250ms on/ 250ms off
-Emergency button is pressed.
-Toilet is occupied and there is an under voltage condition.
en:
If one of the conditions below is fulfilled, the toilet button led shall be blinking in yellow unless the root case is eliminated. Blinking type: 250ms on/ 250ms off
-Emergency button is pressed.
-Toilet is occupied and there is an under voltage condition.

text: If the toilet is manually locked, a "WC Occupied" warning shall be displayed on the cluster. If the driver presses the toilet button while the warning is displayed, the pop-up shall disappear for 5 seconds and then reappear to bring it to the foreground.
en: If the toilet is manually locked, a "WC Occupied" warning shall be displayed on the cluster. If the driver presses the toilet button while the warning is displayed, the pop-up shall disappear for 5 seconds and then reappear to bring it to the foreground.

text:
Toilet function shall keep the interior lighting of toilet open as long as the toilet door mechanical locked is active.
Remark: If the WC component type is Cf Maier the interior light of the toilet should become unavailable as soon as the door is unlocked.
en: Toilet function shall keep the interior lighting of toilet open as long as the toilet door mechanical locked is active.
remark: Remark: If the WC component type is Cf Maier the interior light of the toilet should become unavailable as soon as the door is unlocked.

text:
If one of the conditions below is fulfilled, the toilet button led shall be blinking in yellow. Blinking type: 800ms on/ 200ms off
-WC is active, exhibition mode off, toilet is occupied and driver button pressed.
-Ignition clamp 15 turned off, toilet occupied.
-WC is active, toilet occupied, external door button pressed.

en:

-The waste tank of the toilet is full.

text: If Door 1 is unlocked for more than 500 milliseconds, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Door 1 Status as Unlocked by consediring the Door 2 Status.
en: If Door 1 is unlocked for more than 500 milliseconds, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Door 1 Status as Unlocked by consediring the Door 2 Status.

text: If Door 1 and Door 2 is locked for more than 500 milliseconds, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Door 1 Status as Locked.
en: If Door 1 and Door 2 is locked for more than 500 milliseconds, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Door 1 Status as Locked.

text: If Door 1 Status is not Unlocked, neither Locked nor in motion, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall activate Door 1 Error.
en: If Door 1 Status is not Unlocked, neither Locked nor in motion, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall activate Door 1 Error.

text: If Door 1 and Door 2 Statuses are Unlocked for more than 500 milliseconds, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Central Lock System Status as Unlocked.
en: If Door 1 and Door 2 Statuses are Unlocked for more than 500 milliseconds, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Central Lock System Status as Unlocked.

text: If Door 1 and Door 2 Statuses are Locked for more than 500 milliseconds, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Central Lock Door Status as Locked.
en: If Door 1 and Door 2 Statuses are Locked for more than 500 milliseconds, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Central Lock Door Status as Locked.

text: If Central lock Door Status is neither Locked nor Unlocked, and Door 1 and Door 2 are not in motion for 10 seconds, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Central Lock Door Status as Error.
en: If Central lock Door Status is neither Locked nor Unlocked, and Door 1 and Door 2 are not in motion for 10 seconds, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Central Lock Door Status as Error.

text: If Central Lock Door Status is not Locked, Unlocked or Error, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Central Lock Door Status as in Action.
en: If Central Lock Door Status is not Locked, Unlocked or Error, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Central Lock Door Status as in Action.

text: If driver presses upper part of Emergency Central Lock schalter and ignition KL15 is active, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall detect an error and blink Emergency Central Lock schalter red LED (250 milliseconds on / 250 milliseconds off) for 1.5 second.
en: If driver presses upper part of Emergency Central Lock schalter and ignition KL15 is active, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall detect an error and blink Emergency Central Lock schalter red LED (250 milliseconds on / 250 milliseconds off) for 1.5 second.

text: If Central Lock Door Status is not Locked, and ignition KL15 is active, and driver presses upper part of Emergency Central Lock Schalter, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall set Schalter Lock status to active.
en: If Central Lock Door Status is not Locked, and ignition KL15 is active, and driver presses upper part of Emergency Central Lock Schalter, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall set Schalter Lock status to active.

text: As soon as Central Lock Door Subsystem recieves Door Unlock Request, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall unlock Door 1 and Door 2.
en: As soon as Central Lock Door Subsystem recieves Door Unlock Request, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall unlock Door 1 and Door 2.

text: If there are no errors for Central Lock Lift Door, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall turn on Central Lock Door Warning Lights for 3 seconds.
en: If there are no errors for Central Lock Lift Door, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall turn on Central Lock Door Warning Lights for 3 seconds.

text: If ZV Door Status is Unlocked, Flap Lock Function shall turn on ZV Door Warning Lights for 500 milliseconds.
en: If ZV Door Status is Unlocked, Flap Lock Function shall turn on ZV Door Warning Lights for 500 milliseconds.

text: If there are errors for ZV Lift Door or ZV Flap Status is Open, and ZV Door Status is Locked, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall activate ZV Door Horn for 500 milliseconds.
en: If there are errors for ZV Lift Door or ZV Flap Status is Open, and ZV Door Status is Locked, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall activate ZV Door Horn for 500 milliseconds.

text: If Central Locking Status is Locked and Emergency Central Lock schalter is not pressed, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Door Locked Status as Locked from Outside for 1 second to other software modules.
en: If Central Locking Status is Locked and Emergency Central Lock schalter is not pressed, Central Lock Door Subsystem shall transmit Door Locked Status as Locked from Outside for 1 second to other software modules.

text: If ignition KL15 is inactive and driver presses upper part of Luggage Room Schalter, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall lock the driver side flaps.
en: If ignition KL15 is inactive and driver presses upper part of Luggage Room Schalter, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall lock the driver side flaps.

text: If ignition Kl15 is inactive and driver presses upper part of Luggage Room 2 Schalter, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall lock the hostess side flaps.
en: If ignition Kl15 is inactive and driver presses upper part of Luggage Room 2 Schalter, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall lock the hostess side flaps.

text: If the driver presses upper part of the Luggage Room Schalter and vehicle speed is less than 3km/h, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall turn on the Luggage Room Schalter green LED.
en: If the driver presses upper part of the Luggage Room Schalter and vehicle speed is less than 3km/h, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall turn on the Luggage Room Schalter green LED.

text: If the driver presses upper part of the Luggage Room 2 Schalter and vehicle speed is less than 3km/h, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall turn on the Luggage Room 2 Schalter green LED.
en: If the driver presses upper part of the Luggage Room 2 Schalter and vehicle speed is less than 3km/h, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall turn on the Luggage Room 2 Schalter green LED.

text: If the driver presses upper part of the Luggage Room 1 Schalter and the vehicle speed is less than 3 km/h, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall unlock Driver Side flaps and turn on the Luggage Room 1 Schalter yellow LED.
en: If the driver presses upper part of the Luggage Room 1 Schalter and the vehicle speed is less than 3 km/h, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall unlock Driver Side flaps and turn on the Luggage Room 1 Schalter yellow LED.

text: If the driver presses upper part of Luggage Room 2 Schalter and the vehicle speed is less than 3 km/h and Wheelchair Lift Hostess Side is inactive, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall unlock Hostess Side flaps and turn on Luggage Room 2 Schalter yellow LED.
en: If the driver presses upper part of Luggage Room 2 Schalter and the vehicle speed is less than 3 km/h and Wheelchair Lift Hostess Side is inactive, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall unlock Hostess Side flaps and turn on Luggage Room 2 Schalter yellow LED.

text: If Driver Side flaps are locked or Hostess Side flaps are unlocked is active, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activateFlap Light Request.
en: If Driver Side flaps are locked or Hostess Side flaps are unlocked is active, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activateFlap Light Request.

text: If doors are open and Central Lock Door Status is not Locked and driver locks flaps, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activate Flap Horn for 50 milliseconds.
en: If doors are open and Central Lock Door Status is not Locked and driver locks flaps, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activate Flap Horn for 50 milliseconds.

text: If doors are open and Central Lock Door Status is not Locked and driver locks flaps, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activate Flap Warning Blinker for 500 milliseconds.
en: If doors are open and Central Lock Door Status is not Locked and driver locks flaps, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activate Flap Warning Blinker for 500 milliseconds.

text: If driver closes flaps and Central Locking Flap Status is not Open and Door is closed and Central Locking Door Status is Locked, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activate Central LockingFlap Warning Blinker for 3 seconds.
en: If driver closes flaps and Central Locking Flap Status is not Open and Door is closed and Central Locking Door Status is Locked, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activate Central LockingFlap Warning Blinker for 3 seconds.

text: If Door Flap 1 or 2 is open, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall set Central locking Flap Status as Open.
en: If Door Flap 1 or 2 is open, Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall set Central locking Flap Status as Open.

text: If the vehicle speed is greater than 3 km/h and the parameter named G_80_PARA_Kof_Klappe_Offen_Warn is defined , Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activate Luggage Flap Open Warning.
en: If the vehicle speed is greater than 3 km/h and the parameter named G_80_PARA_Kof_Klappe_Offen_Warn is defined , Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activate Luggage Flap Open Warning.

text: If the vehicle speed is greater than 3 km/h and the parameter named G_80_PARA_Kof_Klappe_Offen_Warn is defined , Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activate Warning Buzzer.
en: If the vehicle speed is greater than 3 km/h and the parameter named G_80_PARA_Kof_Klappe_Offen_Warn is defined , Central Lock Flap Subsystem shall activate Warning Buzzer.

text: If any flap on the right or left side of the bus is open, Flap Alarm Subsystem shall activate Flap Open.
en: If any flap on the right or left side of the bus is open, Flap Alarm Subsystem shall activate Flap Open.

text: The driver shall not lock or unlock flaps via schalter in Exhibition Mode. Remark: Central Locking Luggage Schalter LED shall be active in Exhibition Mode.
en: The driver shall not lock or unlock flaps via schalter in Exhibition Mode.
remark: Remark: Central Locking Luggage Schalter LED shall be active in Exhibition Mode.

text: Driver and Hostess Side Luggage flaps shall be open in Exhibition Mode.
en: Driver and Hostess Side Luggage flaps shall be open in Exhibition Mode.

-Driver EWC closing button is pressed for less than 600ms.

en:

-Driver EWC closing button is pressed for less than 600ms.
