text: Fire Detection Function shall run if the ignition KL15 is active. Remark: Fire Detection Function shall keep operating for one hour after ignition KL15 is switched off. Due to high engine temperatures, the fire protection systems shall run for a while after the engine is stopped.
en: Fire Detection Function shall run if the ignition KL15 is active.
remark: Remark: Fire Detection Function shall keep operating for one hour after ignition KL15 is switched off. Due to high engine temperatures, the fire protection systems shall run for a while after the engine is stopped.

text: Fire Detector and Fire Extinguisher Installation shall define the type of the fire protection system which is installed on the vehicle. Remark Fire protection system which is installed on the vehicle shall be one of the fire detector system or fire extinguisher system. If the installed system is none of them, Fire Detector and Fire Extinguisher Installation shall return and save the error code SPN: 6129.(SPN 6129 shall be only saved , SPN shall not be displayed)
en: Fire Detector and Fire Extinguisher Installation shall define the type of the fire protection system which is installed on the vehicle.
remark: Remark Fire protection system which is installed on the vehicle shall be one of the fire detector system or fire extinguisher system. If the installed system is none of them, Fire Detector and Fire Extinguisher Installation shall return and save the error code SPN: 6129.(SPN 6129 shall be only saved , SPN shall not be displayed)

text: If the fire detector is installed on the vehicle and fire detector voltage value is between 4900-5200 mV or if the fire extinguisher is installed on the vehicle and electronic unit system reports a fault signal (relevant fault signal is 0), state selected as "Infinite" and sensor failure shall be activated. If the fire detector is installed on the vehicle and fire detector voltage value is between 2500-4900 mV or if the fire extinguisher is installed on the vehicle and electronic unit system is not ok, state selected as "Nearly Zero" and fire alarm shall be activated. If the fire detector is installed on the vehicle and fire detector voltage value is between 0-2500 mV or if the fire extinguisher is installed on the vehicle and electronic unit system is ok and there is no fire, state selected as "Expected". If the state is not defined above, the fire detector resistor state selected as "Undefined Resistor Value" (undefined case).
en: If the fire detector is installed on the vehicle and fire detector voltage value is between 4900-5200 mV or if the fire extinguisher is installed on the vehicle and electronic unit system reports a fault signal (relevant fault signal is 0), state selected as "Infinite" and sensor failure shall be activated. If the fire detector is installed on the vehicle and fire detector voltage value is between 2500-4900 mV or if the fire extinguisher is installed on the vehicle and electronic unit system is not ok, state selected as "Nearly Zero" and fire alarm shall be activated. If the fire detector is installed on the vehicle and fire detector voltage value is between 0-2500 mV or if the fire extinguisher is installed on the vehicle and electronic unit system is ok and there is no fire, state selected as "Expected". If the state is not defined above, the fire detector resistor state selected as "Undefined Resistor Value" (undefined case).

text:
If fire extinguisher state is "Infinite", Operation Subsystem shall activate the fire alarm. If fire extinguisher state is "Nearly Zero",Operation Subsystem shall activate the sensor failure.Remark: To perform this operation, the fire extinguisher shall be installed on the vehicle.
REQ CANCELLED (MERGED with 2021.30164).

text:
If the parameter named G_13_PARA_Sumer_nur_ohne_Zuend is defined, fire alarm is active and ignition is inactive or if the parameter named G_13_PARA_Sumer_nur_ohne_Zuend is not defined and fire alarm is active, buzzer shall be active. If a time value is defined with the parameter named G_13_PARA_Sumer_maxZeit, Operation Subsystem shall deactivate the buzzer after the defined time.

en: If the parameter named G_13_PARA_Sumer_nur_ohne_Zuend is defined, fire alarm is active and ignition is inactive or if the parameter named G_13_PARA_Sumer_nur_ohne_Zuend is not defined and fire alarm is active, buzzer shall be active. If a time value is defined with the parameter named G_13_PARA_Sumer_maxZeit, Operation Subsystem shall deactivate the buzzer after the defined time.

text: As long as the fire alarm and ignition radio are active, Operation Subsystem shall activate the horn. Remark: When activated, horn shall be on for 500 milliseconds and off for 500 milliseconds. This is valid only for low-floor buses.For this behavior, the parameter named FA_StAlrmByIg_P shall be defined. (KSW Requirement)
en: As long as the fire alarm and ignition radio are active, Operation Subsystem shall activate the horn.
remark: Remark: When activated, horn shall be on for 500 milliseconds and off for 500 milliseconds. This is valid only for low-floor buses.For this behavior, the parameter named FA_StAlrmByIg_P shall be defined. (KSW Requirement)

text: If the fire alarm is active and ignition KL15 is inactive for less than 30 minutes, Operation Subsystem shall activate the air pressured horn for 30 seconds. Remark: To perform this operation, the parameter named FA_StHrnAtFire_P shall be defined and air supply pressure shall not be low. Remark: This requirement is valid only for low-floor buses. (KSW Requirement)
en: If the fire alarm is active and ignition KL15 is inactive for less than 30 minutes, Operation Subsystem shall activate the air pressured horn for 30 seconds.
remark: Remark: To perform this operation, the parameter named FA_StHrnAtFire_P shall be defined and air supply pressure shall not be low. Remark: This requirement is valid only for low-floor buses. (KSW Requirement)

text: If the fire alarm and ignition radio are active, Operation Subsystem shall activate the warning lights. Remark: To perform this operation, the parameter named FA_StAlrmByIg_P shall be defined. Operation Subsystem shall also activate the warning lights, if fire alarm is active and the parameter named FA_StNoneWarnBlnkrByEce107_P is not defined. Remark: This requirement is valid only for low-floor buses. (KSW Requirement)
en: If the fire alarm and ignition radio are active, Operation Subsystem shall activate the warning lights.
remark: Remark: To perform this operation, the parameter named FA_StAlrmByIg_P shall be defined. Operation Subsystem shall also activate the warning lights, if fire alarm is active and the parameter named FA_StNoneWarnBlnkrByEce107_P is not defined. Remark: This requirement is valid only for low-floor buses. (KSW Requirement)

text: If the fire alarm is active, FA_StNoneWarnBlnkrByEce107_P parameter shall be set to "1" and ignition KL15 is inactive for less than 30 minutes, Operation Subsystem shall activate the warning blinker. Turn Off Delay Threshold Subsystem shall activate warning blinker with defined threshold values according to bus type. Remark: For bus type low floor, parameter G_13_PARA_Zeit_Warnblink_bei_Feuer/G_13_PARA_t_Warnblinker_bei_Feuer shall be defined different than 0 seconds otherwise Turn Off Delay Threshold Subsystem defines duration time as 0 seconds. Remark: For bus type high floor, if parameter G_13_PARA_Zeit_Warnblink_bei_Feuer/G_13_PARA_t_Warnblinker_bei_Feuer greater than maximum threshold value, Turn Off Delay Threshold Subsystem defines duration time as maximum threshold value. If it is less than maximum threshold value and greater than 30 seconds, Turn Off Delay Threshold Subsystem defines the duration time as 30 seconds. If it is less than 30 seconds, Turn Off Delay Threshold Subsystem defines the duration time as parameter value G_13_PARA_Zeit_Warnblink_bei_Feuer/G_13_PARA_t_Warnblinker_bei_Feuer. (KSW Requirement)
en: If the fire alarm is active, FA_StNoneWarnBlnkrByEce107_P parameter shall be set to "1" and ignition KL15 is inactive for less than 30 minutes, Operation Subsystem shall activate the warning blinker. Turn Off Delay Threshold Subsystem shall activate warning blinker with defined threshold values according to bus type.
remark: Remark: For bus type low floor, parameter G_13_PARA_Zeit_Warnblink_bei_Feuer/G_13_PARA_t_Warnblinker_bei_Feuer shall be defined different than 0 seconds otherwise Turn Off Delay Threshold Subsystem defines duration time as 0 seconds. Remark: For bus type high floor, if parameter G_13_PARA_Zeit_Warnblink_bei_Feuer/G_13_PARA_t_Warnblinker_bei_Feuer greater than maximum threshold value, Turn Off Delay Threshold Subsystem defines duration time as maximum threshold value. If it is less than maximum threshold value and greater than 30 seconds, Turn Off Delay Threshold Subsystem defines the duration time as 30 seconds. If it is less than 30 seconds, Turn Off Delay Threshold Subsystem defines the duration time as parameter value G_13_PARA_Zeit_Warnblink_bei_Feuer/G_13_PARA_t_Warnblinker_bei_Feuer. (KSW Requirement)

text: As long as additional heating display or additional heating flame control is active, Operation Subsystem shall also activate the horn, air pressured horn and warning lights, if fire alarm is active and ignition radio is inactive. Remark: This requirement is valid only for low-floor buses. (KSW Requirement)

text: If the ignition radio is not active, Roof Ventilator Controller shall ignore aeration/deaeration schalter inputs from driver.
en: If the ignition radio is not active, Roof Ventilator Controller shall ignore aeration/deaeration schalter inputs from driver.

text: Deaeration function exists in the vehicle independent from the schalter type. Remark: If aeration/deaeration schalter is installed, Roof Ventilator Controller shall able to start both aeration and deaeration processes. The aeration/deaeration schalter has two parts. The upper part of this schalter is used for deaeration and the lower part is used for aeration. Deactivation of aeration and deaeration processes are setting by the schalter in the neutral position.
en: Deaeration function exists in the vehicle independent from the schalter type.
remark: Remark: If aeration/deaeration schalter is installed, Roof Ventilator Controller shall able to start both aeration and deaeration processes. The aeration/deaeration schalter has two parts. The upper part of this schalter is used for deaeration and the lower part is used for aeration. Deactivation of aeration and deaeration processes are setting by the schalter in the neutral position.

text: If aeration/deaeration schalter and deaeration schalter are both installed on the vehicle, Roof Ventilator Controller returns configuration error code SPN 6129 in the corresponding software module. Remark: The two different schalter types shall not be installed to the vehicle together.
en: If aeration/deaeration schalter and deaeration schalter are both installed on the vehicle, Roof Ventilator Controller returns configuration error code SPN 6129 in the corresponding software module.
remark: Remark: The two different schalter types shall not be installed to the vehicle together.

text: Roof Ventilation Controller shall save the schalter status on NVM(Non Volatile Memory). Remark: This allows the last selected function of the roof ventilator to be reactivated when the ignition is switched on. If the vehicle is left overnight (for more than 4 hours), the settings on the NVM are reset.
en: Roof Ventilation Controller shall save the schalter status on NVM(Non Volatile Memory).
remark: Remark: This allows the last selected function of the roof ventilator to be reactivated when the ignition is switched on. If the vehicle is left overnight (for more than 4 hours), the settings on the NVM are reset.

text: If an additional aeration/deaeration schalter is installed to the vehicle due to the existance of more than one roof ventilator, aeration and deaeration processes are based on that additional aeration/deaeration schalter. Remark: If more than one roof ventilator exists and there is no additional aeration/deaeration schalter installed, aeration and deaeration processes are based on the existing (just one) aeration/deaeration schalter.
en: If an additional aeration/deaeration schalter is installed to the vehicle due to the existance of more than one roof ventilator, aeration and deaeration processes are based on that additional aeration/deaeration schalter.
remark: Remark: If more than one roof ventilator exists and there is no additional aeration/deaeration schalter installed, aeration and deaeration processes are based on the existing (just one) aeration/deaeration schalter.

text: As soon as the driver presses lower part of the aeration/deaeration schalter, Aeration Process Subsystem shall activate aeration request. Remark: To activate aeration request, engine shall be ready to run for more than 2 seconds and the climate shall be off. If the engine is not ready to running, Aeration Process Subsystem shall activate primary aeration request instead of aeration request. If the parameter named "G_25_PARA_Dachluefter_aus_bei_KLima_Citysphere_ein" is defined, as soon as the driver presses lower part of the schalter, Aeration Process Subsystem shall activate primary aeration request even if the climate is on. For this behaviour, engine status is ignored. Remark: "Engine is ready for running" means that the engine is ready for drive and it is working at the moment. In order for the engine to be ready for running, KL15 needs to be active.
en: As soon as the driver presses lower part of the aeration/deaeration schalter, Aeration Process Subsystem shall activate aeration request.
remark: Remark: To activate aeration request, engine shall be ready to run for more than 2 seconds and the climate shall be off. If the engine is not ready to running, Aeration Process Subsystem shall activate primary aeration request instead of aeration request. If the parameter named "G_25_PARA_Dachluefter_aus_bei_KLima_Citysphere_ein" is defined, as soon as the driver presses lower part of the schalter, Aeration Process Subsystem shall activate primary aeration request even if the climate is on. For this behaviour, engine status is ignored. Remark: "Engine is ready for running" means that the engine is ready for drive and it is working at the moment. In order for the engine to be ready for running, KL15 needs to be active.

text: As soon as the aeration request is active, Aeration Process Subsystem shall activate aeration process if compressor is not working. Remark: The aeration process shall start 2 seconds after the deaeration request disappears. To perform this behaviour, the parameter named "G_25_PARA_Dachlueft_H_nur_Entlueften" shall not be defined.
en: As soon as the aeration request is active, Aeration Process Subsystem shall activate aeration process if compressor is not working.
remark: Remark: The aeration process shall start 2 seconds after the deaeration request disappears. To perform this behaviour, the parameter named "G_25_PARA_Dachlueft_H_nur_Entlueften" shall not be defined.

text: As soon as the driver presses upper part of the schalter, Deaeration Process Subsystem shall activate deaeration request. Remark: To activate deaeration request, the engine shall be run for more than 2 seconds and the climate shall be off. If the engine is not ready to be run, Deaeration Process Subsystem shall activate primary deaeration request instead of deaeration request. If the parameter named "G_25_PARA_Dachluefter_aus_bei_KLima_Citysphere_ein" is defined, as soon as the driver presses the upper part of the schalter, Deaeration Process Subsystem shall activate primary deaeration request even if the climate is on. For this behaviour, engine status is ignored.
en: As soon as the driver presses upper part of the schalter, Deaeration Process Subsystem shall activate deaeration request.
remark: Remark: To activate deaeration request, the engine shall be run for more than 2 seconds and the climate shall be off. If the engine is not ready to be run, Deaeration Process Subsystem shall activate primary deaeration request instead of deaeration request. If the parameter named "G_25_PARA_Dachluefter_aus_bei_KLima_Citysphere_ein" is defined, as soon as the driver presses the upper part of the schalter, Deaeration Process Subsystem shall activate primary deaeration request even if the climate is on. For this behaviour, engine status is ignored.

text: As soon as the deaeration request is active, Deaeration Process Subsystem shall activate deaeration process if compressor is active not less than 2 minutes and the climate is off. Remark: The deaeration process shall start 2 seconds after the aeration request disappears. Deaeration Process Subsystem shall also activate deaeration process if the compressor is active for less than 2 minutes and the climate is off. If the parameter named "G_25_PARA_Dachluefter_aus_bei_KLima_Citysphere_ein" is not defined, it shall be used instead of climate is off condition.
en: As soon as the deaeration request is active, Deaeration Process Subsystem shall activate deaeration process if compressor is active not less than 2 minutes and the climate is off.
remark: Remark: The deaeration process shall start 2 seconds after the aeration request disappears. Deaeration Process Subsystem shall also activate deaeration process if the compressor is active for less than 2 minutes and the climate is off. If the parameter named "G_25_PARA_Dachluefter_aus_bei_KLima_Citysphere_ein" is not defined, it shall be used instead of climate is off condition.

text: Platform Heating Subsystem shall activate platform heating if either aeration or deaeration process is started. Remark: For this behaviour, the parameter named "G_25_PARA_DachlBeEnt_und_PodestHzg" shall be defined.
en: Platform Heating Subsystem shall activate platform heating if either aeration or deaeration process is started.
remark: Remark: For this behaviour, the parameter named "G_25_PARA_DachlBeEnt_und_PodestHzg" shall be defined.

text: If an aeration/deaeration schalter (or deaeration schalter) error occurs , LED Lighting Subsystem shall activate the red roof ventilator schalter LED blinking (ON for 250ms, OFF for 250ms). Error has priority over aeration/deaeration requests. Remark: The red LED shall keep blinking for 1.5 seconds more after the error disappears. As long as an error exists, only the roof ventilator schalter red LED is able to blink.
en: If an aeration/deaeration schalter (or deaeration schalter) error occurs , LED Lighting Subsystem shall activate the red roof ventilator schalter LED blinking (ON for 250ms, OFF for 250ms). Error has priority over aeration/deaeration requests.
remark: Remark: The red LED shall keep blinking for 1.5 seconds more after the error disappears. As long as an error exists, only the roof ventilator schalter red LED is able to blink.

text: If the driver requests deaeration, LED Lighting Subsystem shall activate the green roof ventilator schalter LED. Remark: If the driver requests primary deaeration, LED Lighting Subsystem shall activate the green roof ventilator schalter LED blinking (ON for 200ms, OFF for 800ms). Primary deaeration has priority over deaeration request.
en: If the driver requests deaeration, LED Lighting Subsystem shall activate the green roof ventilator schalter LED.
remark: Remark: If the driver requests primary deaeration, LED Lighting Subsystem shall activate the green roof ventilator schalter LED blinking (ON for 200ms, OFF for 800ms). Primary deaeration has priority over deaeration request.

text: If the driver request aeration, LED Lighting Subsystem shall activate the yellow roof ventilator schalter LED. Remark: If the driver request primary aeration, LED Lighting Subsystem shall activate the yellow roof ventilator schalter LED blinking (ON for 200ms, OFF for 800ms). Primary aeration has priority over aeration request.
en: If the driver request aeration, LED Lighting Subsystem shall activate the yellow roof ventilator schalter LED.
remark: Remark: If the driver request primary aeration, LED Lighting Subsystem shall activate the yellow roof ventilator schalter LED blinking (ON for 200ms, OFF for 800ms). Primary aeration has priority over aeration request.

text: In case of undervoltage, Roof Ventilator Controller shall not able to operate.
en: In case of undervoltage, Roof Ventilator Controller shall not able to operate.

text: If the exhibition mode is active, Roof Ventilator Controller shall not able to operate.
en: If the exhibition mode is active, Roof Ventilator Controller shall not able to operate.

text: If parameter 165017 (IBP_SofIbisEmcyCallLd_P) is active, using panic button (IBPB_StIbisEmcyCallBtn) or by foot-button (IBPB_StIbisEmcyCallFootBtn) shall activate loud version of mode. After turning off buttons mode is still active and second pushing button or turning on ignition KL15 shall deactivate it. Loud version of mode in addition to standard operation activates warning lights and it shall send signal to video system. If additionally the parameter 165559 (IBP_SofIbisEmcyCallLdWithFrm_P) is active, deactivating mode (output signal) is after turning off button. If above parameter is active and the parameter 165017 is not active, changing mode status is after every turning off buttons.
en: If parameter 165017 (IBP_SofIbisEmcyCallLd_P) is active, using panic button (IBPB_StIbisEmcyCallBtn) or by foot-button (IBPB_StIbisEmcyCallFootBtn) shall activate loud version of mode. After turning off buttons mode is still active and second pushing button or turning on ignition KL15 shall deactivate it. Loud version of mode in addition to standard operation activates warning lights and it shall send signal to video system. If additionally the parameter 165559 (IBP_SofIbisEmcyCallLdWithFrm_P) is active, deactivating mode (output signal) is after turning off button. If above parameter is active and the parameter 165017 is not active, changing mode status is after every turning off buttons.

text: If the parameter IBP_TdIbisEmcyCallHldUp_P (165619) is defined and ignition radio is active and panic button or foot button is pressed, standard panic mode signal shall be active for a specified time. Turning off ignition radio shall interrupt mode.
en: If the parameter IBP_TdIbisEmcyCallHldUp_P (165619) is defined and ignition radio is active and panic button or foot button is pressed, standard panic mode signal shall be active for a specified time. Turning off ignition radio shall interrupt mode.

text: If the parameter IBP_SofIbisEmcyAddlHrn_P (165997) is equal 1 panic mode shall activate pulsating horn. It shall be deactivated by turning on KL15 (if panic mode is not still active) or when the parameter is equal 2 by turning off panic button. When panic mode is in loud version, deactivating mode shall automatically turns off horn. There can be also additional button which shall activate continuous horn signal.
en: If the parameter IBP_SofIbisEmcyAddlHrn_P (165997) is equal 1 panic mode shall activate pulsating horn. It shall be deactivated by turning on KL15 (if panic mode is not still active) or when the parameter is equal 2 by turning off panic button. When panic mode is in loud version, deactivating mode shall automatically turns off horn. There can be also additional button which shall activate continuous horn signal.

text: If the parameter IBP_TdIbisEmcyForDedispHldUp_P (165999) is defined and ignition radio is active, panic mode shall send signal to destination displays for specified time. Turning off ignition radio shall interrupt this process.
en: If the parameter IBP_TdIbisEmcyForDedispHldUp_P (165999) is defined and ignition radio is active, panic mode shall send signal to destination displays for specified time. Turning off ignition radio shall interrupt this process.

text: Sending panic mode signal for destination displays, activing mode for specified time and turning on horn by the button shall depend from the ignition radio. Using the parameter IBP_SofIbisEmcyCallWoutIg_P (166001) shall result they are independent.
en: Sending panic mode signal for destination displays, activing mode for specified time and turning on horn by the button shall depend from the ignition radio. Using the parameter IBP_SofIbisEmcyCallWoutIg_P (166001) shall result they are independent.

text: If the parameter IBP_SofBlnkrAlrmCtl_P (166100) is active, quiet panic mode button is turned on and warning lights button is turned off warning lights alarm shall activate. If the quiet panic mode button is turned on and one side of blinkers is active then alarm of only second side blinkers shall turn on. Another cases shall cause alarm is inactive and lighting of learning button.
en: If the parameter IBP_SofBlnkrAlrmCtl_P (166100) is active, quiet panic mode button is turned on and warning lights button is turned off warning lights alarm shall activate. If the quiet panic mode button is turned on and one side of blinkers is active then alarm of only second side blinkers shall turn on. Another cases shall cause alarm is inactive and lighting of learning button.

text: Activating IBIS shall activate Destination Display system.
en: Activating IBIS shall activate Destination Display system.

text: If parameter 150994 is defined, Destination Display is active for specified time after turning off IBIS.
en: If parameter 150994 is defined, Destination Display is active for specified time after turning off IBIS.

en: If parameter 150955 is active, Destination Display is active when IBIS is active. If additionally 150994 is defined, Destination Display is active for specified time after turning off engine.

en: If parameter 150955 is active, Destination Display is active when IBIS is active. If additionally 150994 is defined, Destination Display is active for specified time after turning off engine.

en: If parameter 239017 is defined, Destination Display shall be active for specified time after turning on Ignition Radio or after turning off Ignition KL15. Important condition is Ignition Radio shall be active.

en: If parameter IBP_SofDedispWithSelfHldUp_P (151018) is active, Destination Display shall be activated by IBPS_StIbisSelfHldUp self-retention signal.

text: As soon as the voltage in the bus body system has reached 2nd level of undervoltage, the destination display shall shut down (destination display inactive) Remark: 1st level of undervoltage means in this context: All unimportant electric loads will be shut down. 2nd level of undervoltage means: All important electric loads will be shut down.

remark: Remark: 1st level of undervoltage means in this context: All unimportant electric loads will be shut down. 2nd level of undervoltage means: All important electric loads will be shut down.

en: If exhibition mode is on, the destination display system shall be active.

text: The system shall activate the temperature display for 10 seconds, followed by deactivation for 15 seconds. During this cycle, the digital clock shall be displayed as a complement to the outside temperature.
en: The system shall activate the temperature display for 10 seconds, followed by deactivation for 15 seconds. During this cycle, the digital clock shall be displayed as a complement to the outside temperature.

en: The system shall activate the Toilet Occupied Display via CAN when the toilet is occupied.

text: The system shall activate the Stop Request Display upon Stop Request activation.
en: The system shall activate the Stop Request Display upon Stop Request activation.

text:
The system shall activate the Seatbelt Display if all of the following conditions are met:
- All doors are closed.
- The engine is running.
- The vehicle speed is less than 20 km/h.
- No bus stop request has been made.
The Seatbelt Display shall remain active for the duration these conditions are met.
en:
The system shall activate the Seatbelt Display if all of the following conditions are met:

- The engine is running.
- The vehicle speed is less than 20 km/h.
- No bus stop request has been made.
The Seatbelt Display shall remain active for the duration these conditions are met.

text:

- All doors are closed.
- The engine is running.
- The vehicle speed is less than 20 km/h.
- No bus stop request has been made.
en:

- All doors are closed.
- The engine is running.
- The vehicle speed is less than 20 km/h.
- No bus stop request has been made.

text:
The system shall display a repeating loop of the following four features, in the specified order, on the Passenger Information Panel while in Exhibition Mode:
- Outside Temperature Information
- Toilet Occupied Warning
- Seatbelts Warning
- Bus Stop Request Warning
Each feature shall be displayed for 5 seconds. The loop shall continue uninterrupted as long as the vehicle remains in Exhibition Mode.

- 2nd/3rd/4th doors can be opened by the corresponding driver button by pressing for 10 second.
- 2nd/3rd/4th doors can also be opened by the external driver button by pressing for 10 second if the 1st door is already closed.

text: All Emergency Hammers are connected through a single pin and the same emergency signal is transmitted through this pin when any Emergency Hammers is pulled.

text: The system shall activate Emergency Hammer Usage after a 3-second delay when an emergency signal is received.
en: The system shall activate Emergency Hammer Usage after a 3-second delay when an emergency signal is received.

text:
The Emergency Hammer Buzzer Request shall be triggered if all the following conditions are met:
- Ignition radio is active.
- Exhibition mode is deactivated.
- Emergency Hammer usage is detected for more than 3 seconds.
The buzzer shall remain active for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds, the buzzer request shall be reset.
en:
The Emergency Hammer Buzzer Request shall be triggered if all the following conditions are met:
- Ignition radio is active.
- Exhibition mode is deactivated.
- Emergency Hammer usage is detected for more than 3 seconds.
The buzzer shall remain active for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds, the buzzer request shall be reset.

text:
This requirement is KSW.
EHUW shall activate Emergency Hammer buzzer request for both side, if the vehicle is not in exhibition mode and ignition radio is active and if there is an Emergency Hammer usage for both side for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds, the buzzer request shall be reset. The buzzer activation time can be changed according to parameter EHUW_EmcyHmmrBuzTi_P (G_16_PARA_Zeit_Summer_Nothammer). If this parameter is not defined, the default buzzer activation time shall be 10 seconds.
Remark: EHUW shall reset buzzer after 10 seconds if Emergency Hammer buzzer off is active. EHUW shall activate Buzzer Error Set Flag signal status, if parameter EHUW_EmcyHmmrBuzCnsBeep_P (G_16_PARA_Nothammer_Summer_Dauerton) is not defined and parameter EHUW_EmcyHmmrBuzF1_P (G_16_PARA_Nothammer_Summer_F1) is defined and Emergency Hammer buzzer request for both side is activated. Remark: EHUW shall activate Buzzer Set Flag signal status, if parameter EHUW_EmcyHmmrBuzCnsBeep_P (G_16_PARA_Nothammer_Summer_Dauerton) is defined.

text: The system shall be adjusted according to the installation the proximity switch, which give the information about driver door state. The proximity switch could be used like NO type or NC type. This shall be able to changed by parameter.
en: The system shall be adjusted according to the installation the proximity switch, which give the information about driver door state. The proximity switch could be used like NO type or NC type. This shall be able to changed by parameter.

text: The system shall have possibility to deactivate the driver door lock by the separate driver button on the dashboard. The parking brake should be active simultaneously for the possibility of using this driver door to unlock.
en: The system shall have possibility to deactivate the driver door lock by the separate driver button on the dashboard. The parking brake should be active simultaneously for the possibility of using this driver door to unlock.

text: The system should have possibility to unlock the driver door when the ignition is totaly turned off. The parking brake should be active simultaneously for the possibility of using this driver door to unlock.
en: The system should have possibility to unlock the driver door when the ignition is totaly turned off. The parking brake should be active simultaneously for the possibility of using this driver door to unlock.

text: If the ignition radio is active, the system shall disable the activation of all Radio Remote Control Channels.
en: If the ignition radio is active, the system shall disable the activation of all Radio Remote Control Channels.

text: Radio Remote Control Channel 1 is activated by pressing button 1 of the remote controller, regardless of whether the press is short or long.
en: Radio Remote Control Channel 1 is activated by pressing button 1 of the remote controller, regardless of whether the press is short or long.

text: Radio Remote Control Channel 2 is activated by pressing button 2 on the remote controller for a duration shorter than 2 seconds.
en: Radio Remote Control Channel 2 is activated by pressing button 2 on the remote controller for a duration shorter than 2 seconds.

text: If the Radio Remote Control Channel 3 is activated, the system shall initiate a request to lock or unlock the luggage comportments.
en: If the Radio Remote Control Channel 3 is activated, the system shall initiate a request to lock or unlock the luggage comportments.

text: If Radio Remote Control Channel 1 or Channel 2 is activated and all doors remain in the closed state continuously for 7 seconds, the system shall initiate a door lock request.
en: If Radio Remote Control Channel 1 or Channel 2 is activated and all doors remain in the closed state continuously for 7 seconds, the system shall initiate a door lock request.

text: In exhibition mode, Radio Remote Control Channels 1 and 2 shall remain available for activation during the first 30 seconds. All channels shall be deactivated after 30 seconds.
en: In exhibition mode, Radio Remote Control Channels 1 and 2 shall remain available for activation during the first 30 seconds. All channels shall be deactivated after 30 seconds.

text: If Radio Remote Control Channel 1 or Channel 2 is activated and all doors remain closed for 5 seconds, the system shall deactivate the channels for 4 seconds.
en: If Radio Remote Control Channel 1 or Channel 2 is activated and all doors remain closed for 5 seconds, the system shall deactivate the channels for 4 seconds.

text:
CANCELLED
If one of the Radio Remote Control Channels is active for more than 10 seconds (short to battery error/plus signal), Diagnostic Subsystem shall activate radio remote control error and perform diagnostics operation with the following parameters: Priority: 4 SPN: 6386 FMI: 6 The diagnostics subsystem shall save the error code for this operation. There is no need to display the error on the dashboard. Remark: If short to ground(0V) error for one of the radio remote control channels is occurred and remains for at least 10 seconds, Diagnostic Subsystem shall perform the same diagnostics operation with different FMI value of 5.
en:

There is no need to display the error on the dashboard. text:
The system shall be able to activate the Night Light if all of the following conditions are true:
-Vehicle is not in the under voltage condition.
- Parking Light shall be active.
en:
The system shall be able to activate the Night Light if all of the following conditions are true:
-Vehicle is not in the under voltage condition.
- Parking Light shall be active.

text:
CANCELLED
The system will deactivate the Night Light if driver closes door with external door button.
en:
CANCELLED
The system will deactivate the Night Light if driver closes door with external door button.

text: The system will deactivate the Night Light after 30 seconds in under voltage condition.
en: The system will deactivate the Night Light after 30 seconds in under voltage condition.

text: In Sky Vehicles, When the speed exceeds 3 km/h the system will deactivate the right side of Night Light until vehicle is stopped and any door is opened.
en: In Sky Vehicles, When the speed exceeds 3 km/h the system will deactivate the right side of Night Light until vehicle is stopped and any door is opened.

text: If hostess light input (PRLI_In_LightHossLi_I) is active , Diagnostic Subsystem shall perform diagnostics operation with the following parameters: Priority: 5 SPN: 6611 FMI: 0 The diagnostics subsystem shall display the error on the dashboard. There is no need to save the error on NVM. Remark: The diagnostics subsystem shall perform this operation with 1 second delay. When hostess light input is deactive, the diagnostics subsystem shall keep performing this operation for 1 second more. Also ignition KL15 shall be active for 3 seconds at least otherwise this operation is cancelled.
en: If hostess light input (PRLI_In_LightHossLi_I) is active , Diagnostic Subsystem shall perform diagnostics operation with the following parameters: Priority: 5 SPN: 6611 FMI: 0 The diagnostics subsystem shall display the error on the dashboard. There is no need to save the error on NVM.
remark: Remark: The diagnostics subsystem shall perform this operation with 1 second delay. When hostess light input is deactive, the diagnostics subsystem shall keep performing this operation for 1 second more. Also ignition KL15 shall be active for 3 seconds at least otherwise this operation is cancelled.

text:
If the activation signal of the fair trade mode has a value equal to "1" then the fair trade mode shall be activated.
If the activation signal of the fair trade mode has a value equal to "0" then the fair trade mode shall be deactivated.
en:
If the activation signal of the fair trade mode has a value equal to "1" then the fair trade mode shall be activated.
If the activation signal of the fair trade mode has a value equal to "0" then the fair trade mode shall be deactivated.

text:
Trade fair mode function shall activate trade fair mode according to following conditions,
- If vehicle speed is less than 1 km/h, engine is not running and ignition KL15 is active at least 1 second and,
- If status of vehicle's front roof hatch 1 or front roof hatch 2 or front roof hatch 3 or front roof hatch 4 is open and,
- If warning lights are on and,
- If mirror heater is active at least 20 seconds.
en:
Trade fair mode function shall activate trade fair mode according to following conditions,
- If vehicle speed is less than 1 km/h, engine is not running and ignition KL15 is active at least 1 second and,
- If status of vehicle's front roof hatch 1 or front roof hatch 2 or front roof hatch 3 or front roof hatch 4 is open and,
- If warning lights are on and,
- If mirror heater is active at least 20 seconds.

text: If trade fair mode is active when the ignition is closed, after the ignition becomes active again exhibition mode shall start as active.
en: If trade fair mode is active when the ignition is closed, after the ignition becomes active again exhibition mode shall start as active.

text: If the ignition taster function is installed on the vehicle, ignition taster function shall wake up the ignition schalter/taster over CAN.
en: If the ignition taster function is installed on the vehicle, ignition taster function shall wake up the ignition schalter/taster over CAN.

text: Ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall deactivate the ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2 by taster only when the tachometer speed is less than 1 kph (the vehicle is stationary) and engine is not ready to run and bottom part of the motor start - stop taster is pressed. Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.
en: Ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall deactivate the ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2 by taster only when the tachometer speed is less than 1 kph (the vehicle is stationary) and engine is not ready to run and bottom part of the motor start - stop taster is pressed.
remark: Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.

text: Ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall activate Ignition bypass 2 only when ignition bypass 1 is active.
en: Ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall activate Ignition bypass 2 only when ignition bypass 1 is active.

text: Ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall activate the ignition bypass 1 as soon as the upper part of the ignition taster is pressed. Remark: As long as the ignition bypass 2 is inactive, if the bottom part of the ignition taster is pressed after the activation of ignition bypass 1, ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall deactivate the ignition bypass 1. Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.
en: Ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall activate the ignition bypass 1 as soon as the upper part of the ignition taster is pressed.
remark: Remark: As long as the ignition bypass 2 is inactive, if the bottom part of the ignition taster is pressed after the activation of ignition bypass 1, ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall deactivate the ignition bypass 1. Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.

text: After the ignition bypass 1 is activated, ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall activate the ignition bypass 2 as soon as the upper part of the ignition taster is pressed. Remark: ignition bypass 1 remains active after the activation of ignition bypass 2.
en: After the ignition bypass 1 is activated, ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall activate the ignition bypass 2 as soon as the upper part of the ignition taster is pressed.
remark: Remark: ignition bypass 1 remains active after the activation of ignition bypass 2.

text: As soon as the bottom part of the ignition taster is pressed, ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall deactivate the ignition bypass 1 only when the ignition bypass 2 is inactive. Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.

remark: Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.

text: If the parameter named G_15_PARA_Zuend12_zusammen is defined, as soon as the upper part of the ignition taster is pressed, ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall activate ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2. Remark: Ignition bypass 2 is activated after 1 cycle time from ignition bypass 1 is activated. Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.
en: If the parameter named G_15_PARA_Zuend12_zusammen is defined, as soon as the upper part of the ignition taster is pressed, ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall activate ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2.
remark: Remark: Ignition bypass 2 is activated after 1 cycle time from ignition bypass 1 is activated. Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.

text: If the parameter named G_15_PARA_Zuend12_zusammen(IgB_StCtldByp1And2_P) or G_15_PARA_Zuend12_zus_aus(IgB_StCtldByp1And2ToOff_P) is defined, as soon as the bottom part of the ignition taster is pressed, ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall deactivate ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2. remark: Remark: Ignition bypass 2 is deactivated after 1 cycle time from ignition bypass 1 is deactivated. Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.

text: If the bottom part of ignition taster is pressed for 1500 milliseconds, ignition bypass control by taster subsystem shall deactivate ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2. Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.

remark: Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.

text: Ignition bypass control by schalter subsystem shall activate the ignition bypass 1 and the ignition bypass 2 as soon as the upper part of the ignition schalter is pressed. Remark: When the upper part of the ignition schalter is pressed, ignition bypass 1 is activated and ignition bypass 2 is activated after 1 cycle time from ignition bypass 1 is activated. Remark:For this operation, the parameter name G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypSwt_P) shall be defined.
en: Ignition bypass control by schalter subsystem shall activate the ignition bypass 1 and the ignition bypass 2 as soon as the upper part of the ignition schalter is pressed.
remark: Remark: When the upper part of the ignition schalter is pressed, ignition bypass 1 is activated and ignition bypass 2 is activated after 1 cycle time from ignition bypass 1 is activated. Remark:For this operation, the parameter name G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypSwt_P) shall be defined.

text: Ignition bypass control by schalter subsystem shall deactivate the ignition bypass 2 as soon as the bottom part of the ignition schalter is pressed. Remark: After 1 second from the ignition bypass 2 is deactivated, ignition bypass control by schalter subsystem shall deactivate ignition bypass 1. The bottom part of the ignition schalter has no functionality. It is only used for disabling. Remark:For this operation, the parameter name G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypSwt_P) shall be defined.
en: Ignition bypass control by schalter subsystem shall deactivate the ignition bypass 2 as soon as the bottom part of the ignition schalter is pressed.
remark: Remark: After 1 second from the ignition bypass 2 is deactivated, ignition bypass control by schalter subsystem shall deactivate ignition bypass 1. The bottom part of the ignition schalter has no functionality. It is only used for disabling. en: To enable ignition bypass control by ignition key subsystem, the parameter named G_15_PARA_Zuend_Zuendschloss shall be defined.

en: Ignition bypass control by ignition key subsystem shall activate ignition bypass 1 as soon as the ignition radio becomes active.
remark: Remark: Ignition bypass control by ignition key subsystem shall deactivate ignition bypass 1 as soon as ignition radio becomes inactive.

text: Ignition control by ignition key subsystem shall activate ignition bypass 2 as soon as the ignition KL15 becomes active. Remark: Ignition bypass control by ignition key subsystem shall activate the ignition bypass 2 only when ignition bypass 1 shall be active.
en: Ignition control by ignition key subsystem shall activate ignition bypass 2 as soon as the ignition KL15 becomes active.
remark: Remark: Ignition bypass control by ignition key subsystem shall activate the ignition bypass 2 only when ignition bypass 1 shall be active.

text: Ignition bypass control by ignition key subsystem shall deactivate ignition bypass 2 as soon as the ignition KL15 becomes inactive.
en: Ignition bypass control by ignition key subsystem shall deactivate ignition bypass 2 as soon as the ignition KL15 becomes inactive.

text: Ignition bypass deactivation control by engine stop subsystem shall deactivate ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2 only when the engine is not ready to run and the tachometer speed is less than 1 kph (the vehicle is stationary) bottom part of the motor start - stop taster is pressed.
en: Ignition bypass deactivation control by engine stop subsystem shall deactivate ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2 only when the engine is not ready to run and the tachometer speed is less than 1 kph (the vehicle is stationary) bottom part of the motor start - stop taster is pressed.

text: To enable ignition bypass deactivation by main schalter subsystem, the parameter named G_02_PARA_Hauptschalter_ueber_Zuendung shall be defined.
en: To enable ignition bypass deactivation by main schalter subsystem, the parameter named G_02_PARA_Hauptschalter_ueber_Zuendung shall be defined.

text: Ignition bypass deactivation by main schalter subsystem shall deactivate ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2 as soon as the main schalter becomes inactive. Remark: Ignition bypass 1 shall be deactivated with 1 second delay.
en: Ignition bypass deactivation by main schalter subsystem shall deactivate ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2 as soon as the main schalter becomes inactive.
remark: Remark: Ignition bypass 1 shall be deactivated with 1 second delay.

text: Engine start control subsystem shall delay the activation of the engine start request 100 ms.
en: Engine start control subsystem shall delay the activation of the engine start request 100 ms.

text: Engine start control subsystem shall activate the engine start request based on set of the engine start conditions.
en: Engine start control subsystem shall activate the engine start request based on set of the engine start conditions.

text: Set of the engine start conditions: When the upper part of the motor start - stop taster is pressed, engine start control subsystem shall activate the engine start request as long as the tail side flap is closed and ignition KL15 is active.
en: Set of the engine start conditions: When the upper part of the motor start - stop taster is pressed, engine start control subsystem shall activate the engine start request as long as the tail side flap is closed and ignition KL15 is active.

text: If engine stop control subsystem activates engine stop request when engine is ready to run, engine start control subsystem shall not activate the engine start request for 5 seconds.
en: If engine stop control subsystem activates engine stop request when engine is ready to run, engine start control subsystem shall not activate the engine start request for 5 seconds.

text: If the parameter named G_15_PARA_An_nur_bei_FSB is defined, engine start control subsystem shall activate the engine start request via set of engine start conditions only when the parking brake is active.
en: If the parameter named G_15_PARA_An_nur_bei_FSB is defined, engine start control subsystem shall activate the engine start request via set of engine start conditions only when the parking brake is active.

text: Engine stop control subsystem shall activate the engine stop request based on set of the engine stop conditions.
en: Engine stop control subsystem shall activate the engine stop request based on set of the engine stop conditions.

text: Set of stop engine conditions: If the bottom part of the motor start - stop taster is pressed more than 1 second, engine stop control subsystem shall activate the engine stop request only when the tachometer speed is less than 1 kph (the vehicle is stationary), ignition bypass 2 is active and engine is running for more than 5 seconds.
en: Set of stop engine conditions: If the bottom part of the motor start - stop taster is pressed more than 1 second, engine stop control subsystem shall activate the engine stop request only when the tachometer speed is less than 1 kph (the vehicle is stationary), ignition bypass 2 is active and engine is running for more than 5 seconds.

text: If the bottom part of ignition taster is pressed for 1500 milliseconds, engine stop control subsystem shall activate the engine stop request when the tachometer speed is less than 1 kph (the vehicle is stationary) and engine is running. Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_PARA_Aus_bei_FSB(IgB_StEngOffPrkgBrk_P) shall not be defined. Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.
en: If the bottom part of ignition taster is pressed for 1500 milliseconds, engine stop control subsystem shall activate the engine stop request when the tachometer speed is less than 1 kph (the vehicle is stationary) and engine is running.
remark: Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_PARA_Aus_bei_FSB(IgB_StEngOffPrkgBrk_P) shall not be defined. Remark:For this operation, the parameter named G_15_Zuendung_S switch(IgB_StIgBtnTypBtn_P) shall be defined.

text: If the parameter named G_15_PARA_Aus_bei_FSB is defined, engine stop control subsystem shall activate the engine stop request via set of engine stop conditions only when the parking brake is active.
en: If the parameter named G_15_PARA_Aus_bei_FSB is defined, engine stop control subsystem shall activate the engine stop request via set of engine stop conditions only when the parking brake is active.

text: If the bottom part of the ignition taster is pressed, the ignition taster red led shall blink on 500ms off 500 ms for 3 seconds. Blinking type: Info Blinken : E500/ A500
en: If the bottom part of the ignition taster is pressed, the ignition taster red led shall blink on 500ms off 500 ms for 3 seconds. Blinking type: Info Blinken : E500/ A500

text: If the upper part of the ignition taster is pressed as long as ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2 are active, the ignition taster red led shall blink 500ms on 500 ms off for 3 seconds. Blinking type: Info Blinken : E500/ A500
en: If the upper part of the ignition taster is pressed as long as ignition bypass 1 and ignition bypass 2 are active, the ignition taster red led shall blink 500ms on 500 ms off for 3 seconds. Blinking type: Info Blinken : E500/ A500

text: If the engine is ready to run, led control subsystem shall turn on the motor start - stop taster green led.
en: If the engine is ready to run, led control subsystem shall turn on the motor start - stop taster green led.

text: If undervoltage state is active for more than 3 seconds, as soon as the upper or bottom part of the motor start - stop taster is pressed, the motor start - stop taster red led shall blink 250ms on 250 ms off. Blinking type [3]: Fehler Blinken : E250/ A250
en: If undervoltage state is active for more than 3 seconds, as soon as the upper or bottom part of the motor start - stop taster is pressed, the motor start - stop taster red led shall blink 250ms on 250 ms off. Blinking type [3]: Fehler Blinken : E250/ A250

text: In case of undervoltage state, as soon as the upper/bottom part of the ignition taster is pressed or the upper part of the ignition schalter is turned on/off, the ignition schalter/taster red led shall blink 250ms on 250 ms off Blinking type: Fehler Blinken : E250/ A250
en: In case of undervoltage state, as soon as the upper/bottom part of the ignition taster is pressed or the upper part of the ignition schalter is turned on/off, the ignition schalter/taster red led shall blink 250ms on 250 ms off Blinking type: Fehler Blinken : E250/ A250

en: If the exhibition mode is active, ignition schalter/taster and engine taster/schalter are not enabled.

en: Test Case Result 7.1. Engine is ready to run 7.2. Upper part of the ignition taster is pressed 7.1. Motor start - stop taster green led is activated

text: Test Case Result 9.1. Set ignition key to radio position 9.2. Drain the battery to the under voltage state If upper/bottom part of the ignition taster is pressed or the upper part of the ignition schalter is turned on/off : 9.1 Ignition schalter/taster red led shall blink 250ms on 250 ms off If undervoltage state is active for more than 3 seconds and upper or bottom part of the motor start - stop taster is pressed : 9.2 Motor start - stop taster red led shall blink 250ms on 250 ms off
en: Test Case Result 9.1. Set ignition key to radio position 9.2. text:
When the trade fair mode is active,
- The menu operation shall be suppressed
- All indicator lights and sound outputs shall be suppressed
- All error messages and notes shall be suppressed
- Infotainment displays are not displayed
- the night back light is activated for instrumentation
- the dimming of the back light is deactivated
- A static picture is shown of bus stop-mode
-All doors and roof hatches shall be displayed open in the static picture.
en:
When the trade fair mode is active,
- The menu operation shall be suppressed
- All indicator lights and sound outputs shall be suppressed
- All error messages and notes shall be suppressed
- Infotainment displays are not displayed
- the night back light is activated for instrumentation
- the dimming of the back light is deactivated
- A static picture is shown of bus stop-mode
-All doors and roof hatches shall be displayed open in the static picture.

text: If the passengers press the passenger request button, it shall be shown on the cluster. [ Notification 2138 ]
en: If the passengers press the passenger request button, it shall be shown on the cluster. [ Notification 2138 ]

text: If the fresh water tank of the kitchen is empty, the message shall be shown on the cluster [ notification 2146 ]
en: If the fresh water tank of the kitchen is empty, the message shall be shown on the cluster [ notification 2146 ]

text: If parking light is active and undervoltage is deactive , the night light mode shall activate.
en: If parking light is active and undervoltage is deactive , the night light mode shall activate.

text:
If parking light is active and undervoltage is deactive , the system shall activate.
If the parking light is deactive the system shall reset lights after 5 mins later.
If the undervoltage is activated , system shall be deactivated.
en:
If parking light is active and undervoltage is deactive , the system shall activate.
If the parking light is deactive the system shall reset lights after 5 mins later.
If the undervoltage is activated , system shall be deactivated.

text: All other information in the cluster (e.g. display of temperature, time, fuel level, mileage,...) shall be displayed in their normal state/behaviour.
en: All other information in the cluster (e.g. display of temperature, time, fuel level, mileage,...) shall be displayed in their normal state/behaviour.

text: The operation of the climate functions shall be (partially) locked in the Trade Fair Mode. The Trade Fair Mode specifically specifies air conditioning functionalities.
en: The operation of the climate functions shall be (partially) locked in the Trade Fair Mode. The Trade Fair Mode specifically specifies air conditioning functionalities.

text:
The Staircase lighting shall provide the possibility to open the lighting corresponding conditions are fullfilled:
-Ignition clamp 15 is inactive.
-Door 1 or door 2 is opened.
-Vehicle speed is less than 3 km/h .
If one of the conditions below is changed the system turn off:
-When door 1 is closed .
-Ciritical voltage status activated.
-Ignition clamp 15 is active.
-When the door 1 is open , the system shall be deactivated after 3 min.
en:
The Staircase lighting shall provide the possibility to open the lighting corresponding conditions are fullfilled:
-Ignition clamp 15 is inactive.
-Door 1 or door 2 is opened.
-Vehicle speed is less than 3 km/h .
If one of the conditions below is changed the system turn off:
-When door 1 is closed .
-Ciritical voltage status activated.
-Ignition clamp 15 is active.
-When the door 1 is open , the system shall be deactivated after 3 min.

text:
Lighting shall be activated when below the following conditions is set;
-Ignition clamp radio is activated
-Undervoltage status is deactivated
-Auto mode is deactivated
-Press the driver area button
The system shall reset lighting if one of the following condition is reset,
-Press the driver area button
en:

-Ignition clamp radio is activated
-Undervoltage status is deactivated
-Auto mode is deactivated
-Press the driver area button

-Press the driver area button

-Hostess buttons is pressed
-Auto mode is activated
en:
The system shall activate hostess knee light in yellow lighting if the one of the conditions is satisfied:
-Hostess buttons is pressed

The system shall activate hostess knee light in red lightning if the following conditions satisfied:
-Driver side Hostess button is pressed
-There is hostess call request button from passengers.

The system shall activate hostess knee light in red lightning if the following conditions satisfied:
