text:
3 minute (Hold Up)
The system shall provide the possibility to open during 3 mins(timer hold up) the lighting corresponding one of the conditions are fullfilled:
-Ignition clamp radio is turned off.
-External door button is pressed and after the opening the door.
-Radio remote remote button is pressed and after the opening the door (without ignition radio).
-Manuel mode is activated.
-Auto mode is activated.
The system shall deactivate if following one of the conditions are satisfied:
-After the 3 mins.
-External door button is pressed and after the closed the door.
-Radio remote button is pressed and after the closed the door.
-Auto mode is deactivation conditions.
en:
3 minute (Hold Up)
The system shall provide the possibility to open during 3 mins(timer hold up) the lighting corresponding one of the conditions are fullfilled:
-Ignition clamp radio is turned off.
-External door button is pressed and after the opening the door.
-Radio remote remote button is pressed and after the opening the door (without ignition radio).
-Manuel mode is activated.
-Auto mode is activated.
The system shall deactivate if following one of the conditions are satisfied:
-After the 3 mins.
-External door button is pressed and after the closed the door.
-Radio remote button is pressed and after the closed the door.
-Auto mode is deactivation conditions.

text: The system shall be activated when the external door button is pressed and after the door is opened.
en: The system shall be activated when the external door button is pressed and after the door is opened.

text: Ibis Voltage Converter Enable Parameter (IBVC_StsFctEna_P) shall be active for all requirements.
en: Ibis Voltage Converter Enable Parameter (IBVC_StsFctEna_P) shall be active for all requirements.

text:
Vehicle speed:
-When the vehicle speed above 65 km/h, the front edges of all electrically operated roof hatches should automatically be closed.This can not controlled with buttons.
-When the vehicle speed below 65 km/h, the roof hatches shall open with automatically after 10 second.
en:
Vehicle speed:
-When the vehicle speed above 65 km/h, the front edges of all electrically operated roof hatches should automatically be closed.This can not controlled with buttons.
-When the vehicle speed below 65 km/h, the roof hatches shall open with automatically after 10 second.

text: If the continuous signal and intermittent signal are activated simultaneously, then the intermittent sound has the priority.
en: If the continuous signal and intermittent signal are activated simultaneously, then the intermittent sound has the priority.

text: The buzzer signaling shall be the same for both automatic door and manual door operations.
en: The buzzer signaling shall be the same for both automatic door and manual door operations.

text: The warning lamp shall work simultaneously with buzzer for corresponding doors. If the electrical ramp is not fully closed the warning lamp shall be active (no door buzzer activation only for this case)
en: The warning lamp shall work simultaneously with buzzer for corresponding doors. If the electrical ramp is not fully closed the warning lamp shall be active (no door buzzer activation only for this case)

text: The exterior door button for driver shall wake the door system up and open/close the door by a single press.
en: The exterior door button for driver shall wake the door system up and open/close the door by a single press.

text:
The exterior door button shall open/close both door wings only for door 1.
There are two exceptions:
1. One wing is blocked by the switch on the dashboard (wing blocking switch)
2. Through the open flap with which the door wing will have collision during opening.
3. If there is two seperate buttons on the dashboard for each door 1 wings; when one wing is in the open position and the other in the closed position, the closing signal has priority for the open wing.
en:
The exterior door button shall open/close both door wings only for door 1.
There are two exceptions:
1. One wing is blocked by the switch on the dashboard (wing blocking switch)
2. Through the open flap with which the door wing will have collision during opening.
3. If there is two seperate buttons on the dashboard for each door 1 wings; when one wing is in the open position and the other in the closed position, the closing signal has priority for the open wing.

text: Opening blocking shall be applied to all the doors in the vehicle when the vehicle is driven upper than 3 km/h speed.
en: Opening blocking shall be applied to all the doors in the vehicle when the vehicle is driven upper than 3 km/h speed.

text: Only for the first door, the door wings shall be able to be blocked separately.
en: Only for the first door, the door wings shall be able to be blocked separately.

text: For the Intercity vehicle, the second door's wings shall be able to be blocked separately because of the seat opened in front of the front wing or the flap next to the first wing.
en: For the Intercity vehicle, the second door's wings shall be able to be blocked separately because of the seat opened in front of the front wing or the flap next to the first wing.

text: The auto mode for a door shall be activated by the switch above the door in workshop area. If the corresponding door has an error, the door release function shall not be activated for this door.
en: The auto mode for a door shall be activated by the switch above the door in workshop area. If the corresponding door has an error, the door release function shall not be activated for this door.

text: When the door release is activated, it shall be indicated in the bus stop menu (with green outline of the corresponding doors) and led of the button shall be activated.
en: When the door release is activated, it shall be indicated in the bus stop menu (with green outline of the corresponding doors) and led of the button shall be activated.

text: After the emergency opening, the first movement request shall be always in the closing direction.
en: After the emergency opening, the first movement request shall be always in the closing direction.

text:
When a door is in emergency mode;
- This shall be shown in the bus stop display menu
- The driver buzzer shall have a continuous sound.
- The corresponding door buzzer shall be active intermittent.
- The corresponding internal entrance light shall be permanently active.
en:
When a door is in emergency mode;
- This shall be shown in the bus stop display menu
- The driver buzzer shall have a continuous sound.
- The corresponding door buzzer shall be active intermittent.
- The corresponding internal entrance light shall be permanently active.

text: The ignition clamp reset shall not deactivate the wing blocking, if one of the wing is already blocked before ignition reset.
en: The ignition clamp reset shall not deactivate the wing blocking, if one of the wing is already blocked before ignition reset.

text: In case of any stop demand, this shall be indicated to the driver with symbols.
en: In case of any stop demand, this shall be indicated to the driver with symbols.

text:
When the emergency hammer is active,
Emergency hammer was released (notification re-appears after each clamp change).
en:
When the emergency hammer is active,
Emergency hammer was released (notification re-appears after each clamp change).

text: The buttons shall have full functionality regardless of the door position and door release. This means that they shall be able to be used when the door status is open, close, opening or closing.
en: The buttons shall have full functionality regardless of the door position and door release. This means that they shall be able to be used when the door status is open, close, opening or closing.

text:
For the doors configured as automatic, the active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- After using the pram driver button (reset function).
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition (radio).
- Occurring an error on the corresponding door.
- When the corresponding door "closed" status appears.
- When the "all doors closed" status appears, if the door is out of service, e.g. overnight locking system (lock with the microswitch in the door leaves) or local mode is active.
en:
For the doors configured as automatic, the active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- After using the pram driver button (reset function).
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition (radio).
- Occurring an error on the corresponding door.
- When the corresponding door "closed" status appears.
- When the "all doors closed" status appears, if the door is out of service, e.g. overnight locking system (lock with the microswitch in the door leaves) or local mode is active.

text: - In case when the door is opened in automatic mode and the automatic closing process is interrupted, closing the door by the driver shall be possible by pram driver button pressing (reset function)
en: - In case when the door is opened in automatic mode and the automatic closing process is interrupted, closing the door by the driver shall be possible by pram driver button pressing (reset function)

text: If the door is opened in manual mode by the driver, the button does not affect the behaviour of the door.
en: If the door is opened in manual mode by the driver, the button does not affect the behaviour of the door.

text:
The buttons shall have additional "Simulation mode" functionality. When all the conditions below are fulfilled:
- Ignition switch in "clamp15" position.
- Engine simulation mode is active.
This mode is used only to test the signal from the button. Pressing the button activates the acoustic (buzzer or bell for the driver and optical notification as wheelchair symbol) for 500 ms . In this mode, the button has no effect on the behaviour of the door (e.g. opening).
en:
The buttons shall have additional "Simulation mode" functionality. When all the conditions below are fulfilled:
- Ignition switch in "clamp15" position.
- Engine simulation mode is active.
This mode is used only to test the signal from the button. Pressing the button activates the acoustic (buzzer or bell for the driver and optical notification as wheelchair symbol) for 500 ms . In this mode, the button has no effect on the behaviour of the door (e.g. opening).

text:
When the emergency hammer is deactivated,
Ok button pressed (notification disappears until next clamp change) or 20 seconds after emergency hammer was inserted again.
en:
When the emergency hammer is deactivated,
Ok button pressed (notification disappears until next clamp change) or 20 seconds after emergency hammer was inserted again.

text: Pram button is used to inform the driver that a person with a baby-stroller wants to get in/out of the vehicle.
en: Pram button is used to inform the driver that a person with a baby-stroller wants to get in/out of the vehicle.

text:
Locations of the button may be :
1. Passenger compartment - The button is located in a special designed area of the door 2 - it can be a standalone button or in the form of a single button with dual functionality (one button with two symbols wheelchair and pram). In articulated vehicles the button can be additionally located at door 3 area.
2. Outside the vehicle - In the area of door 2, the button is only available as a single button with dual functionality (one button with two symbols wheelchair and pram). In articulated vehicles the button can be additionally located at door 3 area.
en:
Locations of the button may be :
1. Passenger compartment - The button is located in a special designed area of the door 2 - it can be a standalone button or in the form of a single button with dual functionality (one button with two symbols wheelchair and pram). In articulated vehicles the button can be additionally located at door 3 area.
2. Outside the vehicle - In the area of door 2, the button is only available as a single button with dual functionality (one button with two symbols wheelchair and pram). In articulated vehicles the button can be additionally located at door 3 area.

text: Buttons are assigned to specific doors. This means that they shall only affect the corresponding door (for example, door 2) and other doors shall not be affected by the functionality of the buttons.
en: Buttons are assigned to specific doors. This means that they shall only affect the corresponding door (for example, door 2) and other doors shall not be affected by the functionality of the buttons.

text: The buttons have full functionality regardless of the door position and door release. They shall be usable when the door status is: open, close, opening or closing.
en: The buttons have full functionality regardless of the door position and door release. They shall be usable when the door status is: open, close, opening or closing.

text: When the "20 Uhr" (Deactivation of the external opening buttons) function is active, the external button only sends a notification to the driver and does not open the door.
en: When the "20 Uhr" (Deactivation of the external opening buttons) function is active, the external button only sends a notification to the driver and does not open the door.

text: If the door has been opened in manual mode by the driver, the button does not affect the behaviour of the door. It shall only send a driver notification to the cluster.
en: If the door has been opened in manual mode by the driver, the button does not affect the behaviour of the door. It shall only send a driver notification to the cluster.

text:
For the doors configured as automatic mode, the active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- After using the pram set-reset driver button (reset function).
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition (radio).
- Detection of an error from corresponding door.
- When the "all doors closed" status appears if the door is out of service, e.g. overnight locking system (lock with the microswitch in the door leaves) or local mode is active.
en:
For the doors configured as automatic mode, the active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- After using the pram set-reset driver button (reset function).
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition (radio).
- Detection of an error from corresponding door.
- When the "all doors closed" status appears if the door is out of service, e.g. overnight locking system (lock with the microswitch in the door leaves) or local mode is active.

text: The buzzer shall be able to operate both during the movement (Closing/Opening) OR before the movement (Open/Close).
en: The buzzer shall be able to operate both during the movement (Closing/Opening) OR before the movement (Open/Close).

text: The button shall be a standalone button or in the form of a single button with dual functionality (one button with two symbols wheelchair and pram).
en: The button shall be a standalone button or in the form of a single button with dual functionality (one button with two symbols wheelchair and pram).

text: Buttons are assigned to specific doors. They shall only affect the corresponding door (for example, button located in area of door 2 shall only affect door 2) and other doors shall not be affected by the functionality of the buttons.
en: Buttons are assigned to specific doors. They shall only affect the corresponding door (for example, button located in area of door 2 shall only affect door 2) and other doors shall not be affected by the functionality of the buttons.

text: The buttons shall have standard functionality regardless of the door position and door release. They shall be able to be used when the corresponding door status is: open, close, opening or closing.
en: The buttons shall have standard functionality regardless of the door position and door release. They shall be able to be used when the corresponding door status is: open, close, opening or closing.

text: Acoustic warning to passengers only occurs if the button has an internal buzzer (hardware solution).
en: Acoustic warning to passengers only occurs if the button has an internal buzzer (hardware solution).

text:
If the corresponding door is operating in automatic mode then these buttons have additional functionality:
- The button shall send a signal to open the door as soon as the door release is activated (the signal can also be sent when the door is during closing by automatic mode.
- The button shall deactivate the automatic door closing process and the door shall stay in the open position (even if the door was opened with another button by the passenger).
en:
If the corresponding door is operating in automatic mode then these buttons have additional functionality:
- The button shall send a signal to open the door as soon as the door release is activated (the signal can also be sent when the door is during closing by automatic mode.
- The button shall deactivate the automatic door closing process and the door shall stay in the open position (even if the door was opened with another button by the passenger).

text:
If the corresponding door is operating in semi-automatic mode then these buttons have additional functionality:
- Sends a signal to open the door as soon as the door release is activated.
en:
If the corresponding door is operating in semi-automatic mode then these buttons have additional functionality:
- Sends a signal to open the door as soon as the door release is activated.

text: When the "20 Uhr" (Deactivation of the outside opening buttons) function is active, the external button only sends a notification to the driver and does not open the door.
en: When the "20 Uhr" (Deactivation of the outside opening buttons) function is active, the external button only sends a notification to the driver and does not open the door.

text: In "waiting room" (Wartesaal) mode, the button shall open the automatic door and close it after about 10 seconds, automatically.
en: In "waiting room" (Wartesaal) mode, the button shall open the automatic door and close it after about 10 seconds, automatically.

text:
Door configured as automatic - active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- After using the pram driver button (reset function).
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition (radio).
- Occurring error on the corresponding door.
- When the corresponding door "closed" status appears.
- When the "all doors closed" status appears - if the door is out of service, e.g. overnight locking system (lock with the microswitch in the door leaves) or local mode is active, simultaneously.
en:
Door configured as automatic - active notifications shall be reset by one of the conditions:
- After using the pram driver button (reset function).
- Turning off the vehicle's ignition (radio).
- Occurring error on the corresponding door.
- When the corresponding door "closed" status appears.
- When the "all doors closed" status appears - if the door is out of service, e.g. overnight locking system (lock with the microswitch in the door leaves) or local mode is active, simultaneously.

text: Stop demand signal activates a pictogram on driver dashboard and a single sound on driver buzzer
en: Stop demand signal activates a pictogram on driver dashboard and a single sound on driver buzzer

text: When the emergency hammer is disengaged, info notification "emergency hammer released" shall be shown on the cluster. [ Notification 2156 ].
en: When the emergency hammer is disengaged, info notification "emergency hammer released" shall be shown on the cluster. [ Notification 2156 ].

text: The system shall held additional button, handbrake, bus stop emergency and ignition radio unlocking request for 5 seconds.
en: The system shall held additional button, handbrake, bus stop emergency and ignition radio unlocking request for 5 seconds.

text: In the ignition radio position, If the driver area door is opened and the park brake is not engaged, the driver buzzer should be turned on.
en: In the ignition radio position, If the driver area door is opened and the park brake is not engaged, the driver buzzer should be turned on.

text: When a fire alarm is detected in the vehicle, the driver area door shall be unlocked immediately without any delay.
en: When a fire alarm is detected in the vehicle, the driver area door shall be unlocked immediately without any delay.

text: When the emergency bus stop brake switch is deactivated (when "notlöse schalter" is used), the driver area door shall be unlocked.
en: When the emergency bus stop brake switch is deactivated (when "notlöse schalter" is used), the driver area door shall be unlocked.

text: The system shall set the installation status of the doors in the vehicle by the parameter in remark.
en: The system shall set the installation status of the doors in the vehicle by the parameter in remark.

text:
The buttons shall have additional "Exhibition mode" functionality.
- The green backlight will be active constantly.
- Pressing the button activates the acoustic notification (buzzer or bell for the driver) for 500 ms and optical notification for 3s (Wheelchair symbol on the dashboard) and 500 ms flashing the stop request symbol on the dashboard, stop request board/monitor for passengers).
en:
The buttons shall have additional "Exhibition mode" functionality.
- The green backlight will be active constantly.
- Pressing the button activates the acoustic notification (buzzer or bell for the driver) for 500 ms and optical notification for 3s (Wheelchair symbol on the dashboard) and 500 ms flashing the stop request symbol on the dashboard, stop request board/monitor for passengers).

text: "Waiting room" - a mode in which passengers can enter/exit the vehicle without the presence of the driver in the vehicle.
en: "Waiting room" - a mode in which passengers can enter/exit the vehicle without the presence of the driver in the vehicle.

text: Waiting room functionality shall provide the power supply for the door system for the passenger boarding even in ignition level is clamp 30.
en: Waiting room functionality shall provide the power supply for the door system for the passenger boarding even in ignition level is clamp 30.

text: Waiting Room Mode deactivation If ignition radio shall be activated anytime or time defined by a parameter has ended
en: Waiting Room Mode deactivation If ignition radio shall be activated anytime or time defined by a parameter has ended

text: Waiting Room Mode shall be activated If Waiting room button shall be pressed when ignition is in minimum radio position and ignition radio shall be turned off within 30 seconds
en: Waiting Room Mode shall be activated If Waiting room button shall be pressed when ignition is in minimum radio position and ignition radio shall be turned off within 30 seconds

text: Waiting Room Button LED: If waiting room button has not been pressed, button LED shall remain off
en: Waiting Room Button LED: If waiting room button has not been pressed, button LED shall remain off

text: If waiting room mode is deactivated and button is pressed, LED shall flash with a frequency of 200/800ms until the function is activated.
en: If waiting room mode is deactivated and button is pressed, LED shall flash with a frequency of 200/800ms until the function is activated.

text: If waiting room mode is active, LED shall continuously light.
en: If waiting room mode is active, LED shall continuously light.

text: When the manual ramp is opened, wheelchair symbol shall be shown on cluster until the manual ramp is closed.
en: When the manual ramp is opened, wheelchair symbol shall be shown on cluster until the manual ramp is closed.

text: The activation of the trade fair mode shall be parametrisable.
en: The activation of the trade fair mode shall be parametrisable.

text:
CANCELLED.
There will be 2 steps of ventilation in the luggage area.
en:
CANCELLED.
There will be 2 steps of ventilation in the luggage area.

text:
The first step of ventilation shall be active if all the following conditions are met:
- Engine is active.
- Exhibition mode is inactive.
en:
The first step of ventilation shall be active if all the following conditions are met:
- Engine is active.
- Exhibition mode is inactive.

text: The second step of ventilation shall be active if vehicle speed is greater than 90 km/h.
en: The second step of ventilation shall be active if vehicle speed is greater than 90 km/h.

text: The second step of ventilation shall be inactive if vehicle speed is lower than 80 km/h.
en: The second step of ventilation shall be inactive if vehicle speed is lower than 80 km/h.

text: If the parameter is defined, the system shall unlock all doors upon activation of ignition clamp 15. However, it shall remain possible to lock the vehicle while the ignition is active.
en: If the parameter is defined, the system shall unlock all doors upon activation of ignition clamp 15. However, it shall remain possible to lock the vehicle while the ignition is active.

text: reverse camera requirements
en: reverse camera requirements

text:
IBMO_StRvdcmrSbx shall be active, if all of the following conditions are satisfied when the vehicle has splitbox ;
- First of all Enable parameter of ibis monitor model (IBMO_StsFctEna_P) is active.
-IBV_StIbisRvsgCmraAcv (req:2024.10444 ) is active.
-IBP_StsIbisWoutRvdcmr_P(KSW parameter) and IBMO_StsIbisMoniOffAtSpdBtn_P(KSW parameter) are not active.
en:
IBMO_StRvdcmrSbx shall be active, if all of the following conditions are satisfied when the vehicle has splitbox ;
- First of all Enable parameter of ibis monitor model (IBMO_StsFctEna_P) is active.
-IBV_StIbisRvsgCmraAcv (req:2024.10444 ) is active.
-IBP_StsIbisWoutRvdcmr_P(KSW parameter) and IBMO_StsIbisMoniOffAtSpdBtn_P(KSW parameter) are not active.

text:
The system shall activate the lift release, If all of the conditions below are fulfilled:
* Lift release button is pressed.
* Vehicle is standstill.
* Park brake is active.
* Ignition state is KL15.
* Engine is running.
* Voltage level is not in low level.
* Exhibition mode is not active.
* Vehicle is in normal level (ECAS System).
* Opening blocking on the corresponding door is not active for Intercity.
* The corresponding door is open for Intercity.
en:
The system shall activate the lift release, If all of the conditions below are fulfilled:
* Lift release button is pressed.
* Vehicle is standstill.
* Park brake is active.
* Ignition state is KL15.
* Engine is running.
* Voltage level is not in low level.
* Exhibition mode is not active.
* Vehicle is in normal level (ECAS System).
* Opening blocking on the corresponding door is not active for Intercity.
* The corresponding door is open for Intercity.

text:
The system shall deactivate the lift release, If all of the conditions below are fulfilled:
* Lift release button is pressed.
* Lift is retracted.
* Lift door is closed.
en:
The system shall deactivate the lift release, If all of the conditions below are fulfilled:
* Lift release button is pressed.
* Lift is retracted.
* Lift door is closed.

text:
The system shall deactivate the lift release if one of the following conditions is met :
* Parking brake is disengaged when the lift door is closed.
* Engine is stopped when the lift door is closed.
* Vehicle is driven off.
* Voltage level is in critical level.
en:
The system shall deactivate the lift release if one of the following conditions is met :
* Parking brake is disengaged when the lift door is closed.
* Engine is stopped when the lift door is closed.
* Vehicle is driven off.
* Voltage level is in critical level.

text:
CANCELLED
The system shall provide visual information to the driver and passengers, If the wheelchair stop button is pressed.
en:
CANCELLED
The system shall provide visual information to the driver and passengers, If the wheelchair stop button is pressed.

text: The system shall activate the bus stop brake request, If the lift is released.
en: The system shall activate the bus stop brake request, If the lift is released.

text: The system shall activate the wheelchair lift warning lights, If the lift is released.
en: The system shall activate the wheelchair lift warning lights, If the lift is released.

text:
The system shall unlock pneumatic locks, If all of the conditions below are fulfilled :
* Vehicle is standstill.
* Parking brake is engaged.
* Ignition state is in KL15.
* Lift is released.
* Battery voltage level is not low.
* Exhibition mode is not active.
en:
The system shall unlock pneumatic locks, If all of the conditions below are fulfilled :
* Vehicle is standstill.
* Parking brake is engaged.
* Ignition state is in KL15.
* Lift is released.
* Battery voltage level is not low.
* Exhibition mode is not active.

text:
The system shall lock pneumatic locks when the lift door is closed and one of the conditions below is fulfilled :
* The lift release is deactivated.
* Ignition is turned off.
* The vehicle speed exceeds 1 km/h
en:
The system shall lock pneumatic locks when the lift door is closed and one of the conditions below is fulfilled :
* The lift release is deactivated.
* Ignition is turned off.
* The vehicle speed exceeds 1 km/h

text:
The lift functionallity in exhibition mode shall be :
* Wheelchair external button shall be activated.
* Lift shall be released.
* Lift warning light shall be activated.
* Lift door locks shall be unlocked.
en:
The lift functionallity in exhibition mode shall be :
* Wheelchair external button shall be activated.
* Lift shall be released.
* Lift warning light shall be activated.
* Lift door locks shall be unlocked.

text:
Lift door error shall be shown in the display if one of conditions below is met;
* Lift is not released but the lift door is open.
* Lift is not released and the vehicle speed is above 1 km/h but the lift door is open.
* Lift door is not closed when the vehicle speed is above 1 km/h.
* One of door locks is unlocked when the vehicle speed is above 1 km/h.
* Lift door open and closed information is not active.
* Lift locked and unlocked information is not active.
* The emergency relay is activated while the lift is in the retracted position.
en:
Lift door error shall be shown in the display if one of conditions below is met;
* Lift is not released but the lift door is open.
* Lift is not released and the vehicle speed is above 1 km/h but the lift door is open.
* Lift door is not closed when the vehicle speed is above 1 km/h.
* One of door locks is unlocked when the vehicle speed is above 1 km/h.
* Lift door open and closed information is not active.
* Lift locked and unlocked information is not active.
* The emergency relay is activated while the lift is in the retracted position.

text:
Lift error shall be shown in the display if one of conditions below is met;
* Lift is not released but the lift is extracted.
* Lift is not released and the vehicle speed is above 1 km/h but the lift is extracted.
* Lift emergency button is pressed.
en:
Lift error shall be shown in the display if one of conditions below is met;
* Lift is not released but the lift is extracted.
* Lift is not released and the vehicle speed is above 1 km/h but the lift is extracted.
* Lift emergency button is pressed.

text: The system shall provide a possibility to have a visualisation on the bus stop menu of the driver display for status of the lift.
en: The system shall provide a possibility to have a visualisation on the bus stop menu of the driver display for status of the lift.

text: Opening & closing blockade shall be active in case of any of doors is in local mode or emergency mode.
en: Opening & closing blockade shall be active in case of any of doors is in local mode or emergency mode.

text: Opening blocking shall be active if vehicle body gateway ECU or door controller ECU is not transmitting rolling counter on the CAN line.
en: Opening blocking shall be active if vehicle body gateway ECU or door controller ECU is not transmitting rolling counter on the CAN line.

text:
IBV_AcvIbisRvsgCmraAcvn_O shall be active, if all of the following conditions are satisfied;
- First of all Enable parameter of ibis video model (IBV_StsFctEna_P) is active.
-IBV_StIbisRvsgCmraBtnOn (req:2024.10447 ) or GW_StRvsGearEngd is active.
-GW_StClmpRdo is active.
en:
IBV_AcvIbisRvsgCmraAcvn_O shall be active, if all of the following conditions are satisfied;
- First of all Enable parameter of ibis video model (IBV_StsFctEna_P) is active.
-IBV_StIbisRvsgCmraBtnOn (req:2024.10447 ) or GW_StRvsGearEngd is active.
-GW_StClmpRdo is active.

text:
IBMO_StMoni1Cmra shall be active, if all of the following conditions are satisfied;
- First of all Enable parameter of ibis monitor model (IBMO_StsFctEna_P) is active.
- IBP_StMoniCtlInp_P parameter is active.
- GW_StRvsGearEngd is active.
en:
IBMO_StMoni1Cmra shall be active, if all of the following conditions are satisfied;
- First of all Enable parameter of ibis monitor model (IBMO_StsFctEna_P) is active.
- IBP_StMoniCtlInp_P parameter is active.
- GW_StRvsGearEngd is active.

text: The telephone power supply in the sleeping cabin shall be activated, as long as the ignition clamp 15 is active.
en: The telephone power supply in the sleeping cabin shall be activated, as long as the ignition clamp 15 is active.

text: Half-automatic mode shall be enabled with the door release button activation by the driver.
en: Half-automatic mode shall be enabled with the door release button activation by the driver.

text: If automatic mode switch is active on top of the corresponding door (workshop area), then the manual control of the driver shall not be available for that door.
en: If automatic mode switch is active on top of the corresponding door (workshop area), then the manual control of the driver shall not be available for that door.

text: If forced closing functionallity is not activated at the vehicle, then the driver shall have possibility to reset the emergency mode by using the corresponding door manual driver button.
en: If forced closing functionallity is not activated at the vehicle, then the driver shall have possibility to reset the emergency mode by using the corresponding door manual driver button.

text: Closing the corresponding door only one time by the driver manual control buttons after emergency mode reset, shall be possible when the door is in automatic mode. (if forced closing functionallity is not active)
en: Closing the corresponding door only one time by the driver manual control buttons after emergency mode reset, shall be possible when the door is in automatic mode. (if forced closing functionallity is not active)

text: If the driver has no manual control button, then closing the door shall be possible for the driver over emergency mode reset/refill button for only one time after emergency reset. (In automatic mode when forced closing functionallity is not active.)
en: If the driver has no manual control button, then closing the door shall be possible for the driver over emergency mode reset/refill button for only one time after emergency reset. (In automatic mode when forced closing functionallity is not active.)

text: When the manual ramp is opened, the bus stop brake request shall be activated until the manual ramp is closed.
en: When the manual ramp is opened, the bus stop brake request shall be activated until the manual ramp is closed.

text: If the manual ramp under door X is not closed and the door X is closed, the opening blockage of door X shall be activated.
en: If the manual ramp under door X is not closed and the door X is closed, the opening blockage of door X shall be activated.

text: For the activation of the ramp functionality, MR_CfgFctEnaNv and MR_StDoorXRampInstdNv should be installed.
en: For the activation of the ramp functionality, MR_CfgFctEnaNv and MR_StDoorXRampInstdNv should be installed.

text: The emergency button power shall be fed by directly ignition clamp 15 or Exhibition mode activation.
en: The emergency button power shall be fed by directly ignition clamp 15 or Exhibition mode activation.

text:
If all of the conditions below are fulfilled, the toilet ventilation shall be active:
-The toilet system is active.
-Toilet is occupied.
-There is no under voltage condition.
Remark: The toilet ventilation shall remain active for 3 mins more after the toilet gets free.
en:
If all of the conditions below are fulfilled, the toilet ventilation shall be active:
-The toilet system is active.
-Toilet is occupied.
-There is no under voltage condition.
remark: Remark: The toilet ventilation shall remain active for 3 mins more after the toilet gets free.

text: When ignition radio is not active then pressing the external door button, the system shall activate during 20 s.
en: When ignition radio is not active then pressing the external door button, the system shall activate during 20 s.

text: If the wing blocking button is used, the main door 1 button shall only control the wing which is not blocked.
en: If the wing blocking button is used, the main door 1 button shall only control the wing which is not blocked.

text: If the steering wheel is rotated to the right hand side minimum 30 degree then opening blocking shall be activated for the rear wing.
en: If the steering wheel is rotated to the right hand side minimum 30 degree then opening blocking shall be activated for the rear wing.

text: If the corresponding door is in auto mode, then the system shall provide to close the door for only one time by pressing driver manual door control button after emergency refill.
en: If the corresponding door is in auto mode, then the system shall provide to close the door for only one time by pressing driver manual door control button after emergency refill.

text: If there is seperate emergency reset (refill) button is placed on the driver working place, when any of doors in the vehicle is in emergency mode then this refill button illumination shall blink 250 ms ON / 250 ms OFF.
en: If there is seperate emergency reset (refill) button is placed on the driver working place, when any of doors in the vehicle is in emergency mode then this refill button illumination shall blink 250 ms ON / 250 ms OFF.

text:
The system shall provide the possibility to deactivate Luggage Room Front Lights and shall turn off Luggage Room Lighting Schalter yellow LED if all below conditions are fulfilled:
-The driver shall press Luggage Room Lighting Schalter.
-The vehicle speed shall not be less than 3 km/h.
-Undervoltege conditions is present.
-Ignition KL50 shall be inactive for more than 3 seconds.
en:
The system shall provide the possibility to deactivate Luggage Room Front Lights and shall turn off Luggage Room Lighting Schalter yellow LED if all below conditions are fulfilled:
-The driver shall press Luggage Room Lighting Schalter.
-The vehicle speed shall not be less than 3 km/h.
-Undervoltege conditions is present.
-Ignition KL50 shall be inactive for more than 3 seconds.

text:
The system shall provide the possibility to activate Luggage Room Mid, Left and Right Lights if all below conditions are fulfilled:
-Right or Left Flaps shall be open.
-The vehicle speed shall be less than 3 km/h.
-Undervoltege conditions is not present.
-Ignition KL50 shall not be inactive for more than 3 seconds.
en:
The system shall provide the possibility to activate Luggage Room Mid, Left and Right Lights if all below conditions are fulfilled:
-Right or Left Flaps shall be open.
-The vehicle speed shall be less than 3 km/h.
-Undervoltege conditions is not present.
-Ignition KL50 shall not be inactive for more than 3 seconds.

text:
The system shall provide the possibility to deactivate Luggage Room Mid, Left and Right Lights if all below conditions are fulfilled:
-Right or Left Flaps shall not be open.
-The vehicle speed shall not be less than 3 km/h.
-Undervoltege conditions is present.
-Ignition KL50 shall be inactive for more than 3 seconds.
en:
The system shall provide the possibility to deactivate Luggage Room Mid, Left and Right Lights if all below conditions are fulfilled:
-Right or Left Flaps shall not be open.
-The vehicle speed shall not be less than 3 km/h.
-Undervoltege conditions is present.
-Ignition KL50 shall be inactive for more than 3 seconds.

text: The system shall close all the doors which are not in "closed" status, when the vehicle drives off.
en: The system shall close all the doors which are not in "closed" status, when the vehicle drives off.

text: The system shall generate a buzzer request when at least one door is not in "closed" status until it is closed fully when the vehicle drives off.
en: The system shall generate a buzzer request when at least one door is not in "closed" status until it is closed fully when the vehicle drives off.

text: The system shall create an closing blockade when the corresponding door which, the manual ramp is installed, is opened and manual ramp is opened.
en: The system shall create an closing blockade when the corresponding door which, the manual ramp is installed, is opened and manual ramp is opened.

text: The system shall create an opening blockade when the corresponding door which, the manual ramp is installed, is closed and manual ramp is opened.
en: The system shall create an opening blockade when the corresponding door which, the manual ramp is installed, is closed and manual ramp is opened.

text: The system shall lead opening/closing requests in exhibition mode.
en: The system shall lead opening/closing requests in exhibition mode.

text: The system shall open all of the doors when one of the driver manual door control buttons is pressed, if there is active fire alarm.
en: The system shall open all of the doors when one of the driver manual door control buttons is pressed, if there is active fire alarm.

text:
The Staircase lighting shall provide the possibility to open the lighting corresponding conditions are fullfilled:
-Internal light function shall be activated.
-Door 1 is open.
-Cirticalvoltage status not activated.
en:
The Staircase lighting shall provide the possibility to open the lighting corresponding conditions are fullfilled:
-Internal light function shall be activated.
-Door 1 is open.
-Cirticalvoltage status not activated.

text: The system shall generate closing blockades for all the doors once they are opened, if there is active fire alarm.
en: The system shall generate closing blockades for all the doors once they are opened, if there is active fire alarm.

text: The system shall open all the doors automatically once the vehicle stops, if there is active fire alarm.
en: The system shall open all the doors automatically once the vehicle stops, if there is active fire alarm.

text:
If one of the conditions below is activated the system shall turn on:
-Exbition mode.
-Internal Night ECE107.
en:
If one of the conditions below is activated the system shall turn on:
-Exbition mode.
-Internal Night ECE107.

text:
The StepEdge lighting shall be activated under the following condition ;
1. Ignition clamp 15 is activate, and criticalvoltage is not active
2. If the ignition 15 is off, Door 2 is closed , speed is less than 3km/h, and criticalvoltage is not activate, the lighting shall be activate during 3 min.
3. If cleaning mode is active and criticalvoltage is not active, the Step Edge lighting shall be activated.
en:
The StepEdge lighting shall be activated under the following condition ;
1. Ignition clamp 15 is activate, and criticalvoltage is not active
2. If the ignition 15 is off, Door 2 is closed , speed is less than 3km/h, and criticalvoltage is not activate, the lighting shall be activate during 3 min.
3. If cleaning mode is active and criticalvoltage is not active, the Step Edge lighting shall be activated.

text:
The system shall activate the ramp extension request, If all of the conditions below are fulfilled :
- The ramp with kneeling button is pressed.
- Ignition level is minimum KL15.
- Bus speed is lower than 1 km/h.
- Ramp key switch is in position 1.
- The ramp is not extended.
- Parking brake is active.
- Corresponding door is closed.
- There is no fault at the corresponding door.
- Position of vehicle is at lower level.
en:
The system shall activate the ramp extension request, If all of the conditions below are fulfilled :
- The ramp with kneeling button is pressed.
- Ignition level is minimum KL15.
- Bus speed is lower than 1 km/h.
- Ramp key switch is in position 1.
- The ramp is not extended.
- Parking brake is active.
- Corresponding door is closed.
- There is no fault at the corresponding door.
- Position of vehicle is at lower level.

text:
The system shall activate the ramp retraction request, If all of the conditions below are fulfilled :
- The ramp with kneeling button is pressed.
- Ignition level is minimum KL15.
- Bus speed is lower than 1 km/h.
- Ramp key switch is in position 1.
- The ramp is extended.
- Parking brake is active.
- Corresponding door is closed.
- There is no fault at the corresponding door.
- Position of vehicle is at lower level.
en:
The system shall activate the ramp retraction request, If all of the conditions below are fulfilled :
- The ramp with kneeling button is pressed.
- Ignition level is minimum KL15.
- Bus speed is lower than 1 km/h.
- Ramp key switch is in position 1.
- The ramp is extended.
- Parking brake is active.
- Corresponding door is closed.
- There is no fault at the corresponding door.
- Position of vehicle is at lower level.

text: When the ramp is fully extended, the ramp button LED shall remain continuously illuminated.
en: When the ramp is fully extended, the ramp button LED shall remain continuously illuminated.

text: When the ramp is in motion, the ramp button LED shall blink.
en: When the ramp is in motion, the ramp button LED shall blink.

text: When the system sends a lowering request, the button LED shall be active until the position of vehicle reaches the lower level.
en: When the system sends a lowering request, the button LED shall be active until the position of vehicle reaches the lower level.

text: If exhibition mode is activated, the night lights shall be activated automatically and can not be controlled by driver.
en: If exhibition mode is activated, the night lights shall be activated automatically and can not be controlled by driver.

text:
The system shall be able to activate the Night Light if vehicle is not in the under voltage condition and one of the following conditions are true:
-The driver shall enable night lights by night lights button.
- Parking Light shall be active.
en:
The system shall be able to activate the Night Light if vehicle is not in the under voltage condition and one of the following conditions are true:
-The driver shall enable night lights by night lights button.
- Parking Light shall be active.

text:
The system shall be able to deactivate the Night Light if one of the following conditions are true:
-The driver shall disable night lights by night lights button.
- Parking Light shall be deactivated.
-One of the interior lightning zone is active.
en:
The system shall be able to deactivate the Night Light if one of the following conditions are true:
-The driver shall disable night lights by night lights button.
- Parking Light shall be deactivated.
-One of the interior lightning zone is active.

text:
The system shall be able to deactivate the Night Light if one of the following conditions are true:
-The driver shall disable night lights by night lights button.
- Parking Light shall be deactivated.
en:
The system shall be able to deactivate the Night Light if one of the following conditions are true:
-The driver shall disable night lights by night lights button.
- Parking Light shall be deactivated.

text:
The system shall provide possibility open the lightings if all below conditions are fulfilled;
-Ignition clamp 15 shall be active.
-Parking light shall be active.
-Doors shall be open or released.
-Lighting button shall be pressed.
If the parking light is deactivated or lighting button is pressed again, the system shall be turned off.
en:
The system shall provide possibility open the lightings if all below conditions are fulfilled;
-Ignition clamp 15 shall be active.
-Parking light shall be active.
-Doors shall be open or released.
-Lighting button shall be pressed.
If the parking light is deactivated or lighting button is pressed again, the system shall be turned off.

text: When the bus speed above 3km/h, the system shall be turn off.

text:
The working logic of the FAP system shall be defined as follows.
-Button is pressed on a pin connected to an EIO module.
-The Pin Manager detects this and prepares a signal.
-This signal is sent to the FAP system module.
-FAP system checks the bus type and decides what output action to take.
-If required, it sends a signal to the corresponding output pin — in this case, to turn on an LED.
en:
The working logic of the FAP system shall be defined as follows.
-Button is pressed on a pin connected to an EIO module.
-The Pin Manager detects this and prepares a signal.
-This signal is sent to the FAP system module.
-FAP system checks the bus type and decides what output action to take.
-If required, it sends a signal to the corresponding output pin — in this case, to turn on an LED.

text: FAP system assigns the received button information to the signal Function_EIO_BXX_No_XX by using the mapping parameters Function_EIO_BXX_No_XXNv.
en: FAP system assigns the received button information to the signal Function_EIO_BXX_No_XX by using the mapping parameters Function_EIO_BXX_No_XXNv.

text:
The value within the mapping parameters (Function_EIO_BXX_No_XXNv) represents different meanings depending on its digit position. The format of the parameter is as follows:
Example: XYYZZW
X: The first digit indicates from which EIO the button information is received.
YY: The second and third digits indicate which socket is used.
ZZ: The fourth and fifth digits indicate which pin is used.
W : The sixth digit indicates the type of input— 0 for a taster,1 for a schalter.
en:
The value within the mapping parameters (Function_EIO_BXX_No_XXNv) represents different meanings depending on its digit position. The format of the parameter is as follows:
Example: XYYZZW
X: The first digit indicates from which EIO the button information is received.
YY: The second and third digits indicate which socket is used.
ZZ: The fourth and fifth digits indicate which pin is used.
W : The sixth digit indicates the type of input— 0 for a taster,1 for a schalter.

text:
Based on the LED value LED_BXX_No_XX received from the FAP Manager the FAP system generates an LED and sends it to corresponding EIO's Pin Manager.
-Value 0 : LED output is always OFF
-Values 4 / 8 / 12 : LED output is always ON
-Values 1 / 5 / 9 : LED blinks with 200ms ON and 800ms OFF
-Values 2 / 6 / 10 : LED blinks with 250ms ON and 250ms OFF
-Values 3 / 7 / 11 : LED blinks with 800ms ON and 200ms OFF
en:
Based on the LED value LED_BXX_No_XX received from the FAP Manager the FAP system generates an LED and sends it to corresponding EIO's Pin Manager.
-Value 0 : LED output is always OFF
-Values 4 / 8 / 12 : LED output is always ON
-Values 1 / 5 / 9 : LED blinks with 200ms ON and 800ms OFF
-Values 2 / 6 / 10 : LED blinks with 250ms ON and 250ms OFF
-Values 3 / 7 / 11 : LED blinks with 800ms ON and 200ms OFF

text:
The system shall unlock the doors if any of the following conditions are met:
- The ignition clamp 15 is active and the doors are locked and no door error is present and the central locking taster is pressed.
- A door unlock request is received.
- The doors are locked and the vehicle speed exceeds 3 km/h.
- The doors are locked and the ECR button is pressed.
en:
The system shall unlock the doors if any of the following conditions are met:
- The ignition clamp 15 is active and the doors are locked and no door error is present and the central locking taster is pressed.
- A door unlock request is received.
- The doors are locked and the vehicle speed exceeds 3 km/h.
- The doors are locked and the ECR button is pressed.

text:
The system shall lock the doors when the vehicle is not in Exhibition Mode and provided that any of the following conditions are met:
- The ignition clamp 15 is inactive and all doors are closed and any door button on the remote controller is pressed.
- The ignition clamp 15 is active and all doors are closed and unlocked and the vehicle speed is below 1 km/h and the central locking taster is pressed.
en:
The system shall lock the doors when the vehicle is not in Exhibition Mode and provided that any of the following conditions are met:
- The ignition clamp 15 is inactive and all doors are closed and any door button on the remote controller is pressed.
- The ignition clamp 15 is active and all doors are closed and unlocked and the vehicle speed is below 1 km/h and the central locking taster is pressed.

en: If the ignition clamp 15 is active and not all doors are closed and the central locking taster is pressed, the taster LED shall blink for 2 seconds with a pattern of 200 ms on / 800 ms off.

en: The central locking taster LED shall remain off when the doors are locked. When the doors are unlocked, the LED shall be continuously illuminated.

en: If the ignition clamp 15 is inactive and the doors are locked via the remote controller, the hazard lights shall blink for 2 seconds.

en: If the ignition clamp 15 is inactive and the doors are unlocked via the remote controller, the hazard lights shall blink for 1 seconds.

- Vehicle speed exceeds 3 km/h.

en:

en: If the Central Locking Luggage Taster is pressed to request unlocking, the system shall activate a luggage auto-open flag, unless the button is pressed again to cancel the request.

text: If the luggages are automatically locked due to the vehicle speed exceeding 3 km/h while the luggage auto-open flag is active, the system shall automatically unlock the luggages when the vehicle stops and any door is opened.
en: If the luggages are automatically locked due to the vehicle speed exceeding 3 km/h while the luggage auto-open flag is active, the system shall automatically unlock the luggages when the vehicle stops and any door is opened.

text: If the luggages are automatically locked after all doors are closed and locked while the luggage auto-open flag is active, the system shall automatically unlock the luggages when any door is opened.
en: If the luggages are automatically locked after all doors are closed and locked while the luggage auto-open flag is active, the system shall automatically unlock the luggages when any door is opened.

text: If the luggages are automatically locked due to ignition switch-off while the luggage auto-open flag is active, the system shall automatically unlock the luggages when the ignition is switched on again before the vehicle enters standby mode and any door is opened.
en: If the luggages are automatically locked due to ignition switch-off while the luggage auto-open flag is active, the system shall automatically unlock the luggages when the ignition is switched on again before the vehicle enters standby mode and any door is opened.

text: For the electric vehicles (L4C) there shall be floor hatches on the ground at front side and rear side of the vehicle.
en: For the electric vehicles (L4C) there shall be floor hatches on the ground at front side and rear side of the vehicle.

text:
The status of the floor hatches shall be detected. If at least one of the floor hatches is opened, it shall be shown in the display with texts below :
- If front hatch is opened : "Front Open"
- If rear hatch is opened : "Talegate Open"
- If both hatches are opened : "All Hatches Open"
en:
The status of the floor hatches shall be detected. If at least one of the floor hatches is opened, it shall be shown in the display with texts below :
- If front hatch is opened : "Front Open"
- If rear hatch is opened : "Talegate Open"
- If both hatches are opened : "All Hatches Open"

text: If at least one of the hatches is opened, then driver buzzer shall be continuously active until all the hatches are closed.
en: If at least one of the hatches is opened, then driver buzzer shall be continuously active until all the hatches are closed.

text: If at least one of the hatches is opened, then the bus stop brake request shall be activated until all the floor hatches are closed. If at least one of the floor hatches is opened while driving then the bus stop brake shall be applied when the vehicle is stopped.
en: If at least one of the hatches is opened, then the bus stop brake request shall be activated until all the floor hatches are closed. If at least one of the floor hatches is opened while driving then the bus stop brake shall be applied when the vehicle is stopped.

text: As long as door release is active, the system shall keep bus stop brake request active. Once door release is deactivated by the driver, then bus stop brake request due to active door release, shall be deactivated.

en:
If all of the conditions below are fulfilled, the transformer shall be activated:
-Ignition clamp 15 is on.
-The engine is running or an additional battery is installed or high voltage is on.
-There is no under voltage condition.
-Transformer driver button is pressed.
-Transformer is not active.

text:
If one of the conditions below is fulfilled, the transformer shall be deactivated:
-Transformer driver button is pressed while transformer is active.
-Ignition clamp 15 is turning off while the transformer is active.
-If an undervoltage occurs while transformer is active.
-Engine Run is off when and additional battery is not installed and transformer is active.
- The high-voltage system turns off when an additional battery is not installed and the transformer is active.
